# Chapter 1967: New Otherworldly Demon

"Wake up! Hey, wake up kid."

Peng Da opened his eyes with difficulty. Through blurred vision, he saw the face of a bearded, middle-aged man with clear triangular eyes and a white headscarf covering his head.

"Where am I?!" He was shocked to find himself in a desert under a cloudless sky, scorched by the blazing sun.

"Kid, this place is called Wolf Desert. When we found you, desert wolves had already eaten your dead companions; after chasing them away, we found you still alive."

"My name is Mo Li, leader of this caravan. I saved you and healed your wounds. You are quite lucky to have met us—do you remember anything now?" the bearded middle-aged man explained.

"I transmigrated!"

With several burly men staring at him, Peng Da forced himself to stay calm, holding and shaking his head: "I... I only remember my name is Peng Da. As for the rest... damn it, why don't I remember anything?"

The bearded man looked deeply at Peng Da, light flashing in his eyes: "If you don't remember, forget it. I hope you regain your memories one day. What are your plans now? Do you want to travel with my caravan?"

Peng Da quickly nodded, not daring to travel the desert alone: "Uncle Mo Li, I will definitely repay you for saving my life. Wherever you are going, please take me along; I have nowhere else to go."

"Then follow us." Mo Li nodded, instructing someone beside him: "Provide a camel for kid Peng Da."

Left alone, he was shocked to discover this was not his original body, but one from this world—with tanned brown skin, thick limbs, and bulging joints.

"So only my soul crossed over, entering the body of an inhabitant of this world."

By nightfall, they prepared dinner. A Gu Master planted seeds in the desert that grew into fruit-bearing trees within moments.

"Kid, it seems you really have amnesia! We are Gu Masters! These are Gu Master methods." Mo Li looked at Peng Da with a strange gaze.

"Gu Master?" This was the first time Peng Da heard this phrase.

With an even stranger expression, Mo Li pointed at Peng Da: "Kid, you are also a Gu Master—in fact, a rank two Gu Master."

Extremely excited, he nevertheless succumbed to fatigue by nightfall and fell fast asleep.

"Memory loss or not, he is still a rank two Gu Master and useful to us. There was no loss in saving him," Mo Li said.

As they spoke, Mo Li suddenly frowned, his expression turning grim: "Listen, do you hear something?"

The Gu Masters rushed out of the tent, only to freeze in shock.

A boundless qi tide surged from all directions like a grand tsunami overwhelming heaven and earth, sweeping up sand with unstoppable might.

"Escape!" Gritting his teeth, Mo Li retreated with all his strength before even finishing his sentence.

Amid the chaos, Peng Da remained sound asleep, oblivious to the mortal danger upon him.

# Chapter 1968: Spectral Soul Hunts

In the quiet surroundings of black heaven, three Gu Immortals moved stealthily.

They were Old Man Zheng Yuan, Fairy Zi Wei, and Spectral Soul Demon Venerable!

Fairy Zi Wei analyzed: "The heaven and earth qi varies across the five regions. When Gu Immortals enter other regions, absorbing foreign qi causes problems in their immortal apertures. Now that the regional walls are gone, the five regions' heaven and earth qi is converging into one, giving birth to these qi tides."

Spectral Soul snorted coldly, his voice hoarse and icy: "This qi tide is a hindrance to us! Soul beasts cannot resist it; even if they survive, their soul cores are damaged."

Spectral Soul snorted coldly: "What use is staying by my side? I alone am sufficient, and I have tasks for you two."

Old Man Zheng Yuan and Fairy Zi Wei looked at each other: "Please give us your instructions, Master."

Spectral Soul squinted, saying eerily: "Back then, I expended my assets to refine sovereign immortal fetus Gu for Fang Yuan to create a complete otherworldly demon. Now that Fate Gu is destroyed and the plan succeeded, it is time to retrieve sovereign immortal fetus Gu. I want you two to capture Fang Yuan alive; I will refine him back into sovereign immortal fetus Gu."

Old Man Zheng Yuan frowned, recalling: "Master wants to deal with Fang Yuan? After destroying Fate Gu, that demon left Heavenly Court immediately and did not participate in the subsequent battle. He acted very strangely, and no one knows where he went."

Spectral Soul smiled coldly: "Because of the heaven path dao marks, Fang Yuan could barely save himself and had to make that choice. Since he discerned the arrangement Giant Sun Immortal Venerable placed on wisdom Gu and used it unhesitatingly in the refinement, he can naturally infer my arrangements in sovereign immortal fetus Gu as well."

"But how do we locate Fang Yuan now?" Fairy Zi Wei felt a headache.

Eventually, Spectral Soul ordered: "We temporarily can't find Fang Yuan, we have to force him to show up."

"How? Fang Yuan is a solitary demon with no attachments. Even if he had friends or family, his cruel nature means threats won't make him appear," Old Man Zheng Yuan said, troubled.

Spectral Soul snorted coldly: "During the battle, everyone witnessed Fang Yuan destroying Fate Gu through the killer move everybody's vision. Spread the secret of the sovereign immortal aperture: tell the world Fang Yuan reached rank eight and destroyed Fate because his aperture can annex others to skip tribulations and rapidly raise his cultivation level."

"Periodically, Fang Yuan must annex immortal apertures to sustain his life. Whoever kills him will gain countless venerable inheritances and the sovereign immortal aperture, qualifying them to become an invincible venerable!"

Pausing, Spectral Soul continued: "That will make Fang Yuan the enemy of everyone. We must also reveal his current weakness—that heaven path dao marks have stripped his battle strength, which is why he fled immediately after refining the Gu."

"With the entire world searching for him, where can Fang Yuan hide? Even if he hides for a while, he cannot hide forever. Afterward, both of you will find my hidden secret treasuries. The cultivation resources surplus from refining sovereign immortal fetus Gu are kept there, and their value is substantial. Using these resources, you can rebuild Shadow Sect and help me recruit more members."

"Fang Yuan's subordinates like Bai Ning Bing and Hei Lou Lan are outside—finding them may yield clues to Fang Yuan."

Spectral Soul looked down, his gaze piercing through the darkness toward the five regions: "The five regions have fused into one; converging heaven and earth qi has spawned qi tides spreading across the world. Thus, colliding qi causes tremors in their immortal apertures, forcing the five regions' Gu Immortals to recuperate. The stronger the aperture's foundation, the longer the recovery."

"Fang Yuan will be forced to lie low for a long time. But as former Heavenly Court members with phantom apertures, you two are unaffected. Make use of this time and work hard!"

Spectral Soul waved his sleeves: "Then why are you still here?"

"Master, please take care! We will take our leave." Fairy Zi Wei and Old Man Zheng Yuan left quickly.

# Chapter 1969: Black Heaven's Gu Immortals

After parting with his subordinates, Spectral Soul had been hunting soul beasts in black heaven.

Drawing closer, he found a high-quality soul beast army numbering over three million, delighting him.

This discovery was quite surprising: "Why are there soul path Gu Immortals?"

There were three Gu Immortals controlling the soul beast army.

At the center leading them was a plain-looking female with grey eyes, naturally radiating a rank eight aura.

"Black heaven Gu Immortals." Discerning their aura, Spectral Soul snickered and abandoned his plan to charge in, stealthily mixing into the soul beast army instead.

The female immortal sighed: "Besides me, you two are the most likely in our clan to advance. Now that Fate Gu is destroyed, we control our own fate. The great era has arrived; the peaceful life of the past is long gone. You must strive hard, or Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven will eventually be drowned by the tides of the era!"

The female immortal sighed: "The five regions have fused, spawning qi tides across the world—even black and white heaven are not exempt. Wherever the qi tide reaches, heaven and earth shake, exposing concealed grotto-heavens. We black heaven grotto-heaven Gu Immortals are meeting to discuss how to face this situation. At that time, you will be representing both yourselves and our Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven—do not forget this."

"So that's it," Spectral Soul realized. "With the convergence of heaven and earth qi, grotto-heavens concealed in the two heavens are affected too, for the same reason the five regions' Gu Immortals must recuperate. But while the five regions' Gu Immortals are more affected, the two heavens are less troubled, allowing their immortals to move about with difficulty."

Sensing a perfect opportunity, Spectral Soul remained hidden and followed the three immortals.

After half a day controlling the soul beast army, the three immortals finally arrived at their destination.

"So our friends from Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven have arrived." Seeing them, a Gu Immortal flew out from a pack of night heavenly wolves.

"Night Heavenly Wolf Lord, you arrived early." The rank eight female immortal from Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven replied while smiling.

"Actually, we were late, Lady Cold Ash." Night Heavenly Wolf Lord smiled bitterly, pointing at the grotto-heaven entrance: "Those variant human Gu Immortals have entered already. I waited for you to enter together, otherwise, as lone rank eight Gu Immortals, we will be pushed aside."

Lady Cold Ash nodded grimly: "We gathered today at Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's request. As a snowman Gu Immortal hosting in his Ice Crystal grotto-heaven, this will definitely be dominated by variant human Gu Immortals. Let's go in and see first."

Unknown to her, Spectral Soul had already possessed one of her immemorial soul beasts, he followed after them.

After observing for a while, Spectral Soul saw through the icy palace's foundation, swiftly finding a loophole to enter the hall.

Sitting in the main seat with a squarish face and dignified demeanor was the snowman Gu Immortal Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch.

Beside him were three other rank eight variant humans: a rockman, a hairy man, and an eggman.

"The five regions have merged and qi tides rampage through the heavens. Our grotto-heavens will be exposed; I propose we unite to resist the five regions' enemies together!"

"Do not worry, everyone. Though we are humans, our Soul Pacifying Ancestor was forced into black heaven; we have already severed all ties with the five regions."

"To be straightforward, my Night Wolf grotto-heaven does not wish to be exposed—we share an immense enmity with Northern Plains' Longevity Heaven!"

"Friends," Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch spoke. "Do you only wish to defend rather than advance? With fate Gu destroyed, humanity's reign is disrupted. As the five regions' Gu Immortals recuperate, this is our best chance to act!"

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch sighed with a grim expression: "The five regions are vast and richly resourced; even combined, our grotto-heavens cannot compare to them. The world will plunge into chaos. If we do not strengthen ourselves, the five regions will eliminate us once they settle down. Only by taking the lead can we hope to survive."

# Chapter 1970: Heavenly Court's Dilemma

Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's name and members revealed its soul path foundation, surely rich in cultivation resources Spectral Soul desperately needed.

"Qi tides rampage across the five regions and two heavens, and the black and white heaven grotto-heavens will not stay idle. Hehe, I can exploit this to strike other venerable forces and accelerate my growth!"

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord said: "Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch wants us to form an alliance resisting the five regions. This is quite difficult."

Gu Immortal Ye Zhi nodded: "Indeed. With fate Gu destroyed, the five regions merged, and heaven and earth qi fusing into rampant qi tides, no grotto-heaven can conceal itself. The five regions are obviously stronger than the two heavens, so why can we not join them instead?"

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord sighed: "That is why I agreed with Lady Cold Ash to unite our human grotto-heavens. We should secretly contact Central Continent's Heavenly Court first."

Central Great Hall was finally repaired, with Qin Ding Ling currently in charge.

With Duke Long dead and Fairy Zi Wei turned traitor, Heavenly Court chose Qin Ding Ling as their new leader.

"Oh?" Holding an information path mortal Gu, her expression shifted slightly: "Night Wolf grotto-heaven?"

"Hmph, those of other races have such motives! Once fate Gu got destroyed, these variant humans jumped out immediately." Qin Ding Ling snorted, deep killing intense rose in her heart.

Heavenly Court was at an unprecedented level of weakness.

Recognizing the severity of the situation after brief reflection, Qin Ding Ling decided to discuss it with Zhou Xiong Xin and the others.

Zhou Xiong Xin suggested: "This is crucial, yet the situation remains unclear. Night Heavenly Wolf Lord and the others are merely the rank eights in Central Continent's black heaven. What of the other four regions' black heaven? We know neither how many grotto-heavens exist nor how many rank eight Gu Immortals they hold. I am willing to investigate the two heavens myself!"

Agreeing with his suggestion, Qin Ding Ling chose to maintain contact with Night Wolf grotto-heaven while investigating the situation.

Jun Shen Guang produced an information path mortal Gu: "The candidates have been selected—talented Gu Immortal seeds loyal to Heavenly Court and the ten great ancient sects. However, there is one person requiring everyone's discussion."

The list held many names: Immortal Crane Sect recommended Sun Yuan Hua, Spirit Butterfly Valley put forth Xiao Qi Xing, Ancient Soul Sect offered Gu Ting, Heaven's Envy Manor nominated Wei Wu Shang... but Spirit Affinity House's section was blank.

She knew Spirit Affinity House's intended nominee had to be Feng Jin Huang.

"We will talk about this again next time."

# Chapter 1971: Struggle Between Feng and Zhao

After Feng Jiu Ge betrayed Heavenly Court and vanished, his wife and Feng Jin Huang's mother, Fairy Bai Qing, requested a transfer to Quiet Rain Valley to collect quiet rain, vowing never to leave.

Enchanted by the beautiful music, Feng Jin Huang ventured deeper into the valley and met her mother.

Fairy Bai Qing sat in a bamboo pavilion as two sound path mortal Gu—zither Gu and flute Gu—circled her like white jade pearls.

Already aware of Feng Jin Huang's arrival, Fairy Bai Qing turned slowly: "This demonic immortal unification song was composed by your father when we fell in love; it is the symbol of our relationship. Your father treasured this profound song and kept it hidden, yet he played it during the fate war."

Fairy Bai Qing's tone shifted as she looked fixedly at Feng Jin Huang: "The list of names has already been announced."

Feng Jin Huang nodded: "I know. Heavenly Court gave no reply when the sect recommended me previously. This time, they submitted Sun Yao's name, which Heavenly Court quickly approved."

Fairy Bai Qing said plainly: "The sect originally wanted to recommend you, but Li Jun Ying and Xu Hao interfered, promoting Sun Yao instead. How do you feel about this outcome, my daughter?"

"Hehe." Feng Jin Huang smiled slightly, radiant as a flower, momentarily brightening the bamboo pavilion.

"Mother, why test me? Ever since father turned against Heavenly Court, I have been prepared. The situation is not bad—my dream path Immortal Gu was not taken," Feng Jin Huang said.

Fairy Bai Qing smiled slightly: "Forceful seizures occur in the righteous path as well, merely cloaked in righteousness and morality. It is good that you have reached this level of understanding. Do not worry too much, however. Your father created destiny song upon leaving Heavenly Court; with his peerless strength evident to the world, neither Heavenly Court nor Spirit Affinity House dare touch you."

Feng Jin Huang showed displeasure: "Mother, do not make excuses for him. Turning on Heavenly Court without telling us beforehand was abandoning his wife and daughter! One day, I will settle the score with him."

"Believe me, if I showed the slightest inclination to leave Spirit Affinity House, he would take the initiative to take me away. He understands me well and knows I do not want to become a demonic path member. Therefore, he gave us both the freedom to choose our side, not wanting his ideals to become our burden."

Feng Jin Huang snorted coldly: "Father chose to help the great demon Fang Yuan rather than my master. Master was stubborn and nagged about fate, but he was kind to us and had my best interests at heart. Father was simply too cold and heartless."

"Mother, since you are fine now, I'll be leaving."

Leaving Quiet Rain Valley, Feng Jin Huang encountered two female Gu Masters.

"Senior sister, sorry, I... I did not mean to steal your opportunity..." Sun Yao said anxiously, her cute round face full of worry.

Feng Jin Huang laughed and tapped Sun Yao's forehead: "You did well, so why apologize? The nomination quota is a minor matter—would I be unable to become immortal without this funding? Becoming a Gu Immortal is no obstacle for me; I only have to consider what kind of Gu Immortal I want to become. But for you, this is a rare opportunity, so seize it well."

Feng Jin Huang then turned to Qin Juan: "You have always been diligent and persevering, so why did you faint while fusing with the dao marks? Otherwise, the nomination would have been yours."

"So that was it." Feng Jin Huang nodded with regret: "It is indeed a great loss. Fang Yuan refined destroyed fate Gu into countless heaven path dao marks that dispersed across the world. Ultimately, your achievements in life will depend on your own talents and efforts."

At the same time, on another mountain, Affection Peak.

Spirit Affinity House's Li Jun Ying and Xu Hao visited Zhao Lian Yun.

Having become a Gu Immortal, Zhao Lian Yun was recently appointed Affection Peak Lord by Spirit Affinity House.

"Seniors, you want me to use my status as current generation fairy against Feng Jin Huang and Fairy Bai Qing?"

"Indeed, now is our best chance! Feng Jiu Ge's betrayal caused Heavenly Court's defeat and Fate's destruction. Targeting them now guarantees our victory," Xu Hao urged fiercely.

"This..." Zhao Lian Yun hesitated: "Feng Jiu Ge betrayed Heavenly Court, and I know you hold grudges against him, but why implicate his family?"

"Lian Yun, one cannot be overly kindhearted. Think back to your competition with Feng Jin Huang for the fairy position," Li Jun Ying urged. "If we miss this chance, we will regret it. You need not worry; our sect's original nominee was Feng Jin Huang, but she has already been removed from the list."

Xu Hao dismissed her words: "Back then, did the demon Feng Jiu Ge spare us?"

Zhao Lian Yun sighed and adjusted her argument: "Consider the situation carefully. Heavenly Court has not stripped Feng Jin Huang's status, showing their stance toward her remains ambiguous."

"Precisely because they are uncertain, we must deliver a decisive blow to finalize their stance! Power struggles never cease until a true victor emerges," Li Jun Ying remarked with deep meaning.

Zhao Lian Yun sighed again, forced to accept their request.

Uninterested in any reward, Zhao Lian Yun resumed her closed cultivation after the two departed.

Fate's destruction was great news to Zhao Lian Yun, as reviving Ma Hong Yun would now be far easier.

Yet Ma Hong Yun's soul remained in Fang Yuan's hands.

Thus, Zhao Lian Yun had to cultivate and grow stronger, preparing to rescue her beloved.

Inside the secret room, Zhao Lian Yun calmed down and examined her immortal aperture.

After absorbing the heaven path dao marks, Lian Yun blessed land began undergoing manifold changes.

Watching her immortal aperture's entire transformation unfold, Zhao Lian Yun was dazed and deeply shaken.

"With heaven path dao marks, the immortal aperture transforms closer to a truly balanced environment. Despite temporary losses, its future potential and prospects multiply greatly."

Possessing Divine Concealment from Thieving Heaven's true inheritance, Zhao Lian Yun faced no calamities or tribulations. While advantageous, this had hindered her aperture's development—a problem now greatly alleviated by the heaven path dao marks.

"Sigh, what a pity that I only obtained six and a half heaven path dao marks—all fragmented, without a single complete mark."

"How many heaven path dao marks did Fang Yuan obtain? As the one refining the Gu, he stood closest to them."

Unable to fathom the answer, she knew only that the gap between her and Fang Yuan had widened once more.

# Chapter 1972: Fang Yuan's Disaster Relief

Peng Da groaned and barely opened his eyes to see a bearded uncle slapping his face with a rough palm.

"Uncle Mo Li." He called out: "Wasn't I sleeping on the camel?"

Surrounded by endless sand, the caravan was nowhere to be seen—only he and Mo Li remained, both utterly disheveled.

Uncle Mo Li looked at Peng Da and sighed: "You lucky kid! Many Gu Masters fled desperately and died, yet you survived sound asleep. Still, had I not noticed your faint breath and dug you out, you would have been buried alive."

"Look at me," Mo Li pointed to his chest. "I worked hard most of my life for this caravan, and now it's gone! We must look on the bright side to survive until tomorrow. If only I could become an immortal!"

"Of course!" Mo Li said emphatically. "Making a living in the desert isn't easy; lethal sandstorms are frequent visitors. There are also flying blade hurricanes whose gusts condense into massive wind blades cutting everything in their path. Besides natural disasters, vicious beasts roam—in this wolf desert, desert wolves are most plentiful."

As Mo Li spoke, a pack of desert wolves suddenly emerged from beneath the sand.

Paling, Mo Li cursed aloud: "Damn it! Why weren't these desert wolves wiped out by the disaster?"

Desert wolves emerged from all around, but despite spotting Peng Da and Mo Li, they did not attack, instead gathering to howl and stare at the desert ground.

With shifting sand sounds, millstone-sized golden scorpions crawled out from the ground; Peng Da watched with chills in his heart.

The golden scorpions and desert wolves clashed in a brutal fight.

"We must break out!" Mo Li gritted his teeth firmly.

"Do you want to wait to be eaten?" Mo Li said, about to move: "Kid, can you fight?"

"Huh? I, I can't, I have amnesia."

"The wolves and scorpions don't care about your amnesia. Stay close and do your best—there is at least hope of breaking out." Mo Li laughed, "If we fail, you'll fill their bellies. But don't worry, you won't die alone with me around."

As Mo Li began breaking out, Peng Da yelled: "Uncle, wait for me!"

Almost simultaneously, several golden scorpions and desert wolves lunged from the left and right.

Mo Li grunted and activated his mortal Gu, but only repelled two beasts before the packs encircled them.

"The breakout failed!" Mo Li sighed and gave up the fight.

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Chaos raged across both the mini five regions and mini nine heavens, throwing the entire aperture into turmoil.

Mini Southern Border's mountains collapsed, Mini Central Continent's diverted rivers caused floods, and Mini Western Desert's sandstorms devoured oases.

Mini Northern Plains.

Amid a fierce snowstorm, a pure white flame fluttered in the blizzard, clinging wherever it burned.

"We cannot let this frost ice flame spread!" Snowman Gu Immortal Xue Er took charge, trying to salvage the situation.

Tasked by Fang Yuan to manage Triple Sacred Mountain, she controlled the snow crystal formation to oversee the snowman tribe's expansion.

But at this moment, a figure suddenly appeared.

"Fang Yuan!" Xue Er was stunned before joy filled her face.

Fang Yuan reached into the empty air, drawing away all the frost ice flames within the formation.

Fang Yuan suddenly grunted as his body shook, pale white traces abruptly appearing around him.

From these pale white traces, Xue Er sensed a vast power surging throughout heaven and earth!

"These are... heaven path dao marks! Heavens, so many—he must have at least a thousand!" Xue Er covered her mouth in shock.

"I will leave the rest to you." Smiling at Xue Er, Fang Yuan took the frost ice flame and vanished.

Having helped Xue Er resolve the snowman crisis in Mini Northern Plains, Fang Yuan immediately returned to his secret room to resume closed cultivation.

Holding the prime position while refining fate Gu, Fang Yuan had absorbed over three thousand heaven path dao marks into his body—all complete and intact!

Because the sovereign immortal body had non-conflicting dao marks, Sovereign grotto-heaven had suddenly gained three thousand heaven path dao marks.

"The way of heaven takes away surpluses while replenishing deficits, balancing living beings to limit each other. Even in an extreme environment like the snow crystal formation, the Heavenly Dao could create fire path dao marks within ice and snow path dao marks; once the frost ice flame spreads destruction, Mini Northern Plains will be altered beyond recognition."

"Of course, if ignored, Sovereign grotto-heaven would benefit, creating a balanced, complete ecosystem with great future prospects."

"However, this consumes too much foundation—exactly what Red Lotus Demon Venerable wants to see!"

With fate Gu destroyed and his plan successful, Red Lotus Demon Venerable no longer valued Fang Yuan. Thus, he schemed to restrict Fang Yuan with heaven path dao marks, limiting his growth speed.

Though Fang Yuan saw through this, he had to take the bait. Having noticed that Spectral Soul had tampered with sovereign immortal fetus Gu, he needed the heaven path dao marks to counter Spectral Soul's arrangements.

"Time is about right." A while later, Fang Yuan moved again.

Storing the sovereign immortal aperture, his main body emerged into the five regions.

Standing in Western Desert, he gazed at a tree before him.

Now, he retrieved the immortal formation and took the thousand wish tree, sending both into the sovereign immortal aperture.

Unconcerned, Fang Yuan transformed into a flash of light and soared into the sky.

Surrounded by desert wolves after failing to break out, Peng Da and Mo Li were on the brink of death when air currents arrived.

The desert wolf pack fell into chaos, scattering in flight.

Peng Da jolted: "Another disaster!"

Mo Li's eyes widened before he laughed: "Haha, we are saved! This is no disaster, merely a normal hurricane. Let's go!"

# Chapter 1973: Going After Fang Yuan

With the qi tide gone, sparse clouds drifted across a refreshing sky.

A yellow cloud drifted high in the sky, sprinkling fine sand in its wake.

A corpulent female immortal with a bulging belly sat atop the yellow cloud—a member of Western Desert's Mo clan known as Plump Lady.

Her eyes shone as Plump Lady realized a Gu Immortal had secretly stolen an ancient desolate plant from this spot.

Plump Lady snorted coldly in rising anger. Though she did not know what the plant was, Wolf Desert was Mo clan territory; stealing it was an affront to Mo clan.

Flying onward, she saw a vast oasis with a stone city at its center. Enclosed by low but sprawling walls, Sand Wolf City housed a massive mortal population.

Plump Lady openly descended from the sky directly into the City Lord Manor.

Plump Lady waved her hand, uninterested: "Prepare a secret room for my closed cultivation. Also, how is the gathering of loyal Gu Masters with good aptitude going?"

"Very well. I will collect them in three days. You may return to your duties."

As the secret room's door closed, Plump Lady waved her hand to activate the formation.

Looking exhausted, she probed her immortal aperture with divine sense and let out a deep sigh at the scene within.

Her immortal aperture had once been flat yellow sand, with over six thousand acres of sand farms meticulously cultivated at its heart.

After absorbing five heaven path dao marks during the fate war, however, her immortal aperture shifted, turning uneven as numerous sand dunes formed. Furthermore, a trench cleaved through the center of the desert like a knife, splitting the land and destroying thousands of acres of sand farms.

With the five regional walls gone, the five regions' heaven and earth qi fused unobstructed. Western Desert's changing qi caused the foundations of local Gu Immortals' immortal apertures to diverge from the outside environment.

Absorbing this foreign heaven and earth qi destabilized their immortal apertures, causing tremors.

The best solution was to adapt to the changes by continuously absorbing and expelling heaven and earth qi. If one remained in closed cultivation while heaven and earth qi drastically shifted, opening the immortal aperture to absorb qi later would cause massive tremors and severe damage.

With the five regions unified, peace was at an end. Lone cultivators and super forces alike prepared for the massive battles ahead.

Plump Lady had been tasked to go to Sand Wolf City to bring back Gu Immortal seeds for Mo clan to nurture.

Now, preparing for war, every force was mobilizing these resources.

Thus, factions prioritized nurturing Gu Immortals over hoarding resources. The prevailing consensus was that if they failed to cultivate enough Gu Immortals, their enemies would seize those hoarded resources upon wiping them out in the future.

Plump Lady activated her Gu worms, connecting to treasure yellow heaven.

Other than that, there was Fang Yuan's arrest warrant!

A mysterious force detailed Fang Yuan's circumstances, offering a huge reward for his latest information.

It revealed that Fang Yuan possessed the sovereign immortal aperture with non-conflicting dao marks, but was now burdened by heaven path dao marks, causing his strength to plummet.

The secrets of sovereign immortal fetus Gu were fully exposed, issued not by Heavenly Court, but by Fairy Zi Wei and Old Man Zheng Yuan under Spectral Soul's orders.

Unbeknownst to her, she had once fought Fang Yuan—and the ancient desolate plant stolen earlier had been taken by him.

As Plump Lady entered closed cultivation, two battered figures supported each other toward Sand Wolf City.

"There's an entry fee?" Peng Da, one of the downcast Gu Masters, stared with wide eyes.

The middle-aged Gu Master he supported was Mo Li.

Saved by the air currents from Fang Yuan retrieving the thousand wish tree, they had painstakingly reached Sand Wolf City.

"I have it." Prepared, Mo Li handed two primeval stones to the guard.

Mo Li patted his shoulder: "Let's go, kid. I can still afford this fee. Stay with me for now—you have no money or memories of this city, so how could you survive alone?"

Mo Li's residence was a large house with a blooming garden in central Sand Wolf City.

"I'm back!" Mo Li knocked, and his wife opened the door.

"You're finally back!" Mo Li's wife, a rank two Gu Master, greeted him with surprised delight. "When the qi tide struck, I feared the worst..."

"I survived by luck, but the caravan is ruined and only the two of us made it," Mo Li sighed.

After dinner, Mo Li told his wife, "We still have savings left. Even with the caravan gone, as long as I live, I can rebuild!"

"What is it?" Mo Li was curious as he asked.

"After you left, the city lord announced that loyal Gu Masters with A grade aptitude would be selected. It is an order from the higher-ups to nurture new Gu Immortals."

"Oh? The city lord posted a notice?" Mo Li asked. "I passed the gates too quickly to notice."

Mo Li's wife continued, "Our son heard and wants to sign up."

Mo Li chuckled: "I admire his ambition, but he only has B grade aptitude."

His wife laughed: "Aptitude matters less than loyalty to Mo clan. If we show sufficient loyalty, he might be selected."

Mo Li realized at once, asking:" How much?"

When Mo Li's wife named the sum, Peng Da's jaw dropped.

Mo Li's wife looked troubled: "Even all our savings won't be enough. Husband, the decision is yours."

Mo Li hesitated before steeling his resolve: "I will borrow! It is rare that our son wants to improve himself. I'll shamelessly borrow until we have enough funds."

# Chapter 1974: Creating An Opening

Beneath Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's purple sky and thick grey clouds, the layout was impressive enough to draw praise even from Spectral Soul.

As a soul path grotto-heaven with abundant resources, it had once produced two rank eight soul path immortals simultaneously.

Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's greatest trait was an immortal killer move influencing all its lifeforms, pacifying soul beasts and soothing Gu Immortals' souls to greatly aid soul cultivation.

Already raising soul beasts, Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven's Gu Immortals ventured outside to hunt and stockpile even more to prepare for war in the unified five regions.

Deeming this insufficient, the leadership led by Lady Cold Ash dispatched even more Gu Immortals to hunt soul beasts.

After resting only a few days in the grotto-heaven, An Xun was ordered back out to hunt soul beasts.

Before his departure, Lady Cold Ash summoned him: "You will command three thousand soul beasts guarded by an immemorial soul beast. Do your best."

Leading the soul beast army, An Xun departed Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven to hunt in black heaven.

Finding few soul beasts along the way but gathering abundant qi path immortal materials, An Xun did not know whether to laugh or cry.

While An Xun was puzzled, Spectral Soul understood: "The passing qi tides flood the area with qi path dao marks, suppressing other paths. Soul path is no exception, making soul beast formation difficult. In contrast, qi path immortal materials are going to increase in numbers, they will be at an absurd number in the future."

Disguised as an ancient soul beast, Spectral Soul shadowed An Xun out of the grotto-heaven for his own objectives.

Over ten days later, An Xun encountered a pack of over a thousand soul beasts.

An Xun held the initial advantage until an immemorial soul beast emerged among the enemy.

At the cost of heavy injuries, An Xun finally slew the enemy immemorial soul beast.

Tallying his spoils despite his injuries, An Xun secured eight hundred soul beasts, including numerous ancient soul beasts.

Just as An Xun let down his guard, Spectral Soul struck like lightning, flying into his body.

An Xun convulsed violently with a distorted expression before settling back to normal.

As Spectral Soul emerged from his body, An Xun knelt: "Greetings, Master!"

Spectral Soul possessed the ability to invade a lifeform's soul and alter it, compelling absolute loyalty from their very core.

He orchestrated this battle rather than attacking directly to deceive Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven. As a rank seven Gu Immortal exploring black heaven, An Xun carried investigative methods that would instantly alert the grotto-heaven to any mishaps.

"With An Xun subdued, I have a foothold in Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven. Lady Cold Ash will soon follow," Spectral Soul chuckled.

"Creating a foothold here far surpasses hunting soul beasts myself. I wonder what progress Fairy Zi Wei has made."

At the same time, in a certain Central Continent valley.

"Fang Yuan, you cannot escape." Fairy Zi Wei called out, using a purple meteor attack.

The purple meteor struck Fang Yuan, blowing a gaping hole through his chest.

Staring at Fairy Zi Wei, Fang Yuan collapsed heavily and dissipated into smoke.

"Another clone!" Despite expecting it, Fairy Zi Wei felt deeply weary.

She promptly collected the smoke left behind by the myriad self clone.

Absorbing the white smoke, the clone's cultivation level climbed once more.

These myriad self clones had been summoned during the Heavenly Court battle, then scattered across Central Continent by Fairy Zi Wei's transportation formation.

Tasked by Spectral Soul to hunt Fang Yuan, every lead she received from the arrest warrant pointed only to these clones.

Left unchecked, these clones provided perfect concealment for Fang Yuan's main body, or he might even be hiding among them.

Watching the sealed clone's cultivation rise, Fairy Zi Wei grew anxious: "Fang Yuan's human path attainment is terrifying. These clones can devour each other and display such autonomy..."

"Fang Yuan's strength is low for two reasons: converging qi tides are destabilizing immortal apertures, and the heaven path dao marks he absorbed act as a seal."

"Human path is best suited to counter heaven path. Who knows how many heaven path dao marks Fang Yuan gained, or how long they can suppress him?"

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

The thousand wish tree was planted in Mini Central Continent.

The Mini Central Continent array served as the main formation, with four human path sub-formations to be built across the other mini regions.

"Using human path to restrain heaven path... let's see how effective this is." Fang Yuan held high expectations for the plan.

# Chapter 1975: World Poetry Competition

Within Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven, Lady Cold Ash was the only rank eight, she was naturally their leader.

One day, Lady Cold Ash summoned An Chong: "Ever since Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch convened our meeting, he has actively pushed for the grotto-heavens to unite. However, Central Continent's black heaven has many variant humans and only two rank eight humans, including me. Fortunately, I have contacted Granny Skeleton, a rank eight Gu Immortal from Eastern Sea's black heaven. You will travel to Eastern Sea representing Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven to meet Granny Skeleton and demonstrate our sincerity to cooperate."

Encountering no mishaps, An Chong reached Eastern Sea's immemorial black heaven. Following Lady Cold Ash's guidance, he entered Shattered Bone grotto-heaven and met Granny Skeleton.

"Fate is destroyed and qi tides surge; without cooperation in this changing world, our future is bleak. As humans, we must unite." Raising no difficulties, Granny Skeleton agreed immediately.

Granny Skeleton continued: "However, variant humans dominate Eastern Sea's black heaven. If Lady Cold Ash seeks cooperation, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch must also be rallying variant humans across the other regions' black heavens."

Granny Skeleton added: "If we unite black heaven's humans, why not include white heaven? I have already contacted many with promising responses. However, there is one key figure we need your help to persuade."

Granny Skeleton paused: "This person is a rank eight Gu Immortal known as Old Immortal Hua Yu, master of Profound Literature grotto-heaven. He is highly renowned in Eastern Sea's white heaven. Allying with him will draw in numerous white heaven Gu Immortals, saving us immense effort."

Making up his mind, An Chong replied: "Since Senior has planned this, Junior shall head to Profound Literature grotto-heaven."

An Chong departed Shattered Bone grotto-heaven for immemorial white heaven to meet Old Immortal Hua Yu.

Upon meeting Old Immortal Hua Yu, An Chong delivered his prepared speech, but the old immortal remained unmoved.

"My Profound Literature grotto-heaven does not involve itself in worldly affairs, we are a neutral party. Even though we do not want to make an alliance, the two of us can still exchange resources."

After parting with Old Immortal Hua Yu, another Gu Immortal invited An Chong to stay.

Gu Immortal Hua Song hosted him, saying: "You have traveled far; stay a few days. The mortal imperial court is holding a world poetry competition with many fine poems recited—it is quite interesting to watch."

Wanting to improve relations with Profound Literature grotto-heaven, An Chong accepted the invitation despite having no interest in poetry.

Amid the bustling streets, Li Xiao Bai and Teacher Jiang walked side by side.

"The world poetry competition has eighteen rounds, Xiao Bai—this is your best chance to change your circumstances," Teacher Jiang sighed. "Your talent can pass the first ten rounds, but the last eight depend on luck. I cannot help you this time, and we might even become opponents."

Li Xiao Bai was Fang Yuan's clone, sent to Profound Literature grotto-heaven to seize control of it.

Initially, Li Xiao Bai fared smoothly, winning Su clan's young miss Su Qi Han's affection, becoming one of the ten great scholars, and earning the chance to be Su clan's son-in-law.

In the capital, Li Xiao Bai faced setbacks, covert targeting, and unwittingly offended officials and royalty. Without Teacher Jiang's help, he would have ended up begging on the streets.

"Though my main body destroyed fate Gu, our immense luck was nearly exhausted, leaving me, his clone, terribly unlucky."

"Profound Literature grotto-heaven created this world poetry competition to select new Gu Immortal seeds. Unaware of the details, Teacher entered and will become my obstacle."

"With my terrible luck, I will definitely face him. Defeating him might breed lifelong resentment, but this opportunity is too rare. If I do not seize it now, greater troubles await!"

# Chapter 1976: Li Xiao Bai's Spring Poem

Entering the fifth-floor room, they looked through the window at the bustling streets; the avenue by the bronze gate hosting the first round was completely packed.

"These are Profound Literature grotto-heaven's scholars. Please observe," Hua Song said, handing An Chong an investigative Gu that inspected talent qi.

An Chong activated it immediately. His vision shifted, revealing talent qi of diverse colors, heights, and forms rising above countless scholars' heads—an eye-opening sight.

Hua Song chuckled: "Talent qi is like cultivation level; even if abundant, one might not utilize it properly in competition. Furthermore, composing poems on the spot prevents cheating. We want to test their foundation; those with abundant talent qi may lack the inspiration to compose top-quality poems."

As the two immortals enjoyed tea, the first arena's bronze gate slowly opened.

Li Xiao Bai was among them, staying toward the back.

"This allows Profound Literature grotto-heaven to select the finest Gu Immortal seeds, giving those who slip up another chance. Scholars who fail across all seven days are deemed subpar, unqualified for the grotto-heaven's immortal ascension assistance."

Reining in his thoughts, Li Xiao Bai arrived at the first arena.

Drums rolled as a voice transmitted into the scholars' minds: "World poetry competition, first question — Spring, time limit five minutes."

Li Xiao Bai thought: "Spring poems are so abundant that this seems easy; most scholars have verses prepared for this theme. Though composing on the spot is required, one can easily modify existing verses into new poems."

Li Xiao Bai pondered: "Which poem should I use—or steal?"

His memory held countless renowned classics about spring.

However, producing an astounding masterpiece right away would draw suspicion given his ordinary talent qi.

With good luck, he might take slight risks, but burdened by bad luck, he decided to play it safe.

Lights of varying colors and intensities appeared, rewarding each scholar once the glow faded from their body.

Li Xiao Bai decided on his poem.

He coughed lightly before starting his recital.

"A moonlit night."

"Deep into the night, the moon shines on half a cottage; across the sky, the Big and Little Dippers slant."

"Tonight the warmth of spring is felt; through the green screen, insects buzz and hum."

As Li Xiao Bai finished reciting, faint buzzing sounded and his body radiated intense green light.

"Such, such a strong light!"

"A famed poem has appeared!"

Looking calm yet feeling conflicted, Li Xiao Bai thought: "Sigh, I went overboard; that eye-catching effect drew too much attention."

As green light entered his aperture, his cultivation rose.

# Chapter 1977: Li Xiao Bai's Inner Conflict

After his recital, three more people stepped up.

One, a burly man wearing a golden mask, shone with glaring golden light.

An old man wearing a conical hat held a cane amid swirling green light.

A slender, veiled woman in a pink dress finished her recital, surrounded by a beautiful flutter of butterflies.

All three produced famed poems matching Li Xiao Bai's moonlit night.

Li Xiao Bai sighed in relief: "With Gu worms assisting creation, famed poems appear far more readily than on Earth."

The four of them occupied their own spaces and exchanged glances.

Without incident, Li Xiao Bai advanced and was teleported away.

After he regained his senses, he arrived in another arena.

A voice echoed in his mind: "This is the fifth round; scholars, please wait patiently."

Li Xiao Bai realized: "Advancement varies—my poem was good enough to skip directly to the fifth round."

"However, everyone here produced a famed poem. With only half advancing, the pressure has intensified."

After several minutes in the arena, the fifth round began.

The theme was announced—Travel, with the same time limit as before.

Li Xiao Bai was also contemplating: "Which poem do I copy?"

As time ran out, several famed poems finally emerged.

One from the strong man.

He recited a poem ablaze with martial intent, echoing charging steeds and clashing weapons amid shimmering golden light.

The second famed poem came from the woman.

She crafted a gentle poem portraying a maiden listening to travelers' tales and imagining her own journey—quite impressive.

"My turn." Li Xiao Bai coughed lightly and recited:

Date flowers fall on the villagers' clothes, the sound of reeling carts heard from every household, old men in simple clothes sell cucumbers beneath the willow tree.

Feeling drunk and drowsy from the long journey, the blazing sun parches my throat; I thirst for a refreshing drink, I knock on a mortal's door, asking for some tea.

He had copied Su Shi's Silk-washing Stream.

Li Xiao Bai exhaled, feigning sheer exhaustion.

"I should advance safely now—performing well without drawing excessive attention or looking incompetent."

He became stunned.

Most scholars failed to create a poem.

The failed scholars departed nonchalantly, while those who composed mediocre poems looked ashamed.

Outwardly calm, Li Xiao Bai was inwardly bewildered: "How can you all act so nonchalantly?"

Though he advanced, he stood out again. He had not expected these scholars to be so inept.

"Hmph, I had overestimated them." Li Xiao Bai thought.

Without further ado, he successfully advanced to the ninth round.

At this point, the pressure of these competitors intensified again.

"Stay steady, no more commotions!" Li Xiao Bai clenched his fists, reminding himself.

This time, his opponents excelled, with over half creating famed poems.

Appearing nervous while remaining composed, Li Xiao Bai recited his pre-prepared poem.

Amid flickering light, his cultivation rose to rank four and he gained a new Gu worm.

Planning meticulously, he composed a middling poem and advanced successfully at the bottom of the batch.

Cough!

Someone coughed out a mouthful of blood.

Ugh.

Someone fainted on the ground.

The burly man sat down unsteadily, while the pale woman coughed incessantly.

Only Li Xiao Bai remained standing, completely unaffected.

Li Xiao Bai: "..."

He was speechless.

Oh heavens, why did everyone overexert themselves?!

Wasn't this just a poetry competition? Why risk their lives?

He considered coughing blood too, but it was too late to fake it.

Li Xiao Bai could only advance to the next round with an impassive face.

# Chapter 1978: Human Path, Changing Luck

Sovereign immortal aperture, Mini Central Continent.

Standing under the Thousand Wish Tree, Fang Yuan gazed up at a dazzling sky filled with flickering specks of blazing light.

His heaven path dao marks were increasing in number!

To hinder its growth, the Heavenly Dao used heaven path dao marks to manifest scorching sun and sand, isolating it from humanity.

At his will, Cooking Luck Pot revealed itself above him.

Low luck from the fate war formed his third hidden threat alongside qi tides and heaven path dao marks.

Yet with pseudo-venerable battle strength, Fang Yuan's main body possessed ample power to withstand any misfortune.

While unproblematic for his main body, he worried about his clones' luck.

Li Xiao Bai's luck resembled a crimson flower blooming amid raging flames—seemingly auspicious, yet fatally dangerous if he failed to control the fire.

Wu Shuai's luck formed a coiled dragon clutching three pearls depicting Dragon Palace, innumerable ants, and Di Zang Sheng. Though boasting the strongest luck, Wu Shuai was besieged by converging sword and blade qi.

Heaven path dao marks disrupted his killer moves, causing activations to fail or drastically weakening successful ones.

"This time should be different," Fang Yuan thought, eyes gleaming.

Fang Yuan multitasked, controlling the Thousand Wish Tree's formation while activating Cooking Luck Pot.

The tree shook as brilliant rainbow light shot from the formation into Cooking Luck Pot.

Violent winds and lightning erupted as heaven path dao marks manifested throughout the area and upon Fang Yuan.

Heaven's way reduces surpluses while replenishing deficits.

Man's way reduces deficits while magnifying surpluses!

Aided by the human path immortal formation, Fang Yuan forcefully altered his clones' luck.

The time path clone's river luck stabilized and became smoother.

Zhan Bu Du's eagle shed feathers underwater, transforming into an adaptable fish.

Li Xiao Bai's flower crystallized amid the flames, no longer risking turning to ash.

Wu Shuai's dragon luck remained coiled, but the surrounding blade qi thinned to a light haze, indicating a smaller battle.

"The clones' plight is settled; the real threat remains the heaven path dao marks," Fang Yuan thought, increasingly grasping Red Lotus's intentions.

# Chapter 1979: Merman Court's Vicious Guest

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch shook his head: "Preposterous! Peace can only be gained through conflict and war. The merman race was helped by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable back then, which is why you survived until now. In the five regions, only you remain a super force among variant humans."

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch nodded: "I know of your Floating Reputation Boat, but it is merely a rank seven Immortal Gu House. You have many Gu Immortals, but do you have even one rank eight? Not a single one! Hehehe, if I attack you right now, can anyone stop me?"

With a cold expression, Xie Ning Si retorted: "Immortal Monarch, attack if you wish—we will show you the power of our merman race!"

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch quickly waved his hand: "Don't misunderstand, I am not your enemy. In a world dominated by humans, variant humans must cooperate. I came seeking an alliance, why would I fight you?"

"I understand your hesitation. But what if I spread word that you three invited me here, intending to join black heaven's variant humans to resist humanity? What would happen then? Hehe."

Seeing their silence, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch smiled: "Since we are all variant humans, I will not force you. Let's make a bet."

The mermaids exchanged glances. Yu Zi asked: "What bet?"

"A three-round contest. Use whatever methods you wish; defeat me in just one round, and I will drop the alliance proposal and leave without exposing your tribe or spreading rumors. But if I win all three, it proves your tribe is too weak to resist even a single rank eight Gu Immortal. In that case, you must ally with me to survive the coming tides."

Left with no choice, the three mermaids agreed to the bet.

In the first round, the mermaids deployed their battle formation, merman wave sacred spiritual formation.

In the second round, the Merman Imperial Court deployed Floating Reputation Boat.

After a hundred exchanges, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch claimed victory again.

"If we lose again, we will need to cooperate with Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch, what do we do?"

"Why don't we ask Gu tribe's leader for help?" Xie Ning Si suggested.

Lian Ke Xin sighed: "Gu tribe's leader is a secluded beastman; asking him is difficult, and he might not even defeat Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch."

Yu Zi blinked: "Did you forget the great expert currently staying at Gu tribe's headquarters?"

"Brilliant! I will contact Gu tribe's leader immediately to ask Lord Wu Shuai for help!" Xie Ning Si said, springing into action.

# Chapter 1980: Admitting Defeat

Eastern Sea, Gu tribe's blessed land.

Glowing with faint orange-gold light, the grand pavilions formed the rank eight Immortal Gu House—Dragon Palace.

Dream realms spread throughout Dragon Palace, which was immune to dream corrosion due to its dream path Immortal Gu.

Seeing Wu Shuai, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch lost his carefree demeanor, asking in shock: "You?"

Wu Shuai snorted coldly: "I revived with Fang Yuan's help and merely cooperated with him to resist Heavenly Court. Are you my opponent? Make your move."

Seeing Wu Shuai's haughty look, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's expression turned cold: "Wu Shuai, you are only rank seven, yet you speak so arrogantly."

Wu Shuai smiled: "Arrogant? By seniority, I hail from Red Lotus Demon Venerable's era! When I passed away of old age, your grandfather wasn't even born yet."

"You came looking for trouble with the mermen, so don't waste time." Wu Shuai glared: "Not attacking? Then I will make my move!"

"Dragon Palace!" Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's pupils shrank as the Immortal Gu House crashed toward him.

Dragon Palace expanded, blasting the entire merman hall apart.

Dragon Palace soared into the sky. Standing at its entrance, Wu Shuai looked down: "Don't run, little fellow."

The three mermaids panicked, and Yu Zi cried out: "Senior Wu Shuai! This is our merman headquarters, please fight outside..."

Before she finished, Wu Shuai released Di Zang Sheng from Dragon Palace with a thunderous roar.

The Evil Dragon's mountain-like body filled the blessed land, its sweeping tail flattening mountains and valleys.

"Come, fight," Wu Shuai said flatly to Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch with arms crossed.

After a long silence, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch cupped his fists: "Senior is truly formidable. Junior admits defeat; you have won."

"Next, let's discuss the alliance," Wu Shuai said as he descended.

"What? You still think you can stay isolated?" Wu Shuai asked with raised brows, displeased.

Overjoyed by the unexpected turn of events, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch stammered: "Se... Senior, you mean?"

Wu Shuai patted his shoulder: "Come, let's talk in the hall."

# Chapter 1981: I Will Be The Alliance Leader!

Learning Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch had already convened the grotto-heavens once, Wu Shuai requested to join and urged him to summon everyone for a second meeting.

Though Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch had planned the meeting later, Wu Shuai's reputation convinced him to advance it immediately.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch thus convened an even larger assembly in Ice Crystal grotto-heaven.

Seeing Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch take the lead, the remaining immortals reluctantly acknowledged Wu Shuai's leadership.

"We cannot wait. Once our successful attack makes waves, they will seek us out on their own. That is human nature," Wu Shuai said, waving his hand.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch had to ask: "Then where does Lord Alliance Leader suggest we attack?"

"Heavenly Court?!" The Gu Immortals shouted in astonishment.

Giving no room for objection, Wu Shuai declared: "It's decided! Our target is Xia clan."

# Chapter 1983: You Have A Problem With Me?

"Though these variant human Gu Immortals are rank eight, their combat strength is lackluster. Only Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch is passable."

Dragon Palace slowly activated.

Then, Wu Shuai's icy voice echoed: "If over ten rank eights cannot deal with one rank seven immortal and a rank seven Immortal Gu House, what is the point of your existence?"

Mystical light shot from his palm, piercing hundreds of feet of water to reach the lake bottom.

The water evaporated into mist, and countless human voices echoed from the dense white fog.

"Come." Wu Shuai willed, the fog quickly gathered and condensed into white lake water that flowed into Dragon Palace.

"To think Human Sea is still incomplete." Wu Shuai observed the white fog within Dragon Palace, which manifested human silhouettes and shadows.

Replenishing Human Sea merely required slaughtering enough humans.

Wu Shuai knew Human Sea was Xia clan's attempt to create a human path secluded domain.

As the immortals gathered at Dragon Palace's entrance, an anxious rank eight Gu Immortal questioned: "Lord Alliance Leader, isn't taking the human path treasure for yourself unfair?"

Wu Shuai glanced at him as Dragon Palace used its killer move — Dreamy Light Smoke!

Caught off guard, the speaking rank eight was swept into Dragon Palace by the smoke before he could say another word.

# Chapter 1984: Wu Shuai's Political Skills

After a momentary silence, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch stepped forward respectfully: "Lord Alliance Leader, allies, our priority now is pursuing the Xia clan remnants. Most escaped aboard Whale Fishing Boat; if we do not give chase, it will be too late."

Wu Shuai laughed loudly: "Chase? Why must we chase them?"

Wu Shuai continued: "We took Xia clan's headquarters through a swift surprise attack. Expanding further is difficult now with the righteous path on high alert."

"However, if we let these Xia clan Gu Immortals escape, they will recruit Eastern Sea's righteous path to try reclaiming their territory."

Wu Shuai's expression turned grim: "I care nothing for these Eastern Sea super forces! Only one person warrants my caution: Qi Sea Ancestor."

"Releasing these Xia clan members is also my way of probing Qi Sea Ancestor's intentions."

Fang Yuan divided Xia clan's assets among the Gu Immortals, granting each a considerable fortune.

To the two heavens' surprise, Wu Shuai claimed a far smaller share than expected.

Having distributed the loot, I will not take it back. But Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch, your words remind me of something."

Wu Shuai nodded: "As vice alliance leader, you should not receive the same share as the others. By my decision, Shooting Fish Sea belongs to you."

"Lord Alliance Leader?" Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch looked up in shock.

Wu Shuai laughed: "Take ownership of it. If anyone causes trouble or displeases you, tell me and I'll deal with them!"

Wu Shuai looked around, dragon eyes glinting aggressively. The Gu Immortals averted their gazes, not daring to meet his eyes.

Cold sweat broke out on Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's back: "As expected of the ruler of the dragonmen, I underestimated him! The old monster saw right through my scheme."

He had intended to erode Wu Shuai's support among the allies. Instead, Wu Shuai turned the tables, making the others believe Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch was dissatisfied with his share and exploiting his status and the leader's backing to seize more benefits.

# Chapter 1988: Wu Shuai Fights Qi Sea Ancestor

Thunderous tremors shook heaven and earth. Endless qi waves surged, forcing the radiant Dragon Palace to retreat continuously.

# Chapter 1990: Wu Shuai's Healing

"Heavenly Court!" Great Wisdom Immortal Mother's expression darkened, gritting her teeth in hatred: "The invaders used Demon Judgment Board, Heavenly Court's rank eight Immortal Gu House—this cannot be faked."

Divine Emperor City, painting path world.

# Chapter 1992: Foundational Pillar of Human Path

Entering the painting, Sun Yao gasped in amazement: "This world inside the painting is incredible! Everything seems so real!"

Sun Yao was Spirit Affinity House's chosen Gu Immortal seed.
