"Xiao Bai Hong is too shortsighted. Sun Yao and Chen Da Jiang stayed true to their nature; if they continue like this, they will reap immense benefits."

"Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable's arrangement is truly magnificent; I deeply admire him."

"Historically, the greatest human path true inheritance is The Legends of Ren Zu. Though deceptively simple, it is profoundly deep; only a select few can grasp its essence to create human path killer moves."

"Yet these killer moves are too sparse to establish a path—unattainable as the moon behind clouds for ordinary people. Despite its immense potential, human path lacked a foundation and could never truly develop."

"Yet Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable created this painting world, using a million years of mortal scenes to derive human path's foundation. His contribution to human path is immense—he is truly its foundational pillar."

"The human path developments here greatly benefit me as well. But what happened during my madness, and how did I end up here?"

"Pity I cannot contact Fang Yuan's Fang Di Chang clone. What is happening on his end?"

Knowing Fang Di Chang had refined Divine Bean Palace, Shen Shang realized another collaboration would benefit them both.

# Chapter 1993: Fang Yuan Within The Mist

Sovereign immortal aperture, Mini Southern Border.

In a valley, Shi Shi Cheng leaned over to examine the stone mushrooms.

Healthy stone mushrooms stood five feet tall, but these were stunted like felled tree stumps. Instead of a healthy gray, their bodies showed a distorted multicolored hue.

"These stone mushrooms are ruined!" Shi Shi Cheng's expression turned grim upon confirming his inspection.

Light flashed as Fang Yuan's will manifested mid-air.

Fang Yuan's will waved a hand: "The destruction of the stone mushrooms was a natural disaster. Return for now; materials will arrive shortly to rebuild the valley."

Shi Shi Cheng nodded: "Lord is perceptive. Can these stone mushrooms be recycled somehow? It would be a pity to discard them."

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Don't worry about the details. If I can resolve it, you have no need to worry; if I cannot, knowing is useless. None of these stone mushrooms are usable; using them as Gu refinement materials would only cause harm. You may leave."

Shi Shi Cheng left, only Fang Yuan's will remained in this valley.

Fang Yuan's expression was grim.

The mushrooms' earth path dao marks had been replaced by a chaotic mix of wind, lightning, poison, dark, and fire dao marks.

"Heaven's will!" Fang Yuan's will sneered, discovering heaven's will lurking in the valley.

With a roar, he transformed into a mist blanketing the valley to hunt down heaven's will.

Fang Yuan triumphed and eradicated the lurking heaven's will, though at no small cost.

This victory treated only the symptoms, not the root cause—new troubles would inevitably arise!

Heaven's will had been manifesting across the sovereign immortal aperture, ruining numerous resource points.

By personally refining Gu to destroy fate Gu permanently, Fang Yuan's main body had gained over three thousand heaven path dao marks.

These unrefined dao marks spontaneously transformed the sovereign immortal aperture's environments, making them increasingly balanced and stable.

This greatly enhanced long-term potential, but inflicted heavy near-term losses on Fang Yuan.

Because all his assets resided within the aperture, heavy losses directly undermined his battle strength. Refusing to succumb to Red Lotus's trap, Fang Yuan commanded his subordinates to combat the incessant natural disasters. Simultaneously, he retrieved the thousand wish tree and incomplete Human Sea, using human path to restrain heaven path's effects.

This strategy improved conditions, yet the heaven path dao marks began spawning heaven's will over time.

Unlike the impartial Heavenly Dao, adaptable heaven's will deliberately sabotaged resource points across the sovereign immortal aperture.

"Though I have heaven's will dissipation, the vast aperture constantly generates new heaven's will anywhere, making clearing it inefficient."

The fundamental solution was directly refining these heaven path dao marks so they truly belonged to him.

No one had ever cultivated heaven path before; the only known method was using human path to suppress it.

"Emperor City has become a human path sacred land; seizing it would greatly restrain the Heavenly Dao."

The second way was in Crazed Demon Cave.

"Limitless Demon Venerable's Crazed Demon Cave houses Heavenly Dao derivations in its eighth layer, where demonic sounds corrupt materials through disrupted dao marks. This mirrors my corrupted resources; unlocking Crazed Demon Cave's secrets should resolve this predicament."

Targeting Emperor City would trigger battle with Heavenly Court, and Fang Yuan feared the hidden schemes of Genesis Lotus and Red Lotus.

Genesis Lotus had schemed away Fang Di Chang; recent luck inspections revealed no trace of him, making death probable.

Red Lotus had also plotted against him with these heaven path dao marks, while simultaneously scheming against Spectral Soul. These dao marks were both a danger and a blessing, preventing Spectral Soul from activating hidden methods.

The Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics had failed to appear in the fate war and vanished without a trace.

Fang Yuan suspected Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had plotted wisdom Gu's consumption, proving the venerable still held hidden trump cards.

With fate Gu destroyed, venerables could revive, and entering Crazed Demon Cave would force Fang Yuan to confront their methods.

Another concern weighing on Fang Yuan was the ongoing turbulence within the River of Time.

Since fate Gu's destruction, the River of Time had grown so turbulent that even Myriad Year Flying Warship could not explore for long.

Consequently, Spring Autumn Cicada was temporarily unusable.

In current violent rapids, activating Spring Autumn Cicada would smash it to pieces without a specialized killer move.

"Turbulent water is manageable, but my true concern remains what other arrangements Red Lotus left in the River of Time."

With fate Gu finally destroyed, Fang Yuan had escaped the Sword of Damocles hanging over his head.

Yet the path ahead was shrouded in mist, like walking through a perilous valley where safe terrain and fatal cliffs lay indistinguishable.

Was his lifelong pursuit of eternal life hidden within that mist?

If it existed, where would it be?

# Chapter 1994: Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch Fights Fang Zheng

In immemorial black heaven, a group of Gu Immortals flew stealthily forward.

These powerful Gu Immortals were all rank eight variant humans, led by the pale-skinned, blue-haired Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch, who wore a grim expression.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch had been ordered by Wu Shuai to reinforce the grotto-heaven headquarters against Heavenly Court's invasion.

"Vice alliance leader, we spotted many Gu Immortals ahead," an investigative Gu Immortal reported. "They are allies."

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch nodded calmly: "Go meet them."

As the groups converged, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch examined the reinforcements, rage simmering within him.

Chaotic Rock grotto-heaven sent an immemorial rock monster, Rotten Egg sent six eggman Gu Immortals, and Strange Hair brought the incomplete Black Emperor Building. These three allied factions brought their trump cards, but the rest exerted little effort—the human forces merely dispatching a few rank seven Gu Immortals.

"With the enemy right ahead, these grotto-heavens still preserve their strength! They lie too far apart and rarely interact; our cooperation exists solely under external pressure."

As Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch pondered this, his expression shifted and his eyes widened with blazing fury.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch gritted his teeth: "Demon Judgment Board invaded my grotto-heaven and my tribe is fighting to the death—we must reinforce them now!"

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch glared around: "My grotto-heaven is still resisting. If anyone refuses to help, I will report it to Lord Alliance Leader Wu Shuai!"

Invoking Wu Shuai's name alongside support from his allied variant human Gu Immortals, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch compelled Great Wisdom Immortal Mother and the rest to comply.

As the entrance opened, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch flew in anxiously, followed by the rest.

Ice Crystal grotto-heaven was in chaos as Demon Judgment Board streaked like an unstoppable meteor, slaughtering everything in its path.

Hidden from view, Ice Crystal grotto-heaven's rank six and seven snowman Gu Immortals controlled the formation to bombard Demon Judgment Board with blizzards, to little effect.

Suddenly, Demon Judgment Board fired a sharp blood-red light at the formation's control area.

The snowman Gu Immortals quickly defended themselves; like a mirror reflection, the blood-red light deflected elsewhere.

With an earth-shaking roar, the crimson explosion completely obliterated several thousand li of snowy plains.

As the grotto-heaven's largest snowman settlement, the plain's destruction caused nearly ten million ordinary snowmen to perish horribly.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch suddenly remembered his father's teachings: "The tribe will definitely help you, my son, if you succeed in the trial, regardless of your achievements, you will need to protect our entire race. This is how a snowman lives!" ""

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's aura erupted into a fierce blizzard as he charged toward Demon Judgment Board.

"Two heavens reinforcements are here." Inside Demon Judgment Board, Gu Yue Fang Zheng took a deep breath, his expression turning grim.

"Grand commotion, but can you match Demon Judgment Board?" Fang Zheng sneered, charging directly with the board rather than unleashing killer moves.

Gritting his teeth, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch was forced back.

Seeing this, Fang Zheng nimbly pulled Demon Judgment Board back to create distance.

Demon Judgment Board unleashed blood-red killer moves, slowing the rock monster and scattering the eggmen before they could form their battle formation. Strange Hair grotto-heaven's incomplete Black Emperor Building also hung back, not daring to confront Demon Judgment Board directly.

"I must use that move!" Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch resolved.

"Master, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's group is faltering, should we help?" soul path Gu Immortal An Xun asked Spectral Soul secretly.

Soul Pacifying grotto-heaven had dispatched An Xun, with Spectral Soul lurking alongside him in secret.

"Hehehe, they fought like this despite having so many rank eight Gu Immortals. The two heavens alliance is a joke." Spectral Soul laughed: "No need to be anxious, that Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch has other tricks up his sleeve, let's wait for now."

# Chapter 1995: Extreme Ice Crystal Light Immortal Suppression Coffin

Around him, countless traces of frost energy gathered, whipping up a storm.

Sensing power that surpassed ordinary rank eight killer moves, Fang Zheng steered Demon Judgment Board to obstruct its activation.

Not entirely useless, the two heavens' Gu Immortals quickly moved to intercept Demon Judgment Board.

Though obstructed by the barrage, Demon Judgment Board fired a flash of blood-red light at Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch at the critical moment.

Still preparing his killer move, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch did not budge.

At that moment, An Xun opened his immortal aperture and released an immemorial soul beast.

The immemorial soul beast swiftly shielded Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch, blocking the blood-red light completely.

Howling in pain, the immemorial soul beast crashed downward with half its body destroyed.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch shot An Xun a grateful glance. With his aura stabilizing, he had safely passed the most perilous phase and completed preparations for his killer move.

"Immemorial soul beasts lack blood, neutralizing the blood path attack." An Xun said excitedly, "Master, your reminder saved Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch."

"Not so," Spectral Soul analyzed. "His move grants heightened defense during activation; even struck, he would only suffer injuries without interruption."

"Heavenly Court! Taste my race's unique killer move—Extreme Ice Crystal Light Immortal Suppression Coffin!" Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch roared as his surging aura vanished into complete concealment.

The next moment, his entire body exploded into countless frost lights.

Fang Zheng sensed danger and tried to maneuver Demon Judgment Board, but he was far outpaced by the frost lights.

Almost instantly, countless extreme ice crystal lights struck Demon Judgment Board.

With crystal lights converging from all directions and nowhere to dodge, thick layers of ice instantly enveloped Demon Judgment Board.

Fang Zheng's heart sank as he activated Demon Judgment Board's killer move to melt the ice.

Yet melting could not keep pace with the freezing, and five-foot-thick ice soon encased Demon Judgment Board.

"The thicker the ice grows, the stronger the frost lights become!" Fang Zheng turned pale in shock.

Fang Zheng mobilized Demon Judgment Board, expending his remaining rank eight immortal essence to unleash its strongest killer move.

Blood-red light radiated outward, rapidly melting a layer of ice.

As if reacting, the frost lights swarmed toward his breakthrough point, greatly suppressing Demon Judgment Board's power.

"The signature ancient killer move of the snowmen... hehe, they have already acquired their racial inheritance," Spectral Soul chuckled from within An Xun.

An Xun realized: "No wonder it is so powerful! But the world has changed drastically since ancient times—wouldn't such antique moves be outdated now?"

"Hehehe," Spectral Soul chuckled. "Variant humans had countless killer moves when they ruled the world; those preserved in racial inheritances are naturally exceptional in many aspects. Extreme ice crystal light immortal suppression coffin, for instance, uses the variant human rather than an Immortal Gu as its core."

Extreme ice crystal light immortal suppression coffin consumed not only Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's ice and snow path dao marks, but also his lifespan.

As a snowman racial move, it remained unaffected by passing eras, though unusable by other races.

Just as Demon Judgment Board was about to be sealed in ice, a phoenix cry resounded.

Amidst crashing waves, Prince Feng Xian and Bai Cang Shui arrived.

Seeing the trapped Immortal Gu House, the two rank eight Gu Immortals roared, unleashing torrents of golden flames and surging waves.

Assailed from both sides, the outer ice cracked, and Demon Judgment Board prepared to strike back from within.

The two heavens' Gu Immortals moved to intervene, but Prince Feng Xian and Bai Cang Shui suppressed them.

Sensing the ice weakening during the deadlock, Spectral Soul ordered An Xun: "Deploy the soul beast army and lend me your Immortal Gu."

"Yes, Master!" An Xun obeyed without hesitation.

Prince Feng Xian and Bai Cang Shui attacked, but the soul beast army parted fluidly, evading most damage.

Three immemorial soul beasts then surged from the army to attack Prince Feng Xian and Bai Cang Shui.

Pinned down by the soul beasts, the two Heavenly Court immortals watched helplessly as the frost lights regained control.

Conferring with Bai Cang Shui, Prince Feng Xian spewed flames to blast a path through the soul beasts and charged toward An Xun.

Unwilling to expose himself, Spectral Soul steered An Xun away while maneuvering allies to obstruct Prince Feng Xian.

Meanwhile, the frost light reconverged on Demon Judgment Board, encasing the rank eight Immortal Gu House within a thick ice coffin.

"Not good!" Bai Cang Shui and Prince Feng Xian's hearts sank.

Just as Heavenly Court fell into peril, heaven and earth trembled as surging qi currents roared across the world.

"Qi tide again!" Spectral Soul snorted coldly.

Breached during Prince Feng Xian and Bai Cang Shui's intrusion, Ice Crystal grotto-heaven was now connected to the outside world.

Ice Crystal grotto-heaven's defensive formation shattered, plunging many snowman Gu Immortals into mortal danger.

The frost light hesitated briefly before redirecting toward the snowman immortals, forming protective ice tubes around them.

With Demon Judgment Board's pressure relieved, Prince Feng Xian and Bai Cang Shui swiftly shattered the remaining ice to rescue the Immortal Gu House.

The two entered the Immortal Gu House, and Demon Judgment Board swiftly retreated amidst the turbulent qi tides.

# Chapter 1996: Big or Small, Qi Harvest Fruit

The massive qi tide soon engulfed all of Ice Crystal grotto-heaven.

"A qi tide erupted during Qi Sea Ancestor's clash, and now another appears here."

Spectral Soul realized: "Could battles between Gu Immortals be attracting qi tides?"

"An Xun performed well; such merits should earn him an audience with Wu Shuai."

"Possessing him lets me approach Wu Shuai and seize Dragon Palace!"

Amidst the surging qi tides, frost lights gathered into Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch.

Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch was pale and weakened, having paid a heavy price in lifespan.

Yet having nearly sealed Demon Judgment Board single-handedly, he was the chief contributor to this victory.

"Friends, I am unharmed, merely exhausted. Please help me protect my grotto-heaven," Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch said.

The immortals quelled the qi tides while Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch repaired the aperture breach.

"Vice Alliance Leader, look, we found something!" Great Wisdom Immortal Mother flew over with surprising news.

Floating before them was a hill-sized translucent fruit shaped like a gourd or peanut, condensed entirely from heaven and earth qi.

"This is a qi harvest fruit?"

"Qi harvest fruits often form after qi tides. Using them inside an immortal aperture rapidly calms heaven and earth qi, accelerating their fusion."

"Yet ordinary qi harvest fruits are only carriage-sized. Why is this one so massive?"

"Master, is this truly a qi harvest fruit?" An Xun asked. "Could absorbing it free Ice Crystal's aperture from qi tide disruptions?"

"It is indeed a qi harvest fruit, but whether blessing or curse remains to be seen," Spectral Soul chuckled inwardly.

Sure enough, attempting to harvest the fruit revealed a shocking truth to Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch.

"Oh no!" Ice Crystal paled. "This fruit absorbs my grotto-heaven's qi—uprooting it now will trigger severe upheaval and violent qi tides."

"We cannot allow it to keep growing. Whoever removes this threat will be richly rewarded," Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch declared grimly.

Great Wisdom Immortal Mother suggested: "We lack qi path cultivation, but what about Lord Alliance Leader?"

Worried, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch sighed deeply: "We can only seek Lord Alliance Leader's aid."

Wu Shuai soon received Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's request for help.

"With limited memories, I knew little of such qi harvest fruits. Perhaps the main body knows more."

Wu Shuai promptly forwarded Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's report to Fang Yuan's main body.

"The two heavens discovered their hidden threat earlier than in my previous life," Fang Yuan mused.

Feeding on heaven and earth qi, these fruits grew unchecked until they destroyed entire grotto-heavens.

"Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch's clash with Heavenly Court induced qi tides within his grotto-heaven, making the fruit appear earlier than in my previous life."

As Fang Yuan replied to Wu Shuai, a sudden flash of inspiration struck him.

"Wait!"

"Perhaps I can use these qi tides against heaven's will."

The unrefinable heaven path dao marks were the core problem, continuously spawning heaven's will.

The heaven's will generated by the dao marks plotted to ruin his sovereign immortal aperture.

Once accumulated past a threshold, this heaven's will would resonate with the outside world and expose his identity.

"I could let qi tides rampage through my sovereign immortal aperture like a washing machine, scouring away all the heaven's will."

Pitting both threats against each other was risky, but feasible with his deep attainment.

At the same time, in Qi Jue grotto-heaven.

"The grotto-heaven's center!" Luo clan's three Gu Immortals arrived, wounded and exhausted.

Before them rested a tiny, exquisite qi harvest fruit, its dazzling surface shimmering with flowing light.

Though only gourd-sized, it exuded a genuine rank nine aura and surging vitality that weighed upon the Luo clan immortals.

"This extraordinary qi harvest fruit holds deep secrets—we must research it."

"Strike!" Mid-conversation, a shout rang out as several variant human Gu Immortals ambushed the three Luo clan immortals.

Caught off guard, the Luo clan trio was instantly ensnared in a battlefield killer move.

Their leader was a thumb-sized miniman Gu Immortal with translucent wings.

"Hmph, Luo clan immortals, I, Xiao He Jian, found this place twenty years before you." The miniman Gu Immortal sneered, "Attack, kill them all!"

# Chapter 1997: Both Sides Seek Reinforcements

Days later, in the headquarters of Southern Border's Wu clan.

As Wu Yong pondered his future, an information path Gu worm flew toward him.

"Luo Zu (Luo Ran) pays respects to Lord Alliance Leader." The two Luo clan Gu Immortals bowed upon seeing Wu Yong.

Once the two sat down, Wu Yong asked directly: "What is the matter with Qi Jue grotto-heaven?"

Luo Zu explained: while exploring white heaven with an Immortal Gu House, Luo clan had discovered Qi Jue grotto-heaven. With the qi tides' help, Luo clan finally breached Qi Jue grotto-heaven's central area.

Upon being informed, Luo clan dispatched their Immortal Gu House in reinforcement, clashing fiercely at the heavenly wind qi wall. Although the variant human Gu Immortals lacked high battle strength, their leader, the miniman Gu Immortal Xiao He Jian, was formidable. As the variant humans also possessed an Immortal Gu House, Luo clan was forced to flee back to Southern Border in disgrace.

Defeated, angry, and helpless, Luo clan's immortals returned to recuperate at headquarters. Recognizing they could not claim Qi Jue grotto-heaven alone, they decided to seek external help.

Wu Yong smiled: "Southern Border stands united. Since Luo clan suffered a setback, the Southern Alliance—and I, Wu Yong—will naturally lend our strength!"

As Wu Yong negotiated with Luo clan, Wu Shuai also granted an audience to a Gu Immortal.

"A miniman Gu Immortal named Xiao He Jian is asking to see me?" Wu Shuai squinted.

"Yes," the subordinate answered. "He is a renowned rank eight miniman whose strength rivals the vice alliance leader's."

"Why does he want to see me?" Wu Shuai asked deliberately.

"Xiao He Jian likely clashed with Luo clan over Qi Jue grotto-heaven. Having suffered a loss, Luo clan will definitely seek help from their Southern Alliance and approach Wu Yong."

"Xiao He Jian cannot resist the Southern Alliance alone. Joining us protects him while using our strength to contest the true inheritance."

"However, in my previous life Qi Jue grotto-heaven self-detonated, dealing the two heavens alliance an irrecoverable blow."

From his seat, Wu Shuai set aside his thoughts and instructed, "Go, bring Xiao He Jian in."

# Chapter 1998: Exploring Qi Jue Grotto-Heaven

Two Immortal Gu Houses faced each other.

One was the grand, golden Dragon Palace; the other was Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building, a two-story bamboo structure brimming with vitality and exquisite craftsmanship.

"Wu Yong," Wu Shuai called from Dragon Palace. "Let us hold a best-of-three duel—the winner claims the true inheritance, the loser takes the grotto-heaven."

"Why so cowardly, Wu Shuai?" Wu Yong sneered. "Let the true inheritance go to whoever has the ability to seize it!"

With that, Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building shot like a rainbow into an opening leading into Qi Jue grotto-heaven.

Dragon Palace followed, entering Qi Jue grotto-heaven.

"Qi Jue grotto-heaven is unique—countless white qi currents weave into tunnels like a giant's intestines, turning the entire grotto-heaven into a maze. We must navigate these tunnels quickly to find the path to the center, where Qi Jue's true inheritance is hidden!" Xiao He Jian explained upon entering.

"The closer to the center, the more valuable the monsters—and at the core, the qi harvest fruit has reached rank nine!" Xiao He Jian added.

"Stay alert; Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building is much faster than us," Wu Shuai said plainly.

He picked a path and navigated Dragon Palace inside.

Ahead appeared an immemorial qi monster—a colossal, pitch-black beast resembling a whale.

Dragon Palace surged forward and slammed into the immemorial qi monster.

The immemorial qi monster shattered into black hard qi, which Wu Shuai swiftly collected.

Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building reached the center. Before Wu Yong could celebrate, his pupils shrank: "Hmph, they were not slow at all."

Behind Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building, Dragon Palace arrived.

Qi Jue grotto-heaven's center was a colossal hollow sphere, interlaced with qi pillars that formed countless tunnels.

"These qi pillars are rank eight immortal materials—disturbing them will invite trouble," Xiao He Jian warned.

"No need for such trouble." Wu Shuai waved his hand.

With a thunderous roar, the Evil Dragon descended.

The Evil Dragon rampaged forward, shattering qi pillars in its path to forge a way for Dragon Palace.

# Chapter 1999: Qi Jue, Xi

Wu Yong smiled faintly: "Wu Shuai is using raw strength to press his advantage. I would do the same in his place. Though they are formidable, we need only seize Qi Jue's true inheritance before they do."

As both sides pursued their goal, a third rank eight Immortal Gu House arrived stealthily outside Qi Jue grotto-heaven.

Piloted by Fang Zheng, Demon Judgment Board carried Prince Feng Xian, Bai Cang Shui, the recovered Che Wei, and information path expert Zhou Xiong Xin.

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord had secretly submitted to Heavenly Court; learning of Qi Jue grotto-heaven through Xiao He Jian, he promptly informed them.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue was a legendary historical figure—a terrifying expert who had opposed Limitless Demon Venerable!

Countless holes opened as surging milky-white qi currents began connecting the grotto-heaven to the outside world.

At the center of Qi Jue grotto-heaven.

The Evil Dragon rampaged, but the shattered qi pillars soon coalesced into swirling qi currents, entangling the dragon and assailing it from all directions.

The Evil Dragon roared as its speed plummeted under immense forward pressure.

Wu Yong looked grim: "Qi Jue's true inheritance is our primary objective!"

Blade qi, black hard qi, and death qi barraged them as Wu Shuai drove Dragon Palace forward by force.

"This is Qi Jue grotto-heaven's true foundation..." Wu Shuai observed solemnly, his gaze flickering with uncertainty.

Outside the grotto-heaven, Fang Zheng's hesitation vanished.

"Retreat for now and observe," Fang Zheng ordered as Demon Judgment Board pulled back.

Raging qi currents erupted everywhere as a new qi tide commenced!

Approaching the center, the two Immortal Gu Houses heard rhythmic, thumping sounds.

Inside the qi harvest fruit was the distinct form of a baby!

As the immortals reacted, Wu Shuai tried to unleash dreamy light smoke, but the fruit seemed to sense danger and detonated itself.

The newborn emerged with thin, frail limbs as if malnourished.

Above his head appeared the silhouette of a concave domain radiating a rank nine aura—far more complete and refined than Wu Shuai's incomplete Human Sea.

"Xi—" He shouted out in a long tone.

Immediately, all surrounding qi currents surged into the secluded domain's silhouette like rivers returning to the sea.

Within breaths, the qi currents vanished into the secluded domain without a single strand remaining.

Only the infant and the two rank eight Immortal Gu Houses remained aloft.

"The entire grotto-heaven was absorbed by him!" Wu Yong gasped in shock, realizing they had been used.

"Who are you?" Wu Shuai shouted from within Dragon Palace.

Having grown into a young boy, he inhaled deeply, drawing the secluded domain's silhouette into his nose.

Looking around, he spotted Dragon Palace, Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building, and the concealed Demon Judgment Board.

The boy smiled as he started to recite: (Chapter 1319)

"Climbed mountains to seek immortality, danger present in every step."

Dust specks float like light, dark Gu lurk in heart.

A dream like golden jade, thousands of years of loneliness.

"Five regions and nine heavens, everything is in one breath."

His voice was youthful yet aged: "Who else could I be? Yours truly, Demon Immortal Qi Jue."

"If he is Demon Immortal Qi Jue, then that secluded domain was Xi from The Legends of Ren Zu?" Within Demon Judgment Board, Zhou Xiong Xin realized.

# Chapter 2000: Might of the Demon Immortal

Inside Dragon Palace, Wu Shuai frowned in realization: "Demon Immortal Qi Jue must have failed to revive in my previous life, or there would have been news of it. He would never permit Demon Immortal Qi Jue to revive."

Freed once Demon Immortal Qi Jue absorbed the grotto-heaven, the injured Evil Dragon charged toward him again with an imposing aura.

Without dodging, he extended his small hand toward Di Zang Sheng.

Immortal killer move — Great Qi Grasp!

Bam.

The two collided, but unexpectedly, Demon Immortal Qi Jue's qi hand was shattered in a single blow.

Di Zang Sheng pressed on without slowing, pursuing Demon Immortal Qi Jue.

Yet within seconds Di Zang Sheng slowed, howling in excruciating pain.

"My great qi grasp forms and scatters at will," Demon Immortal Qi Jue said arrogantly. "Condensed, it seizes mountains and seas; dispersed, it invades the organs. How will you handle it?"

"On this glorious day of my revival, let me test the methods of this era's Gu Immortals!"

"Do not be arrogant! We only retreat wary of Fang Yuan," Wu Yong retorted, withdrawing his Immortal Gu House.

Fang Zheng called from Demon Judgment Board: "Legendary as you are, you cannot rival Gu Yue Fang Yuan. Without him destroying Fate Gu, you would never have revived!"

"Fang Yuan? I shall remember him." Demon Immortal Qi Jue spread his arms, releasing rapid qi currents. "None of you shall escape!"

These unique qi currents resisted ordinary killer moves, ensnaring all three Immortal Gu Houses and slashing their speed.

Wu Shuai snorted, steering Dragon Palace forward to attack Demon Immortal Qi Jue instead of retreating.

A trace of smoke flew out of Dragon Palace.

Immortal killer move — Dreamy Light Smoke!

Gazing warily at Dragon Palace, he noted: "Good, I will remember this."

Abandoning Dragon Palace, he attacked Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building and Demon Judgment Board instead.

After a dozen exchanges, his eyes shone brightly: "Splendid! To think wind path and blood path have been created—reviving in this great era was worth every effort!"

"Who else stands among the world's finest?" Demon Immortal Qi Jue asked.

Wu Shuai cut in: "Get past us first, old man."

Demon Immortal Qi Jue smiled and pointed: "Lower qi."

Milky-white qi currents surged, forcing Dragon Palace downward.

Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building summoned a storm and charged at Demon Immortal Qi Jue.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue pointed another finger: "Upper qi."

Swept by qi currents, Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building flew upward uncontrollably.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue pointed two fingers at Demon Judgment Board: "Upper-lower breathless qi."

With a boom, Demon Judgment Board froze midair. Inside, the shocked immortals found their essence flow disrupted—the rank eight Immortal Gu House gasped like a dying elder.

"Juniors, playtime is over. Tell Fang Yuan, Qi Sea Ancestor, and Feng Jiu Ge that I will visit them soon. None of them can hide from me."

"Retreat," Wu Yong smiled. "Though our gains were few, battling Demon Immortal Qi Jue makes this trip worthwhile."

# Chapter 2001: Recruiting Qi Sea Ancestor

News of Demon Immortal Qi Jue's revival and his suppression of Heavenly Court, Southern Border, and the two heavens quickly shocked the entire Gu Immortal world.

"Have you said enough?" From the head seat, Wu Shuai snorted in displeasure.

Wu Shuai cut him off: "Enough, silence. With the Evil Dragon and Dragon Palace, we need not fear Demon Immortal Qi Jue. The urgent issue is the qi harvest fruits inside your grotto-heavens."

"Demon Immortal Qi Jue revived from a qi harvest fruit—if left unchecked, these mysterious fruits will destroy your grotto-heavens."

Night Heavenly Wolf Lord secretly informed Heavenly Court and requested their aid.

Qin Ding Ling attached great importance to Qi Jue's revival and the crisis in the two heavens, especially since Heavenly Court itself had sprouted a qi harvest fruit.

Qi Sea Ancestor and Wu Shuai clashed repeatedly across the two heavens and Eastern Sea.

Though Wu Shuai and Qi Sea Ancestor fought frequently, casualties remained low, as both sides prioritized resolving the qi harvest fruit crisis over destroying each other.

"Demon Immortal Qi Jue likely understands the qi harvest fruit best, but my strength is constrained," Fang Yuan sighed.

Though he had resolved the threat of heaven's will, he still had no clue how to refine the heaven path dao marks.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue, whom Fang Yuan was pondering, had just arrived in Western Desert.

Failing to borrow Gu from Qi Sea Ancestor, he used qi path investigative methods to search for other qi path Immortal Gu.

"I deduced a qi path Immortal Gu is nearby." As Demon Immortal Qi Jue muttered, a Gu Immortal suddenly entered his investigative range.

Rank eight Gu Immortal, Red Heart Traveler!

# Chapter 2014: Qi Jue Takes Blood Qi

Seeing the handsome, green-robed Gu Immortal in a headband standing tall and imposing, Demon Immortal Qi Jue was startled: "Could that qi path Immortal Gu I deduced be on him?"

The moment this thought emerged, Demon Immortal Qi Jue attacked!

With a loud sound, a giant white qi hand moved to catch Red Heart Traveler.

Unrecognized by Qi Jue, Red Heart Traveler already possessed Heavenly Court's intelligence on him.

So Red Heart Traveler retreated without any hesitation.

The next moment, blood-red light flared behind Red Heart Traveler's head, sharply boosting his speed and allowing him to dodge the qi hand.

Unwilling to let Red Heart Traveler escape so easily, Demon Immortal Qi Jue gave chase.

After pursuing for a while, Demon Immortal Qi Jue shouted: "Where do you think you're running?"

Surrounding qi currents instantly engulfed Red Heart Traveler, severely hindering his speed.

Disadvantaged in direct combat, Red Heart Traveler shielded himself with radiant blood-red flowers that exuded righteous warmth.

Suddenly, a beast roared as an immemorial desolate beast burst from the sands, launching a surprise attack on Demon Immortal Qi Jue from behind.

Just before the giant hand struck, the beast shone brilliantly and transformed into an immemorial swallow, shooting at Demon Immortal Qi Jue like a black arrow.

"A transformation path Gu Immortal! Haha, interesting," Demon Immortal Qi Jue praised in mild surprise while engaging the new foe.

The aid was from Nine Spiritual Fairy.

"We can't drag this out! This old demon is terrifying, and we are no match for him. We are only holding on because he is unfamiliar with our methods," Red Heart Traveler hurriedly transmitted.

"I have a plan, follow me!" Nine Spiritual Fairy transmitted, retreating while fighting.

Demon Immortal Qi Jue pursued the two immortals deep into the desert.

Nine Spiritual Fairy transformed into an immemorial desolate beast, took Red Heart Traveler into her mouth, and plunged into the sands.

With a clap of his hands, heaven and earth shook. Milky-white qi currents slammed down like a tsunami, depressing the surrounding hundred li of desert over ten feet deep!

Just as Demon Immortal Qi Jue moved to dive down and give chase, a beast roared and a massive immemorial soul beast erupted from the desert.

Furious and bizarrely shaped, the immemorial soul beast possessed a tortoise shell, four tiger paws, a dragon tail, a snake neck, and a disheveled human head with eyes radiating ominous fury.

"You found Qing Chou!" Seeing Demon Immortal Qi Jue tangled with the beast, Red Heart Traveler exclaimed in shock.

Nine Spiritual Fairy had located Qing Chou recently, but lacked the strength to subdue it alone. When Red Heart Traveler encountered Demon Immortal Qi Jue, she devised a plan to pit Qi Jue against the beast.

Contrary to their expectations, Demon Immortal Qi Jue sensed something amiss and exhaled vast qi currents that filled the sky.

He entered them and quickly disappeared.

Lacking an opponent, Qing Chou also fled beyond the horizon.

Deep underground, the two Heavenly Court immortals exchanged looks. Red Heart Traveler blurted out: "Damn it! The Blood Sea true inheritance is going to be taken!"

Nine Spiritual Fairy froze before asking: "You truly found that blood path true inheritance?"

Red Heart Traveler sighed: "A qi tide exposed the Blood Sea true inheritance, but I arrived only to encounter Qi Jue."

Meanwhile, Demon Immortal Qi Jue returned to the original spot.

"It really is here!" After inspecting the area, he found the target unmoved.

With further effort, he successfully claimed this Blood Sea true inheritance.

"And this blood qi Immortal Gu suits me perfectly. Hahaha."

Acquiring a qi path Immortal Gu boosted his strength far beyond immortal material consumption.

Though still short of his historical peak, he was already far stronger than when he fought Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 2015: Sand Wolf City's Huge Change

Western Desert.

Amid howling winds and flying sand, a camel caravan trudged with difficulty through the barren desert.

"Heavens, we're finally back at Sand Wolf City," an exhausted Peng Da exclaimed from within the caravan.

Riding a camel beside him, Gu Master Mo Li chuckled: "Kid, you're singing a different tune from when we first set out."

Mo Li smiled, thinking of his wife and reformed son, who was being cultivated as a seed.

These simple blessings gave Mo Li fresh hope and drive. Caravan life was arduous, but he found his own joy in it.

Finally, they arrived in front of Sand Wolf City's gate.

Sand Wolf City lay in smoking ruins, corpses and rubble littering the burning streets.

Mo Li muttered dazedly before bolting toward the inner city.

Reaching the ruined house, Peng Da found Mo Li kneeling in silence before his wife's excavated corpse.

Looking at the statue-still Mo Li, Peng Da hesitated before urging: "Uncle, pull yourself together. Don't forget you still have a son."

These words jolted Mo Li, reigniting a glimmer of hope in his eyes.

"My son is in the inner city being nurtured as a Gu Immortal seed—let's find him!"

Carrying his wife's corpse, Mo Li rushed toward the inner city with Peng Da.

The whole inner city area had turned into a huge crater.

Peng Da gasped, realizing the massive crater was a beast's footprint. For a footprint to be this immense, the beast had to be colossal!

"Did the giant beast not leave?" Peng Da looked up and saw two figures floating in the sky.

"Gu Immortals!" The other Gu Masters shouted.

"Disaster befell this place as well." The Gu Immortals spoke openly, their voices echoing below.

"This damned beast caused my Mo clan disastrous losses. Once I capture it, I will pull out its tendons and flay its skin!" another Gu Immortal fumed.

"Let's go, we will catch up soon." The two Gu Immortals quickly flew off.

"I want to follow them and look," Mo Li said resolutely.

Mo Li was firm: "I cannot avenge my family, but I will stake everything to see the culprit die with my own eyes!"

"Uncle, I also want to follow you." Peng Da said.

"Stay behind, kid." Mo Li's expression softened as he looked at Peng Da.

Peng Da smiled bitterly: "You saved me repeatedly and are closest to me. I won't leave you now—let me come!"

Mo Li stared at Peng Da for a long while before nodding hoarsely: "Then follow me, rascal."

Following the beast's trail across the desert, Mo Li struggled forward alone; climbing a sand dune, he took a sharp breath at what he saw.

Far away in the horizon, dark fog covered everywhere.

The fog was the dark qi current from earlier. Within it, Mo Li vaguely saw a mountain-sized beast and occasional flashes of lightning.

Mo Li took a deep breath and was about to advance when someone suddenly hugged him from behind.

"Uncle, do you want to die? Don't go any further, you'll lose your life!" Peng Da shouted.

"Brat, why haven't you left yet?" Mo Li was furious.

Peng Da urged: "Uncle, you are my benefactor—how could I watch you die? Live on, don't throw your life away!"

"I don't need saving! Even if I die, I'll stake my life for revenge. If even an insignificant attack lands on that damned beast, I will be satisfied!"

Boom——!

As they bickered, a hurricane swept in from the battle on the horizon.

Resembling a pillar connecting heaven and earth, the hurricane rushed toward them.

"Damn it!" Unable to dodge in time, Peng Da and Mo Li were swept away by the hurricane.

The two insignificant figures instantly vanished into the violent hurricane.

# Chapter 2016: Dazzling Smile

Western Desert.

Dark clouds covered the sky and thunder rumbled as the Mo clan Gu Immortals battled the mysterious giant beast.

"You want to kill me?" The mysterious giant beast suddenly spoke in human words.

Simultaneously, the giant beast opened its mouth and shot out its long purple-red tongue.

The tongue pierced a Mo clan Gu Immortal at astonishing speed. Almost instantly, the potent poison corroded the immortal into nothingness.

"A legendary immemorial beast?!" The surviving Mo clan Gu Immortal retreated in horrified panic.

The beast was Qing Chou; dense ghost qi surged around it, forming figures that slaughtered the remaining immortal.

"Pursue me?" Anger flashed across Qing Chou's face: "You two idiots don't even know you're being used. Die!"

With the monster driven off, Qing Chou's ghost qi intensified. Looking toward the sky, it sneered: "Two despicable worms, are you still not coming out?"

Heavenly Court's Nine Spiritual Fairy and Red Heart Traveler slowly showed themselves, floating side by side as they looked down at Qing Chou.

With their ambush exposed, the two Heavenly Court immortals attacked.

However, before long, a qi tide began to appear.

The dead Mo clan immortals' apertures had opened, absorbing heaven and earth qi to stabilize.

The difference in heaven and earth qi between the apertures and the outside world, combined with the clashes against Qing Chou, generated a massive qi tide.

The qi tide heavily suppressed Qing Chou, while the Heavenly Court immortals with phantom apertures remained unaffected.

Qing Chou roared and struggled in vain.

It realized Heavenly Court's deeper scheme: they had not only used the Western Desert immortals, but even factored their immortal apertures into the plan!

While Qing Chou fought bitterly, Peng Da shook his head and opened his eyes.

"Where am I?" After a dazed moment, he found Mo Li carrying him across a huge sand dune.

Mo Li sighed: "The hurricane swept us over ten thousand li away. We are heading back now."

Having lived in the desert for years, Mo Li easily navigated the directions.

Peng Da grew worried: "Uncle, you still want to return? You want to go back and die?!"

Mo Li fell silent before replying with deep resolve: "I know it's risky, but if I don't even see the killer of my wife and son, I will never rest easy!"

As they argued, the sand beneath Mo Li shifted into a huge whirlpool, sucking them both inside.

Peng Da tried to no avail, his face pale: "Is this quicksand? We are going to be sucked in!"

Mo Li sighed deeply: "I implicated you, Peng Da."

But soon, Peng Da's attention was caught by another thing.

He found that Uncle Mo Li, usually so strong-willed, was actually weeping.

Mo Li sobbed: "I am dying without avenging them! I am too weak—the gap between immortals and mortals is too vast. I am only an ant!"

Hot sand poured into Peng Da's mouth as he quickly closed it. Completely buried, his vision filled with darkness.

Suddenly, in his dark vision, there were specks of starlight.

"Huh? I didn't die?" Peng Da sat up, looking around in disbelief.

He was at the bottom of a dry well. The quicksand whirlpool continued rotating at the entrance, yet strangely, no sand fell down.

A mysterious force held back the quicksand whirlpool, allowing only Peng Da and Mo Li to enter.

"Uncle, uncle?" Peng Da spotted Mo Li, calling twice before getting a response.

"Kid, you're awake? We've struck gold!" Mo Li turned around, saying in shock and excitement: "This is likely a Gu Immortal's inheritance!"

Right then, the starlight moved like tidal waves, bypassing Mo Li and entering Peng Da's body.

Peng Da stood dazed like a statue, his eyes wide open.

Mo Li rushed over: "Peng Da, are you alright?"

Only then did Peng Da react: "Un... uncle, you were right, this is Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's true inheritance!"

"Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable?!" Mo Li was shaken. In these changing times, knowledge of venerables and the Gu Immortal world was no longer secret among mortals.

Mo Li murmured: "An otherworldly demon? No wonder the inheritance did not respond to me."

Mo Li waved his hand: "So what if you're an otherworldly demon? You're still the Peng Da I know, aren't you?"

Mo Li added: "You really struck it big this time. Since you inherited the Demon Venerable's inheritance, find the method to leave quickly. Ordinary methods are useless here."

Peng Da felt ashamed: "Uncle, though I have many Gu worms, I've never seen them before and need practice. According to the inheritance, I must use a killer move to leave here."

"Then practise it quickly, ask anything you don't understand, uncle will guide you!"

Over the next few days, Peng Da practiced relentlessly. As a mortal, the Gu worms he practiced with were all mortal Gu.

Mo Li guided his study, demonstrating how to activate the Gu worms.

Finally, Peng Da barely mastered several Gu worms and found a way to activate a killer move.

"Go on, Peng Da, try to succeed in one attempt!" Mo Li encouraged him.

"Watch this, uncle." Peng Da unleashed the killer move, but it failed.

Backlash from the failed killer move struck him; coughing blood, he collapsed to the ground.

"Peng Da, are you okay?" Mo Li quickly inspected him.

Peng Da wheezed: "I have disappointed you, uncle. But rest assured, I will definitely... ah!"

Mo Li's hand pierced his chest, destroying his heart in a sneak attack!

"Un... uncle..." Even more blood poured from Peng Da's mouth.

Mo Li raised his head slowly, eyes tearful and expression twisted, filling Peng Da with dread and alienation.

Mo Li rasped: "I want revenge! But the inheritance chose you, and you couldn't even master a killer move. Uncle cannot wait any longer; I cannot depend on you."

Mo Li then took out his hand.

Peng Da fell powerlessly to the ground, his eyes gazing helplessly at the well's entrance.

He was dead.

Without pausing, Mo Li activated his Gu worms and captured Peng Da's soul.

"The Thieving Heaven true inheritance is mine now." Mo Li laughed, a dazzling smile spreading across his blood-spattered face.

# Chapter 2017: Bai Ning Bing Versus Hei Lou Lan

Central Continent, on a certain nameless and ordinary peak.

Prepared, Hei Lou Lan shouted and thrust out her hands, unleashing a torrent of flames to counter the white light.

Immortal killer move — Bai Xiang!

Activating Bai Xiang, Bai Ning Bing shed flesh and blood, shrouding the peak in frost.

Hei Lou Lan retreated into the cave, and Bai Ning Bing pursued fearlessly.

Just as her strength waned and Bai Ning Bing closed in to capture her, a white light shot from the horizon.

Deceptively swift, the white light struck Bai Ning Bing before her Bai Xiang form could dodge.

Fairy Zi Wei acted quickly, casting a purple aurora over Bai Ning Bing to block Calamity Luck Altar's powerful light.

"I wondered who it was—turns out to be the leader of defeated Heavenly Court!" Bing Sai Chuan's voice boomed from Calamity Luck Altar.

Without another word, Bing Sai Chuan rammed Calamity Luck Altar toward Fairy Zi Wei.

Fairy Zi Wei called a halt: "No need to fight; there is no harm in giving Hei Lou Lan to you."

"We share a common objective. Fang Yuan is at his weakest; we can even cooperate—what do you think, Bing Sai Chuan?" Fairy Zi Wei proposed.

Bing Sai Chuan was silent before sighing: "Who would have thought there would be a day we cooperate!"

# Chapter 2018: Impending Fatal Calamity

Central Continent, deep beneath a certain Earth Trench.

Inside a cave flickering with purple light, Fairy Zi Wei operated a wisdom path formation with Old Man Zheng Yuan's assistance, using part of it to guard against Bing Sai Chuan.

At the edges of the formation, Bai Ning Bing, Hei Lou Lan, and Ying Wu Xie sat in several formation cores as crucial clues.

After a long while, Fairy Zi Wei opened her eyes and deactivated the immortal formation.

"How is it?" Bing Sai Chuan's question came from Calamity Luck Altar.

Fairy Zi Wei sighed: "Still not enough, but it works. With more of his subordinates captured, we can deduce Fang Yuan's exact location."

Bai Ning Bing smiled: "This is not difficult. During the fate war, Fang Yuan dispatched not only us, but also numerous transformation path Gu Immortals."

Ying Wu Xie shook his head: "Those transformation path Gu Immortals have weak connections to Fang Yuan. We should search for Lady White Rabbit and Fairy Miao Yin—they are second only to us in importance."

Fairy Zi Wei looked toward Calamity Luck Altar: "We should split our forces to search for White Rabbit and Miao Yin, capturing any other subordinates along the way."

Calamity Luck Altar picked up Hei Lou Lan while Bai Ning Bing and Ying Wu Xie stayed with Fairy Zi Wei; both sides departed separately.

Immemorial two heavens.

Crescent Moon grotto-heaven.

"Fairy Crescent Moon, you won't surrender even facing death?" Xiao He Jian, Lady Cold Ash, and the others looked down at the dying Gu Immortal in the ruins.

She spat with hatred: "You bandits! Crescent Moon grotto-heaven has never provoked the outside world nor harbored ambitions. I will never surrender to you!"

"Then die!" Growing impatient, Lady Cold Ash pointed her finger, shooting a grey light that struck Fairy Crescent Moon.

Lady Cold Ash withdrew her hand into her sleeve as the grey light brought Fairy Crescent Moon's soul to her.

"This is a rank eight Gu Immortal's soul; devouring it will be far more effective and easier to absorb." Lady Cold Ash was actually Spectral Soul, completely concealed from Wu Shuai's alliance.

Xiao He Jian looked at her: "Lady Cold Ash, Lord Alliance Leader specifically requested this rank eight soul. You cannot take it."

Spectral Soul was briefly stunned, then smiled and handed the rank eight soul to Xiao He Jian: "Since Alliance Leader wants it, how would I dare keep it?"

Xiao He Jian took the soul: "Let the others clean up. Follow me to report the battle to the alliance leader."

"I can finally get close to Wu Shuai. What a good chance!" Spectral Soul rejoiced.

However, arriving in Dragon Palace's hall, they saw only Wu Shuai's will on the main seat.

Hearing the report, Wu Shuai's will praised: "Lady Cold Ash, you contributed the most. Well done."

Leaving Dragon Palace, Spectral Soul felt discontented: "It is truly a pity that we could not see Alliance Leader."

Xiao He Jian glanced at her, feeling some disdain towards Lady Cold Ash's conduct in trying to flatter the alliance leader when they were not even in front of him: "How can Lord Alliance Leader be available whenever you want? He has been in closed cultivation to resolve the danger of the qi harvest fruits. We only need to follow his orders."

Seeing Qi Sea Ancestor on the main seat, Granny Skeleton bowed: "Skeleton grotto-heaven is willing to submit to Qi Sea Ancestor."

Qi Sea Ancestor laughed: "Granny Skeleton, you are wise. You will not regret joining me."

Granny Skeleton sighed: "I wonder when Lord Ancestor can resolve the qi harvest fruit problem?"

"I have already made progress; rest assured." Fang Yuan changed the topic: "Since Crescent Moon grotto-heaven has fallen to Wu Shuai, I wish to station Gu Immortals in Skeleton grotto-heaven."

Granny Skeleton sighed; though Fang Yuan had not proven he could resolve the qi harvest fruit danger, the external situation forced her to submit.

The pressure on Fang Yuan was also increasing.

"A formidable wisdom path great expert was just deducing me. It seems to be Fairy Zi Wei."

"According to my luck, the situation is grim. Calamity impends, danger lurks everywhere, and only a sliver of hope remains."

Though Cooking Luck Pot was only rank seven, Fang Yuan could inspect part of his luck to deduce the whole picture.

Fang Yuan had made progress regarding qi harvest fruits, but remained at his wits' end over refining heaven path dao marks.

His only hope rested on refining the heaven path dao marks. Recovering his strength in time was the sole way to survive the impending calamity.

"But where is this breakthrough point that I seek?"

# Chapter 2019: Rank Eight Hatred Gu

Western Desert.

The intense rank eight level battle was still continuing.

As the blood-red figures exploded, Red Heart Traveler paled, his fighting spirit unyielding as he strained to maintain the battlefield killer move.

"Fine! I can only use that move." Nine Spiritual Fairy gritted her teeth in resolve.

Immortal killer move — Nine Spiritual Transformations!

Her body shook as she reverted to human form, yet her aura surged far stronger than before. Nine spiritual lights shot from her immortal aperture to form an enormous nine-colored light barrier with nine distinct layers.

The multicolored light sphere transformed into a shining rhinoceros, charging toward Qing Chou.

Roaring, Qing Chou temporarily abandoned Red Heart Traveler and charged directly at the rhinoceros without dodging.

When the two enormous monsters collided, Qing Chou was forced a step back while the giant rhino was merely halted.

Red Heart Traveler spat a mouthful of fragrant blood; rotating like a miniature blood sun, it surged toward Qing Chou.

However, Qing Chou's defensive killer move proved useless. The blood sphere seemed illusory, passing straight through the obstruction to strike its chest and turn into a red sun insignia.

Qing Chou was bound entirely by blood threads, all originating from the blood sun insignia at the center of its chest.

"Success. Cough, cough, cough!" Red Heart Traveler coughed up mouthfuls of blood, his face paper-white.

Seeing Qing Chou bound like a mummy by blood threads, Nine Spiritual Fairy praised: "What method is this to actually capture Qing Chou!"

Red Heart Traveler smiled bitterly: "I only succeeded because its vital Gu is rank eight hatred Gu, and your transformation gave me the opening."

Nine Spiritual Fairy shook her head: "Capturing Qing Chou is vital for Heavenly Court to find Fang Yuan. But is this hatred Gu the one recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu?"

"Yes." Red Heart Traveler nodded.

Nine Spiritual Fairy sighed: "Now that we have captured it, we can extract hatred Gu and use Heavenly Court's killer move to locate Fang Yuan, Spectral Soul, and the other demons!"

Restraining his aura, Red Heart Traveler said: "Let's go, we can't stay long."

Exhausted from the long battle, Nine Spiritual Fairy and Red Heart Traveler detained Qing Chou and headed toward Central Continent.

Several days went by again.

Amidst a howling sandstorm, a Gu Master struggled through the desert.

Reaching the sand-buried battlefield craters, he raised his head and roared.

This person was Mo Li, who killed Peng Da and seized Thieving Heaven's true inheritance!

He had braved immense hardships to avenge his family, but he was too late.

Clutching Peng Da's soul, Mo Li activated his Gu worms; white smoke and sizzling sounds erupted where his hand made contact.

Screeching sharply in agony, Peng Da's soul cried out: "I'll talk, I'll talk! This is called electric circuit Gu."

"Electric circuit Gu? What is this thing?"

Peng Da's soul hesitated: "You aren't an otherworldly demon, so it's hard to explain. Simply put, it is the path that electric currents move along."

Mo Li sneered: "What is so hard to understand about it? It is not like I have not read The Legends of Ren Zu! The Legends of Ren Zu has recorded that lightning Gu chose to cooperate with Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance to find a way out, they eventually managed to leave immemorial blue heaven. This should be the true meaning behind electric circuit!"

Mo Li praised repeatedly: "Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable is truly worthy of being a venerable. He had such creative ideas, drawing inspiration from The Legends of Ren Zu to create electric circuit Gu!"

# Chapter 2020: Rank Nine Lightning Gu

Forest Lightning grotto-heaven.

Xiao He Jian looked down from above: "Forest Lightning Grotto Lord, you betrayed the two heavens alliance and colluded with Qi Sea Ancestor. This is an unforgivable crime punishable by death."

Forest Lightning Grotto Lord gave a bitter smile: "Since you found out, I don't have anything to say. But do you think I am willing to collude with the enemy? The alliance wants to experiment on the qi harvest fruit in my Forest Lightning grotto-heaven. Since that is the case, it is better to surrender to the enemy, I might even have some new hope."

Forest Lightning Grotto Lord chuckled: "If alliance leader Wu Shuai had a fair disposition, I would have nothing to say. But he is clearly protecting variant humans while sacrificing humans. The grotto-heavens the alliance has experimented on are all human grotto-heavens. Wu Shuai is a dragonman after all, I have seen through this alliance's farce! Human Gu Immortals present here, watch carefully, this will be your outcome in the future. After me, it will be your turn."

Glancing at Forest Lightning Grotto Lord, Xiao He Jian sneered impatiently: "Who will capture this criminal?"

Stepping forward as the vanguard, Lady Cold Ash volunteered: "Let me."

Xiao He Jian nodded: "Good."

Lady Cold Ash fought with Forest Lightning Grotto Lord, both were at rank eight and went at each other, neither yielding a step.

Soon, the first group of Gu Immortals sent underground returned covered in soot.

Upon hearing their report, Xiao He Jian was stunned: "Such a thing exists? A lightning forest deep underground?"

Using methods like shadow image Gu, the alliance's immortals viewed a vast lightning forest.

Silver lightning trees formed materialized thunder leaves and branches, tempting all the immortals.

"According to The Legends of Ren Zu, the source of a lightning forest is lightning Gu. A rank eight lightning Gu must be here!"

Xiao He Jian frowned: "Who will capture Forest Lightning Grotto Lord?"

Lady Cold Ash stood up once again without hesitation.

Xiao He Jian smiled pleasedly: "Cold Ash, if you succeed, you'll earn the top contribution for this battle."

"Wait," Night Heavenly Wolf Lord stepped forward. "The lightning forest is dangerous; let me accompany Cold Ash."

The two immortals charged into the underground depths while Xiao He Jian and the other Gu Immortals hovered in the air, watching and waiting.

Reaching the lightning forest at the bottom, Lady Cold Ash opened her immortal aperture and unleashed countless soul beasts.

Amid incessant lightning and explosions, the soul beasts suffered heavy casualties, trading their lives to pave a path.

After fighting their way to the center of the lightning forest, Lady Cold Ash and Night Heavenly Wolf Lord found Forest Lightning Grotto Lord once again.

Forest Lightning Grotto Lord was refining rank eight lightning Gu, but halted immediately upon seeing them. He shouted angrily: "Stop! Take one more step and I'll destroy this lightning Gu!"

"So lightning Gu is still wild, and Forest Lightning Grotto Lord hasn't refined it yet?"

Forest Lightning Grotto Lord kept on investing resources and finally advanced this wild lightning Gu to rank eight!"

"This is vital; we cannot act rashly," Xiao He Jian quickly transmitted to Lady Cold Ash and Night Heavenly Wolf Lord.

Lady Cold Ash and Night Heavenly Wolf Lord paused their attacks.

Forest Lightning Grotto Lord offered terms: "Spare me and Forest Lightning grotto-heaven, and I will hand over this lightning Gu."

# Chapter 2021: Blue Heaven Shatters

Receiving a reply soon after, Xiao He Jian flew underground to confront Forest Lightning Grotto Lord: "Alliance Leader agrees to spare you, but Forest Lightning grotto-heaven must belong to the alliance. We will not conduct risky experiments on its qi harvest fruit."

"No!" Forest Lightning Grotto Lord's attitude was extremely firm: "This grotto-heaven is my home, I will not give it up! It won't change owners, this is my territory, what qualifications does the alliance have to seize it? If the alliance wants rank nine lightning Gu, you can provide the resources to raise it in the lightning forest here."

# Chapter 2040: Qing Mouth

Above the clouds, in the sky.

Long ago, when Spectral Soul was young, before confronting Western Desert's Qing clan...

Unable to digest human bodies, the green claw ghost winged lion fed solely on souls.

"My immortal aperture is still with my physical remains, and my Gu are here... but soul path is useless. I still have food path!"

"That's right, didn't Ren Zu get eaten as well?"

# Chapter 2041: Bitter Taste, Swallow Loss

The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter five, section thirty-two.

As Ren Zu journeyed onward, a huge Predicament entered his vision.

Strong Gu laughed from inside the Predicament: "Oh human, I am back with help. Let's see what you can do!"

Ren Zu summoned hope Gu but the light of hope did not scare away this Predicament.

"Haha!" Strong Gu laughed: "With my help, this is the greatest Predicament you have ever met. How can mere hope defeat it?"

Strong Gu laughed: "Stop wasting your effort, human. With me guiding the Predicament, how can you deceive it? You should not have saved Weak Gu—weak people often jeer to conceal their inner frailty behind a ruthless demeanor."

Ren Zu asked strong Gu: "You say the strong eat the weak, but how do you prove you are strong and we are weak? On what basis may you eat us?"

Strong Gu smiled coldly: "I have a way to prove it! We will each eat a part of the other. Whoever cannot persevere loses, and the weak deserve to be eaten."

Seeing he could stall no longer, Ren Zu took the risk: "Then we will do that. Don't regret it! But which of us eats first?"

Ren Zu assessed the Predicament; in truth, he had never eaten one before.

After some thought, Ren Zu had an idea: "I will eat the Predicament's head first."

The Predicament removed its head and gave it to Ren Zu.

Ren Zu took just one bite before his face contorted, nearly vomiting: "So bitter!"

It turned out that this was a huge bitter head.

"Haha!" Strong Gu laughed. "Eating bitter heads resolves nothing. If you cannot even finish it, you are a weakling who deserves to be eaten!"

Frowning, Ren Zu opened his mouth and continued eating the bitter head.

Hope Gu encouraged him: "Grit your teeth, human. You must not only eat food, but also taste bitterness."

Courage Gu urged: "Human, do not fear bitterness. Suffering is only temporary; if you fear it, you will suffer for life."

With courage Gu's help, Ren Zu endured great hardship to finally finish the bitter head.

Ren Zu wiped his mouth, looking at strong Gu with difficulty: "Choose now."

Strong Gu smiled: "Then we will eat your skin first."

Ren Zu had to peel off his skin and throw it to the Predicament.

Headless, the Predicament stuffed Ren Zu's skin down its neck, consuming it completely.

Strong Gu asked again: "Human, what will you eat next?"

After long thought, Ren Zu finally had an idea and told strong Gu: "I will eat the part you least want me to eat."

Strong Gu snorted coldly: "Then you can eat some losses."

It removed all the losses from the Predicament's body, giving them to Ren Zu to eat.

With the losses removed, the huge Predicament shrank considerably.

Rules and regulation Gu explained: "Predicaments vary by person; having eaten such a huge bitter head, you have fewer losses to bear."

Ren Zu was delighted: "Great. Even eating all these losses will not reach my limit or fill my stomach completely."

Ren Zu opened his mouth and ate a small loss.

It was so spicy!

Most uncomfortably for Ren Zu, budding yellowish flames resembling chicks appeared and gathered in groups within his heart.

The burning resentment grew so agonizing that Ren Zu's multiple hearts were pushed to the verge of incineration.

Just then, the heart of nobleness grew in Ren Zu's chest.

Unlike the other hearts, the heart of nobleness could endure the flames of resentment, allowing Ren Zu to persevere.

Ren Zu ate all of the losses.

In the deep, eerie darkness, only Ming You's thoughts flickered faintly, radiating the light of hope near life's end.

Food path killer move — Bitter Taste!

Food path killer move — Swallow Loss!

The green claw ghost winged lion shook violently in midair and crashed toward the ground with a pitiful cry.

Unable to endure the immense bitterness, flames of resentment burned fiercely in its heart.

Knowing Ming You caused havoc in its stomach, it stabbed its claw into its belly without hesitation!

After a long struggle, it slowly fell still as its life force dissipated.

Through the torn hole, Ming You's soul drifted out like smoke with his immortal essence and Gu worms.

"I actually survived." Even he had not anticipated this outcome!

Gazing at the dark sky, the young Spectral Soul snorted coldly, then chuckled: "Pathetic, truly pathetic. But in this world... who does not struggle at death's door?"

In a weak yet resolutely firm voice, he shouted with all his might: "This is the last time I will struggle before death! From today on, only I shall make others struggle before death—let the five regions and two heavens bear witness!"

Returning to the present, his memories faded as the battlefield reappeared.

Rolling in midair, Qing Chou could bear it no longer and finally vomited out Spectral Soul.

Like a phantom, Spectral Soul moved rapidly onto Qing Chou's back.

His right fingers turned ink-black and his sharp white nails lengthened, radiating an icy, terrifying aura.

"Struggle all you want. Don't worry, I will not leave you the slightest hope of survival!"

Spectral Soul's eyes gleamed dark; his fingers stabbed with lightning speed.

Qing Chou shuddered as its surging strength was swiftly absorbed by Spectral Soul.

This brief clash was merely a microcosm of their battle, yet it displayed Spectral Soul's rich combat experience and broad vision. His flawless control of combat left even Fang Yuan feeling stifled.

Refusing to yield, Fang Yuan repaired Dragon Palace while ordering Qi Sea Ancestor to attack again.

Spectral Soul effortlessly multitasked: damaging Dragon Palace with black smoke, draining Qing Chou, and countering Qi Sea Ancestor.

Dragon Palace, Qing Chou, and Qi Sea Ancestor were three top-tier battle forces, yet even fighting on the same side, they could not turn the situation around!

Spectral Soul dominated because he hard-countered Qing Chou, suppressed Dragon Palace, and already understood Qi Sea Ancestor's capabilities.

"His soul path methods form a seamless combat system, whereas my Qi Sea clone has too few methods and is easily countered," Fang Yuan realized.

# Chapter 2085: Four Conditions to Become Venerable

Across three million years of history in this Gu world, only ten Gu cultivators stood at the apex, looking down upon all living beings.

They were the ten great venerables!

Standing at the apex with unparalleled might, these ten suppressed their respective eras without rival!

Fang Yuan felt more deeply toward them than anyone else in the world.

Fang Yuan knew the gap well; despite his pseudo venerable strength, he lacked confidence against a true venerable.

Frankly, Fang Yuan succeeded in the fate war only because he managed to survive sandwiched between heaven's will and the ten venerables' schemes.

Toward these venerables who used him as a pawn, Fang Yuan felt equal parts wariness and desire to rival them.

If they could become venerables, why couldn't Fang Yuan do it?

In his pursuit of eternal life, rank nine venerable cultivation was merely a stepping stone for Fang Yuan.

His plan to become a venerable was set the moment he was reborn!

But how could he become a venerable?

Fang Yuan knew accumulating resources alone could not make him a venerable; his primary purpose was uncovering the secret of venerable ascension. Paradise Earth's true inheritance and true meaning were mere secondary gains for the current Fang Yuan.

Sitting opposite him, Lu Wei Yin smiled and sipped his tea.

Setting down his teacup, he raised his head and held up three fingers: "There are four conditions to become a venerable."

"First, the Gu Immortal's immortal aperture origin core must produce white litchi immortal essence."

"Second, the Gu Immortal's main path must have at least three hundred thousand dao marks."

"Third, the Gu Immortal's main path attainment level must reach supreme grandmaster."

"Fourth, after meeting the first three conditions, the Gu Immortal must break through the Heavenly Dao blockade, triggering a qualitative change in their origin core to produce rank nine yellow apricot immortal essence."

Surprisingly, Lu Wei Yin revealed the secret of venerable ascension directly and candidly.

Lu Wei Yin's openness made Fang Yuan more alert rather than relaxed.

Fang Yuan carefully pondered the four conditions for venerable ascension.

"Passing three myriad tribulations satisfies the first two conditions. I already qualify in qi, time, refinement, and transformation paths."

"For the third condition, my refinement, time, and enslavement paths are already quasi-supreme, so the gap is small."

"As for the fourth condition, breaking through the Heavenly Dao blockade?"

Fang Yuan frowned slightly: "What does the Heavenly Dao blockade refer to?"

Lu Wei Yin explained: "The way of heaven takes away surpluses while replenishing deficits, balancing all things through mutual restriction. A tall tree is the first to face destruction; soil closest to the water is the first swept away by currents. The way of humans is the exact opposite: it reduces deficits and builds surpluses, devouring the weak and learning continuously to grow even stronger."

"The Heavenly Dao restricts Gu Immortals through calamities and tribulations. Before one becomes a venerable, it unleashes a tribulation far surpassing any myriad tribulation!"

"Then there is lifespan Gu, binding even invincible venerables, whose natural production continuously drops while a venerable is alive."

"The third blockade is Fate Gu, which you have already destroyed."

Fang Yuan pondered: "Of the three Heavenly Dao blockades, Fate Gu is destroyed and lifespan Gu is no immediate concern, leaving the tribulation blockade as my greatest hurdle."

"Is there a way to overcome the Heavenly Dao blockade? How did historical venerables bypass it?" Fang Yuan asked.

Lu Wei Yin answered: "Historical venerables' immense innate luck stemmed from two shortcuts: heaven's will and human path adoration."

"Three million years ago, when variant humans disrupted the balance, the Heavenly Dao countered them by favoring Primordial Origin with heaven's will, allowing him to become an Immortal Venerable."

"For human path adoration, tribulation struck at Red Lotus Demon Venerable's birth, forcing Heavenly Court's Three Dukes to shield him."

Fang Yuan raised his brows: "Could human path methods be used to break through the Heavenly Dao blockade?"

Having previously used human path methods to disrupt the Heavenly Dao and buy time, Fang Yuan was quite experienced in this aspect.

Lu Wei Yin nodded: "Indeed. All venerables drew inspiration from The Legends of Ren Zu to create top-tier human path methods."

After analyzing, he realized only two obstacles restricted him from becoming a venerable: attainment level and the Heavenly Dao blockade.

The blockade could be handled through Cooking Luck Pot and further-developed human path methods.

Quasi-supreme grandmaster seemed very close to genuine supreme grandmaster, but was actually extremely difficult to reach.

Yet the revival of venerables now cast a shadow over his future.

Dream realms?

Fang Yuan already knew Spectral Soul's dream realms could only grant great grandmaster attainment at most.

He wondered: "Did Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable leave his true meaning so my earth path could reach supreme grandmaster?"

Sensing his thoughts, Lu Wei Yin shook his head: "Lord Paradise Earth's true meaning only grants earth path great grandmaster. However, Paradise Earth's true inheritance holds the solution."

Looking at the smiling Lu Wei Yin, Fang Yuan's eyes flashed: "Oh, please do tell."

"Primordial Domain?" Fang Yuan was moved: "You know where it is."

Lu Wei Yin's eyes shone: "At the deepest layer of Crazed Demon Cave!"

# Chapter 2092: Wang Xiao Er's Amnesia

Sorrowful Wind Mountain Range.

Inside an ordinary cave, Central Continent's four great obscenities had gathered to rest.

The next day.

# Chapter 2106: Forcing A Rank Eight To Death

# Chapter 2109: Wu Shuai's Life In Danger

Though cultivating himself, Wu Shuai primarily managed the variant human alliance. How could he be in danger?

Worse, it was a fatal peril threatening his life!

Central Continent.

Before him lay a rank eight Gu Immortal true inheritance!

A long-slumbering will awakened and looked at him: "To obtain what my wife and I left behind, you must agree to one condition."

"What condition?" The elderly Gu Immortal squinted and asked.

The will sighed: "In my later years, I took in a traitorous disciple named Wu Shuai, who enslaved both me and my wife! If you want this true inheritance, you must shoulder the responsibility of taking revenge."
