"This is why I brought you here," Fang Di Chang said, sipping tea beside Shen Shang.

The man was a beast tamer, a profession newly emerged in the painting world after the ten children of human path recuperated from their expedition.

In the market, alongside hero Gu, scholar Gu, soldier Gu, and craftsman Gu, a new type appeared—beast tamer Gu!

"Who created this new Gu worm?" Shen Shang asked.

Fang Di Chang shook his head: "Beast tamer Gu appeared naturally; despite thorough investigation, I found no specific origins."

Shen Shang nodded: "Your Beggar Sect is the strongest intelligence organization here. It might not be a person, but the painting world itself or Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable's arrangement."

Shen Shang said: "There appear to be three human path Gu types. First are profession Gu, like craftsman Gu, hero Gu, and beast tamer Gu. Second are organizational position Gu, like beggar sect Gu. Third are human emotion and virtue Gu, like traveling son Gu and doting mother Gu."

Fang Di Chang remained silent, feeling increasingly worried.

"Developing human path seems to be Heavenly Court's main strategy! This path is not simple; what should my main body do? He might not even know yet, and as a barely surviving will, how can I inform him of this crucial information?"

Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace.

Hei Lou Lan was summoned by Immortal Zombie Giant Sun.

"Hei Lou Lan, my descendant, it is time to risk your life," Immortal Zombie Giant Sun got straight to the point. "You want to surpass Gu Yue Fang Yuan? Now is your chance! Enter Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven."

# Chapter 2112: Totem Killer Move

"Where... is this?" As her blurry vision cleared, she found herself lying on a stone bed.

"You're awake?" The tent flap was pulled aside.

The woman was clad simply in beast skin that exposed her shoulders and abdomen.

A vivid blue phoenix tattoo spanned her chest and back, glowing with faint blue light.

"I am Desolate Extremity Lu Tong Lan; you are inside Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven," the middle-aged woman smiled, approaching Hei Lou Lan.

"Lady Lu, what should I do?" Hei Lou Lan inquired. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun had instructed her to follow Desolate Extremity's orders upon arriving.

Lu Tong Lan smiled: "Here, call me Blue Phoenix Tribe Leader. Your identity is my illegitimate daughter whom I bore long ago and left outside, only recently finding and bringing you back during our tribe's relocation."

"Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven has countless tribes coexisting with beasts, vastly unlike the five regions. Every ten thousand years, all tribes gather for the Myriad Tribes Ceremony. This is your fortuitous encounter!"

"What is the point of drinking this soup?" Hei Lou Lan asked.

Lu Tong Lan answered: "Unlike the five regions, success here belongs to those who eat well. I prepared this soup to expand your appetite; the diarrhea is just your body adapting. Though severe and seemingly fatal at first, the symptoms will ease. Within three days, you will normalize and feel ravenous."

Lu Tong Lan soon began preparing soup for Hei Lou Lan. Lu Tong Lan tossed several rats into the boiling pot to prepare meat soup.

Upon finishing the soup, multicolored hair rapidly sprouted across Hei Lou Lan's body.

Next, at her command, the blue phoenix tattoo on her chest drifted up and spat a lump of blue fire.

The blue fire burned the hair, instantly incinerating all of Hei Lou Lan's newly grown hair.

Hei Lou Lan stared wide-eyed: "What method is this? It is truly amazing—I am completely unharmed."

Lu Tong Lan smiled: "This is my blue phoenix totem. In Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven, totems are the mainstream cultivation method; though we use Gu worms, totems symbolize our strength and status."

Hei Lou Lan's eyes shone brightly: "If I am not mistaken, each line of this totem is a dao mark! The totem's essence is a killer move! Does everyone here cultivate totems?"

Lu Tong Lan laughed: "You saw its essence at a glance. Standard killer moves employ Gu worms or expend materials. Totems operate similarly, using Gu worms to assist while consumption and digestion form the primary cultivation method."

"Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven is Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's immortal aperture, left inside the gluttonous demon frog to create a food path environment."

As a legendary immemorial beast, the gluttonous demon frog contained an unimaginable number of food path dao marks.

Humans here could consume Gu materials to gain dao marks, gradually constructing totems with local Gu worms.

"Totem killer moves hold great advantages: ordinary moves require activating Gu worms and expending thoughts in battle, whereas pre-constructed totems save immense time and effort!"

"Unlike Gu Houses, totems can be continuously improved without fixed limits," Lu Tong Lan explained.

Hei Lou Lan frowned: "I possess the Great Strength True Martial Physique and should cultivate strength path, but isn't this totem a transformation path killer move?"

"Totems suit all paths. I cultivate fire path, so I devoured materials to construct my blue phoenix fire path totem."

Hei Lou Lan cupped her fists solemnly: "Please teach me, senior."

Lu Tong Lan pointed at the empty pot: "That snake-rat soup identified which ingredients suit your physique best for natural absorption. As for your totem, it is unique to you; only you will know what it becomes."

Lu Tong Lan added with concern: "Hei Lou Lan, make haste to construct your totem. This killer move is the only method you can use in the Myriad Tribes Ceremony."

# Chapter 2113: Eating People

Hei Lou Lan cultivated while sitting on the stone bed.

Looking down at her chest, she saw a totem.

Though simplistic, the markings clearly depicted a small black cat.

"With the Gu worms Desolate Extremity lent me, the first form of my totem killer move is complete."

Suddenly, there was an argument outside the tent.

"We nominated you as leader, but your selfishness has let down the entire tribe's expectations!"

Lu Tong Lan's voice resounded: "Elders, no need to be angry. I do this for our tribe's sake. Lan, come out."

Hearing this, Hei Lou Lan finally left the tent she had stayed in for a month.

Outside the tent, a group of people confronted Lu Tong Lan.

Elderly Gu Immortals confronted Lu Tong Lan, their gazes locking onto Hei Lou Lan's chest.

"Can anyone confirm with me, is this the dark capital strength tiger?!"

Lu Tong Lan smiled: "Indeed, this is the dark capital strength tiger totem!"

The elders fell silent, shaking with agitation.

Lu Tong Lan continued: "Since my daughter bears the dark capital strength tiger totem, you surely understand she has the sacred physique! Only the sacred physique can cultivate it."

"The sacred physique allows one to directly advance in the Myriad Tribes Ceremony and challenge the Predicament!" An elder stared at Hei Lou Lan with heated excitement.

"Sacred physique? My Great Strength True Martial Physique?" Hei Lou Lan calmed down, knowing the situation remained firmly within Lu Tong Lan's control.

Lu Tong Lan bowed: "Please help improve Lan's totem with all your effort. Our whole tribe will benefit."

Hei Lou Lan also understood Immortal Zombie Giant Sun sent her here because the Great Strength True Martial Physique was invaluable in Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven.

She continued cultivating her totem killer move.

Hei Lou Lan's totem soon grew from a small cat into a black leopard.

Despite immense immortal material expenditure, the dark capital strength tiger totem possessed incredible power, far surpassing her previous methods.

"This is not enough!" Lu Tong Lan said candidly after cultivating. "Since our lord sent you here, I will do my utmost to nurture you and not let him down! Those elders withheld their inventory, and I have few resources left. Don't worry, the situation will change in a few days."

Several days later, mortal enemy Fire Blend Tribe attacked Blue Phoenix Tribe, forcing them to flee the valley after heavy losses.

Lu Tong Lan led Hei Lou Lan away from the gathering point to a valley cave to meet Fire Blend Tribe Leader.

Looking at the shocked Hei Lou Lan, Fire Blend Tribe Leader smiled: "I am Yellow Extremity Jiao Huo."

It turned out that this situation was just Lu Tong Lan's and Jiao Huo's performance.

Jiao Huo handed over materials: "These are all the Gu materials suitable for Hei Lou Lan."

"Other than that, we have these..." With a strange expression, Jiao Huo brought out several corpses.

Lu Tong Lan also brought out several corpses sacrificed from Blue Phoenix Tribe.

Before Hei Lou Lan, Jiao Huo carved the meat while Lu Tong Lan prepared the pot and flame.

Hei Lou Lan was stunned: "You want me to eat these people?!"

Slicing the flesh, Jiao Huo smiled: "Treat them as immortal materials. Normally, a dead Gu Immortal's dao marks return to their aperture. But here, apertures are digested by the grotto-heaven upon death, leaving their dao mark totems fixed in the body as prime materials."

Saying so, Jiao Huo picked several pieces of meat from the pile and tossed them into the pot.

Stirring the soup, Lu Tong Lan said: "Hei Lou Lan, few pieces suit you, but being human makes them easier to absorb, greatly aiding your totem's growth!"

Hei Lou Lan paled, her voice shaking slightly: "Is eating people common in Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven?"

Looking at the meat soup in the pot, Lu Tong Lan said calmly: "Of course not. Even though eating people aids totem growth, it is still demonic. Publicly consuming tribesmen marks you as a demonic path member who must face judgment. There is no helping it, we have little time, to raise your strength to the limit, eating humans is the best way."

"It's cooked, go ahead and eat."

The meat soup was far more delicious than any food she had eaten before, but after the first mouthful, Hei Lou Lan vomited violently.

Vomiting until stomach acid came up, Hei Lou Lan asked: "Have you two eaten human flesh as well?"

Lu Tong Lan shook her head, but Jiao Huo nodded: "I arrived first. Eventually, my outsider identity was exposed and I was hunted down. All of my rations were consumed, I fell into desperation and had to eat people to raise the power of my totem killer move. Relying on that, I managed to survive and change my identity, eventually becoming the current Fire Blend Tribe Leader."

Lu Tong Lan said calmly: "Hei Lou Lan, you can choose not to eat. We will not force you; we only wish to fulfill master's task to our utmost ability. I have not eaten human flesh before, I can understand why you reject it. This is only a method to become stronger, you can also eat other ingredients to help your totem grow, it will only take more time."

Hei Lou Lan smiled bitterly, muttering: "The chasm between us is vast. If I don't seize every moment, how can I ever surpass him? What would he do in my place? Would he eat it?"

"I'll eat it." Hei Lou Lan approached the pot with a solemn expression.

She gulped down the soup and devoured the meat in huge mouthfuls!

Lu Tong Lan's expression changed while Jiao Huo nodded slightly.

Such a person... no wonder their lord held her in such high regard!

# Chapter 2114: Hei Lou Lan, You Are Too Ugly

The myriad tribes were gathered on Moon Field Slope.

The slope appeared bleak and desolate, with yellow sand churning in the wind.

"The Myriad Tribes Ceremony involves all tribes once every ten thousand years," explained Blue Phoenix Tribe Leader, Desolate Extremity Lu Tong Lan.

The clash with Fire Blend Tribe six months prior had allowed Lu Tong Lan to consolidate control over her tribe.

Hei Lou Lan's fame had already spread; her Sacred Child identity was far too conspicuous.

"Hmph!" Fire Blend Tribe Leader grunted coldly, glaring furiously at Lu Tong Lan, Hei Lou Lan, and their entourage.

"Blue Phoenix Tribe Leader, you came too slowly, are you afraid?" Jiao Huo asked arrogantly.

"Tribe leaders, the ceremony is about to begin. Anyone who fights will become an enemy of all tribes and be used as tribute," warned an approaching elder from a large tribe.

Jiao Huo snorted, tossing Lu Tong Lan a parting remark: "I'll spare you for now."

"Fire Blend Tribe Leader lost strength six months ago, but be careful—he has joined Yellow Bell Tribe."

"Yellow Bell Tribe is a super tribe; both its leader and first elder possess rank eight cultivation!"

Hei Lou Lan listened quietly, gaining a deeper understanding of Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven.

"The situation here mirrors the five regions; weaker forces must still attach themselves to larger powers. As two of the Eight Extremities, Lu Tong Lan and Jiao Huo excel among rank sevens even using totem killer moves, naturally drawing followers around them."

Days later, the Myriad Tribes Ceremony began.

"In the name of Great God Reckless Savage, Yellow Bell Tribe offers a vast heavenly sparrow group, ten sight plundering vines, and one outsider as tribute!"

At the central field, tribes took turns slaughtering and offering their sacrificial tokens.

The executed outsiders were at least rank seven, with Yellow Bell Tribe executing a rank eight.

Whether desolate beasts or Gu Immortal corpses, upon touching the yellow soil, they melted like candles and were absorbed into the earth.

"Moon Field Slope contains a huge secret; it is definitely not simple!" Hei Lou Lan thought, watching bloodstained earth absorb the sacrifices and slowly revert to yellow.

On the night of the ceremony, there was a large bonfire celebration.

Leather drums thundered beside thousands of bonfires as people in beast skins and feathers danced around the flames.

Though unconcerned with appearance, Hei Lou Lan was inherently a great beauty.

The locals worshipped muscular builds and rough, dark skin that radiated strength and power rather than pale smoothness.

Thus, in this place, Hei Lou Lan was considered a once-in-a-century ugly woman.

The locals considered her ugly, thinking Blue Phoenix Tribe Leader had abandoned her for her looks despite her sacred physique.

The Myriad Tribes Competition started!

"I, Blue Phoenix Tribe Leader, challenge Stardust Tribe Leader, wagering a divine peacock feather." Lu Tong Lan brought Hei Lou Lan to Stardust Tribe.

"It seems Blue Phoenix Tribe Leader is after my five emperor eel's white thread tendon." Stardust Tribe Leader smiled bitterly, stepping into the arena.

"Begin." Lu Tong Lan poured in immortal essence; her radiant blue phoenix totem solidified and flew toward Stardust Tribe Leader.

Stardust Tribe Leader gritted his teeth and shouted, his totem ascending as a single-horned mountain goat.

The blue phoenix dodged as it chirped, spitting out a torrent of blue flames.

Watching from the side, Hei Lou Lan realized: "Lu Tong Lan has a stronger totem, but the decisive factor is their difference in combat attainment."

Before long, Stardust Tribe Leader conceded: "As expected of Blue Phoenix Tribe Leader. Sigh, I admit defeat."

Stardust Tribe Leader arranged for the white thread tendon to be surrendered.

# Chapter 2115: Lou Lan Fights a Predicament

With Desolate Extremity Lu Tong Lan's full support, Hei Lou Lan resumed devouring massive amounts of immortal materials.

After digesting them, her totem finally reached greater success!

"Good, your dark capital strength tiger totem has fully formed, making you a peak rank seven expert," Lu Tong Lan said joyfully. "Now you can test it."

The Myriad Tribes Ceremony had reached a cruel stage of the competition.

Chillingly, any Gu Immortal who died during the ceremony was sacrificed on the spot, sinking into the yellow soil.

When three rank eight Gu Immortals died on Moon Field Slope, the yellow soil began glowing faintly.

In this yellow light, a road slowly appeared before them.

"Myriad Life Road has appeared!"

"Only recognized experts may enter Myriad Life Road to seek Great God Reckless Savage's immortal opportunities!"

Hei Lou Lan realized: "So all the sacrifices were meant to open this Myriad Life Road."

Possessing the sacred physique, she bypassed testing and was qualified to enter Myriad Life Road immediately.

After the tribes discussed among themselves, they chose eighty-eight people.

Under countless envious gazes, eighty-eight people stepped onto the Myriad Life Road.

"It feels like there is really a road, I can step on it firmly." Hei Lou Lan walked for over ten steps, her expression changed gradually.

"Every step on Myriad Life Road expends strength, will, and immortal essence," Hei Lou Lan said.

Lu Tong Lan added: "More accurately, our foundation and strength are depleted at a fixed proportion."

The road was fair, imposing the same difficulty upon all.

Hei Lou Lan observed closely and soon found something strange.

"The road slopes up and down. Going up offers Gu worms and materials, while going down yields no rewards but expends less strength." Hei Lou Lan gasped in shock: "Strange, this feels just like the tale in The Legends of Ren Zu!"

She looked at Lu Tong Lan, who smiled: "You are right, this is Upslope Road and Downslope Road."

Her eyes shone brightly: "Does that mean I can obtain the legendary ability Gu and effort Gu here?"

Lu Tong Lan replied: "That depends on your fortune. If those Gu worms truly exist here, they should be near the end of the heavenly road."

Hei Lou Lan made up her mind: "I cannot let this opportunity slip! The Gu worms in The Legends of Ren Zu are all top-tier, boasting terrifying strength or miraculous abilities. Ancestor Giant Sun was right, I need to make the best of this supreme opportunity to have a chance of surpassing that guy, Fang Yuan!"

They found numerous Gu worms and materials on the Upslope Road, though most were only mortal rank.

Soon they began finding immortal materials, whereas Gu Immortals taking the Downslope Road received far fewer rewards over the same distance.

Hei Lou Lan realized: "The road measures the quality of travel rather than distance. It only tests whether we give our full effort. By putting in my full effort, I have a chance of making desirable gains. But if I slack off and take the easy path, I might consume all my strength without gaining anything significant."

Lu Tong Lan and Hei Lou Lan continued ahead.

When they found the first rank six Immortal Gu, the first Predicament also appeared.

The Predicament blocking their path was light brown, resembling a mountain-sized raccoon.

"A Predicament, recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu! Though extinct in the five regions, finding it on this heavenly road is hardly strange."

Taking a deep breath, Hei Lou Lan joined Lu Tong Lan to attack the Predicament.

Their vision blurred as they arrived in a light-brown secluded space.

"We've been eaten; we are inside the Predicament," Lu Tong Lan said immediately.

Each Predicament functioned as a natural battlefield killer move.

Within the Predicament, calamities and tribulations formed and descended.

Lu Tong Lan took the lead: "I'll block the tribulations—Hei Lou Lan, break out of the Predicament!"

Hei Lou Lan was stunned: "What should I do?"

"With the Great Strength True Martial Physique, The Legends of Ren Zu says you counter Predicaments! Try whatever you can—tribulations here are unceasing!" Lu Tong Lan urged.

"Dark capital strength tiger, come forth!" Hei Lou Lan willed, expending vast amounts of rank seven immortal essence.

Amid surging black light, the massive black tiger solidified and charged ahead.

With a loud sound, a huge hole was formed.

"Let's go!" Hei Lou Lan and Lu Tong Lan flew out through the hole together.

# Chapter 2116: Fortitude Gu

Without pursuing, Hei Lou Lan picked up the rank six Immortal Gu and continued ahead with Lu Tong Lan.

Pushing up the Upslope Road with all their effort, their rewards grew ever greater.

A while later, they obtained two rank six Immortal Gu and one rank seven Immortal Gu.

Hei Lou Lan felt more difficulty as she walked.

After defeating two more Predicaments, she found only thirty-odd people remained from the eighty-eight.

"My strength is heavily depleted, and the Predicaments are growing stronger. I only have enough battle strength for one more," Hei Lou Lan thought, gritting her teeth unwillingly.

"Don't worry, I have a way. Let's continue," Lu Tong Lan said optimistically, patting Hei Lou Lan's shoulder.

Facing the next Predicament, Lu Tong Lan joined her blue phoenix totem with the dark capital strength tiger to defeat it.

"Eat it." Lu Tong Lan cut the Predicament's flesh and gave Hei Lou Lan a piece.

With each piece eaten, Hei Lou Lan felt her strength return. After devouring the entire Predicament with Lu Tong Lan, her strength was mostly restored.

"Do not overeat Predicament flesh, or your heart will burn and your mind will collapse," Lu Tong Lan sighed. "Let's continue."

A few minutes later, Jiao Huo caught up with them.

"What do you want?" Lu Tong Lan called out, feigning displeasure.

Jiao Huo snorted coldly: "Only seven of us remain—we must cooperate, of course. Scores can be settled outside; here, we must heed the big picture!"

"Leader Jiao Huo is right; the Predicaments grow stronger, so we must cooperate," Yellow Bell Tribe Leader arrived and said, looking at Hei Lou Lan. "Sacred Child, you are qualified to fight alongside us."

Looking at the others, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader asked: "Reaching this far proves everyone is qualified to cooperate. What do you think?"

Of the seven remaining, one was rank six, four were rank seven, and two were rank eight.

"But how do we distribute Immortal Gu and immortal materials?" The rank six Gu Immortal asked the crucial question.

Yellow Bell Tribe Leader said: "No need to fight over Immortal Gu and materials—we can take turns, but anyone violating the rules becomes everyone's enemy. The Myriad Life Road only appears once every ten thousand years, whoever disobeys the rules will face the pursuit of everyone!"

"Okay." The other rank eight Gu Immortal agreed.

After pondering briefly, they decided the sequence and continued on.

Defeating two Predicaments revealed the first rank eight Immortal Gu!

By the sequence, it belonged to the rank six Gu Immortal.

Under everyone's gaze, the rank six Gu Immortal nervously collected the Immortal Gu.

"Everyone, I can't continue. Please understand—I'm not trying to leave just after receiving my reward!" After walking a while, the rank six Gu Immortal said, pale and trembling.

Yellow Bell Tribe Leader nodded: "Go back, at this rate, you will die of exhaustion."

Bowing deeply, the rank six Gu Immortal descended toward the ground.

After the rank six Gu Immortal left, the trend started as people also reached their limits. First was the other rank eight Gu Immortal, followed by Lu Tong Lan.

Also at her limit, Lu Tong Lan urged Hei Lou Lan to be careful before departing.

Only four remained: Hei Lou Lan, Jiao Huo, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader, and a young rank seven Gu Immortal.

"What Gu is this?" Everyone's eyes lit up.

They saw an extraordinary rank eight Immortal Gu shaped like a fist-sized ant, radiating rainbow-colored light.

"This is quantity change Gu!" Yellow Bell Tribe Leader laughed heartily; it was his turn.

However, they had to defeat this Predicament to claim the Immortal Gu.

After an intense battle, they triumphed and shared the meat.

Climbing the Upslope Road, a rank eight Immortal Gu appeared.

A rhinoceros beetle resembling a steel ingot, it was stoutly built and heavily armored.

"This is actually... fortitude Gu!!"

Shocked, everyone looked toward the rank seven Gu Immortal; by the sequence, it was his turn.

After an intense battle, the Predicament cried out pitifully and collapsed.

Dividing the meat, the rank seven Gu Immortal claimed fortitude Gu.

But Jiao Huo rejected the Predicament's flesh.

"I can't eat any more, I'm at my limit. Eating more will burn my heart to death." Jiao Huo sighed, looking deeply at Hei Lou Lan before departing.

Only Hei Lou Lan, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader, and the rank seven Gu Immortal remained.

Hei Lou Lan had chosen her reward earlier; with Jiao Huo gone, the sequence returned to Yellow Bell Tribe Leader.

Soon, another rank eight Immortal Gu appeared.

This Immortal Gu resembled an elongated spider with numerous compound eyes, sparkling in blue and red crystal lights like fused ruby and sapphire.

"Ability Gu! Another famous Immortal Gu from The Legends of Ren Zu!" Hei Lou Lan was tongue-tied.

"Kill this Predicament! I'll stake my life to kill it!!" Yellow Bell Tribe Leader gasped, eyes bloodshot.

# Chapter 2117: Ability Gu

Hei Lou Lan's dark capital strength tiger totem was crippled, while Yellow Bell Tribe Leader's golden bell totem was severely damaged, requiring an immense repair cost. The rank seven Gu Immortal's rain eagle and thunder fish totems were both disabled, but fortunately he possessed a method to fuse them into the thunder rain fish eagle totem.

After a fifteen-minute stalemate, the three immortals risked their lives and finally slew the Predicament.

Lying on the ground without strength even to laugh, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader coughed: "Ability Gu is mine! You two are skilled; whether you join my Yellow Bell Tribe or not, I owe you both a favor. What are you doing?!"

"What else? I am snatching the Gu." The rank seven Gu Immortal stored ability Gu into his aperture right in front of Yellow Bell Tribe Leader.

Coughing up blood, Yellow Bell Tribe Leader fell unconscious and plunged from the heavenly road.

Hei Lou Lan gritted her teeth in anger: "I was just a step away, damn it!"

"I lack the strength to continue." Hei Lou Lan sighed deeply; despite great gains from this trip, she had obtained no top-tier Immortal Gu.

Just as she was about to leave, she suddenly froze—her palm had brushed against something.

"It feels like... an invisible Gu worm?"

Hei Lou Lan focused intently; having touched the Immortal Gu, she could sense its strength path aura.

"An invisible rank eight Immortal Gu? What could it be? Don't tell me..." Overjoyed, Hei Lou Lan seized the mysterious Immortal Gu and departed the heavenly road.

The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter five, section thirty-four —

Legend says Ren Zu encountered the greatest Predicament of his life, creating his seventh child, Great Strength True Martial, and was saved as a result.

Ren Zu patted Great Strength True Martial's head, consoling him: "Don't worry, I have a way. I will use self Gu to gain strength and wisdom, then obtain freedom Gu to break free from fate Gu's control. Now, let us go to a place called Qian Kun Crystal Wall, we will search for wisdom Gu there."

Great Strength True Martial squatted down and searched the ground; as expected, he felt something hard—an invisible Gu.

"I found something good." Great Strength True Martial laughed: "It's effort Gu."

Ren Zu asked curiously: "Is effort Gu really so amazing? Can it bring you success?"

Great Strength True Martial shook his head: "Effort may not guarantee success, but it always yields results. Regardless of the outcome, whether you put in effort makes a difference."

Climbing higher along the Upslope Road, Great Strength True Martial obtained authority Gu and fortitude Gu.

As Great Strength True Martial walked the Upslope Road, an ability Gu suddenly appeared within him.

Holding ability Gu, Great Strength True Martial said to Ren Zu: "Look father, this is the result of effort Gu. It awakened my potential—I have my own ability now!"

Great Strength True Martial killed many Predicaments and began eating their heads.

"So this is a bitter head? It is truly bitter, but I feel myself getting stronger."

He started to eat the Predicament's loss.

Great Strength True Martial immediately spat it out: "Experts do not like to swallow losses."

Several days later, in Eastern Sea.

Fang Yuan looked at the two rank eight Immortal Gu in his hands: fortitude Gu and ability Gu!

"Zhan Bu Du did well this time; this is a great harvest for us." Fang Yuan was thoroughly pleased.

Following the fate war, Fang Yuan had immediately sent Zhan Bu Du into Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven.

"Fortitude Gu is useful to me, and ability Gu holds great future prospects. As for Hei Lou Lan, she joined Longevity Heaven and seemingly receives substantial support. It is a pity that Zhan Bu Du did not have the strength to kill her at that point in time." Fang Yuan did not feel much pity about this.

Hei Lou Lan was unimportant; the key was Crazed Demon Cave and the impending clash between venerables!

# Chapter 2118: Wisdom Path Great Grandmaster

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Meng Qiu Zhen was exploring another dream realm.

Deep in the mountains, Meng Qiu Zhen sat cross-legged on a cliff above a roaring waterfall.

"Immortal, immortal!" An injured young man crawled toward him, begging to be taken as a disciple.

Activating dream butterfly Immortal Gu to investigate, Meng Qiu Zhen stalled: "Reaching me proves our affinity. I have three cultivation paths and will impart one to you."

Hearing the descriptions, the young man was overwhelmed with excitement: "Lord immortal, lord immortal! I wish to learn wisdom path, please teach me!"

"Whatever I impart, this disciple will master and even innovate beyond me, while also cultivating incredible wisdom path secondary methods."

"Thus, this first scene is the crucial chance to weaken him!" Meng Qiu Zhen realized.

Meng Qiu Zhen smiled: "Then I shall impart my modified wisdom path method: the Nine-Nine Multiplication Table."

Not long after, at the final scene.

Meng Qiu Zhen showed no mercy, unleashing his killer move directly at the disciple.

Constantly interrupted, the disciple could not utter 'master' one final time.

Constantly suppressed, the disciple was forced to abandon his strongest raging emotion move and resort to the Nine-Nine Multiplication Table method instead.

Immortal killer move — Eight Times Eight Is Eighty-Eight!

The moment he activated the killer move, it failed, inflicting severe backlash injuries.

"This killer move is flawed! Master, did you..." The disciple stared at Meng Qiu Zhen in disbelief.

"My foolish disciple, the true name of this move is Eight Times Eight Is Sixty-Six!" Meng Qiu Zhen sneered coldly, attacking viciously.

The disciple lasted only a few rounds before being decapitated, dying with deep grievance.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan's main body was comprehending killer moves now.

"In this aspect, totem killer moves are closest to the original form of killer moves," Fang Yuan praised internally.

"These venerables possess unimaginable talent. Though Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's personality was unexpected, his scheming abilities are top-notch."

Originally, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's grotto-heaven contained only strength and transformation path dao marks.

Yet as Fang Yuan learned from Old Eccentric Tian Nan's true inheritance, Reckless Savage turned the beastmen's methods against them, fusing his aperture into the gluttonous demon frog's body.

As a legendary immemorial food path beast enveloping the aperture, the gluttonous demon frog paired with Reckless Savage's methods developed a food path environment across Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven.

Thanks to these food path dao marks, local cultivators with low food path attainment could use refinement path cooking to prepare meals that cultivated totem killer moves.

"Hmm?" Fang Yuan's expression shifted slightly as his thoughts were momentarily interrupted.

"My wisdom path reached great grandmaster attainment level." Sensing the change immediately, his expression remained tranquil and peaceful.

# Chapter 2119: Li Xiao Bai's Immortal Ascension

Setting aside his wisdom path attainment, Fang Yuan promptly resumed his comprehension.

"Both Reckless Savage and Paradise Earth understood food path deeply. In this aspect, Reckless Savage was inferior to Paradise Earth, having merely utilized the gluttonous demon frog. But the way he used the food path environment to create the totem killer move archetype is truly too amazing." Even Fang Yuan could not stint on the praise towards such a move.

"These totem killer moves are of little help to me, but their recipes hold immense reference value!"

Fang Yuan already possessed Shadow Sect's food path true inheritance, the original progenitor of food path in the world. Recently, he had also acquired Paradise Earth's true inheritance from Southern Border, gaining various food path killer moves and tea recipes that increased a cultivator's dao marks.

"I once thought food path excelled primarily at feeding Gu and easing a cultivator's burden. But that is merely one aspect—its true power lies in granting additional dao marks to elevate one's foundation!"

With his wisdom path deductions elevated to great grandmaster level, Fang Yuan could deduce various food path killer moves from these recipes alone.

Possessing abundant immortal materials, expending them on food path killer moves for his sovereign immortal body would yield a vast quantity of dao marks.

Fang Yuan calculated: "Annexing grotto-heavens yields millions of dao marks at once, but with the sovereign aperture near peak capacity and its ecological balance precarious, continuing would cause disastrous losses."

"Though food path killer moves provide modest gains per attempt, repeated use will accumulate a huge amount of dao marks."

"To prepare for Crazed Demon Cave, I also need to develop food path defenses against Spectral Soul Demon Venerable."

Spectral Soul's killer moves, bitter taste and swallow loss, had deeply impressed Fang Yuan.

His adversaries in Crazed Demon Cave would be Star Constellation and Spectral Soul. Spectral Soul far surpassed him in food path, while Star Constellation would hardly falter against it.

"Against such foes, food path is merely secondary and unfit for the main stage. Yet developing defenses is essential so I won't be disadvantaged against Spectral Soul again."

With this in mind, Fang Yuan tasked his time path clone with refining another batch of Immortal Gu.

With the pool's terrifying success rate, vast stockpiles of materials, and abundant essence, nothing could stop Fang Yuan from mass-refining rank eight Gu.

"Rather than rebuilding Immortal Gu Houses, I should design new ones centered around my combat system."

"To face venerables, I need an outstanding combat system. Unfortunately, with Duke Long dead and Demon Immortal Qi Jue sealed, I lack sparring grindstones to hone it."

Fang Yuan's most mature combat systems were sword and time path; with rank eight fortitude Gu and ability Gu, he could now build a strength path system.

Cooking Luck Pot started to vibrate.

"Oh?" Fang Yuan looked up to inspect his luck and that of his clones.

Numerous small grey clouds gathered over his silver-white pillar of light.

Observing closely, Fang Yuan traced these external clouds to Li Xiao Bai.

Fang Yuan deduced: "Li Xiao Bai is undergoing immortal ascension. Judging by his fluctuating luck, he will encounter a small problem. But why does it involve my main body so heavily?"

Profound Literature grotto-heaven.

Dressed in white, Li Xiao Bai hovered midair, enveloped in a dense three-qi cocoon.

A pale green lightning ball trailed down from dark clouds toward Li Xiao Bai.

"Li Xiao Bai is actually balancing the three qi while handling the tribulation with ease!" Far away, a young-looking man watched with eerie eyes, gritting his teeth.

"If you become an immortal, I, Du Zhi Xiao, will never make it big. Blame your own brilliance, Li Xiao Bai—sharing an era with you is a curse for every side character!"

Du Zhi Xiao muttered as he unleashed a wave of grey smoke.

The grey smoke drifted into the tribulation cloud, stirring violent turmoil that shot out three pale green lightning balls in response.

# Chapter 2120: From Today Onwards, You Are The Poet Immortal!

Seeing the tribulation lightning about to strike Li Xiao Bai, Su Qi Han flew skyward.

"Sigh, this foolish daughter." A figure suddenly appeared, stopping Su Qi Han.

Recognizing the newcomer, Su Qi Han cried out in joyful surprise: "Father!"

He was the imperial court's Minister Su, a rank seven Gu Immortal of Profound Literature grotto-heaven.

"Li Xiao Bai is my son-in-law; why would I let him die? Just watch patiently—do not cause trouble." Imperial Minister Su consoled Su Qi Han, sighing inwardly.

Imperial Minister Su sighed deeply, waving his robe, a bright rainbow shot out, blocking the three pale green lightning balls.

The masked Gu Immortal charged towards Imperial Minister Su.

Forced to fight, Imperial Minister Su showed anger: "Come! Which of my political enemies are you, to possess such methods?"

As tribulation lightning struck again, Li Xiao Bai used his killer move to create a poem wall.

The lightning broke the poem wall, but most of its might was blocked; only pale green fire remained, burning Li Xiao Bai's body.

At the crucial moment, Li Xiao Bai pushed his hand out of the cocoon and waved at Su Qi Han: "Don't be rash. Amidst this mortal danger, inspiration has struck—I feel the urge to recite a poem."

Everyone listened attentively as Li Xiao Bai recited:

Under the pine trees I ask of a disciple, he replies, his master had gone to gather herbs.

Somewhere in the mountain he was for certain, within the dense clouds, his figure is hidden.

A chain of black characters flew from Li Xiao Bai's mouth, revolving around him.

The smoke completely absorbed the pale green fire on Li Xiao Bai's body.

"Ahhhh!" Du Zhi Xiao screamed madly as grey smoke appeared from his body again.

Simultaneously, Du Zhi Xiao aged from a young man into a middle-aged one.

Spotting the grey smoke floating into the air, Imperial Minister Su realized: "You are the culprit? Du Zhi Xiao, the former number one scholar, to think you would act so despicably!"

Tied down by the masked Gu Immortal, Imperial Minister Su watched helplessly as the grey smoke entered the tribulation cloud.

The tribulation's power rose again, three pale lightning balls shot towards Li Xiao Bai.

Li Xiao Bai waved his hand again: "Amidst this danger, inspiration has struck again—I feel the urge to recite another poem."

Unable to resist the tribulation alone, he had to rely on Profound Literature grotto-heaven's killer move that assisted literary talents.

Thus, Li Xiao Bai recited again:

Over a thousand hills with no birds in flight, the myriad paths had not one footprint in sight.

A straw hat man sits in a small lone boat, fishing alone in the cold frozen moat.

Upon recitation, the tribulation lightning dispersed with astounding efficacy!

Du Zhi Xiao summoned grey smoke again, aging from a middle-aged man into an elder.

"Is there really a point to this?" Li Xiao Bai thought in distress. "Must I recite yet another poem?"

"I really can't do anything about you. Fine, I'll recite!" Li Xiao Bai looked helplessly at the grounded Du Zhi Xiao.

The sun beyond the mountain glows, the Yellow River seawards flows.

One can enjoy a grander sight, by climbing to a greater height.

With the crisis resolved, the tribulation clouds dispersed. Li Xiao Bai's three qi exploded into an immortal aperture, making him an information path Gu Immortal!

"Oh heaven, since you created me, why create Li Xiao Bai?!" Du Zhi Xiao cried in anguish, drawing his final breath filled with grief, anger, helplessness, and hatred.

"From today onwards, you are Poet Immortal Li Xiao Bai!" Imperial Minister Su flew over with a complex expression.

He sighed: "The younger generation will surpass us; I underestimated you. I wanted to make you an official, but your aspirations surpass mine. From today onwards, roam the world as you please—just do not let down my daughter."

Li Xiao Bai replied: "Father-in-law, don't worry, I will protect Han Er."

# Chapter 2121: Heaven's Envy Immortal Gu

From Du Zhi Xiao's corpse, an Immortal Gu floated up and appeared on his chest.

Resembling a fist-sized crystal flea, it curled silently into a ball.

"This Immortal Gu allowed a mortal to influence the tribulation?" Cleaning the battlefield, Li Xiao Bai discovered it.

"This Immortal Gu is rare, let me check." Imperial Minister Su looked at it peculiarly and employed information path methods.

Soon, he got the answer: "This is heaven's envy Immortal Gu!"

Imperial Minister Su explained: "Heaven's envy Immortal Gu is a heaven path Gu. Even a rank nine venerable cannot activate it."

"Father, you must be mistaken. We saw Du Zhi Xiao activate it with our own eyes to trouble my husband," Su Qi Han retorted.

Imperial Minister Su shook his head: "Heaven's Envy resonates with jealousy to activate, but exacts lifespan—that is why Du Zhi Xiao aged so rapidly."

Imperial Minister Su smiled: "Xiao Bai, this heaven's envy Immortal Gu is yours. Offer it to the Imperial Court, and you will be duly compensated."

Li Xiao Bai pondered: "Can I exchange for an information path Immortal Gu?"

Remaining calm, Li Xiao Bai thought: "Father-in-law has many political rivals. Asking him to exchange for an Immortal Gu from the Imperial Court would face heavy obstruction, with little chance of success. Even if he succeeds, he would lose too much political capital. That would be unwise."

Li Xiao Bai said: "Father-in-law, Han Er, I'll list this heaven's envy Immortal Gu in treasure yellow heaven to see if anyone buys it."

Li Xiao Bai's expression suddenly changed: "Someone bought heaven's envy Immortal Gu!"

"What?" Imperial Minister Su was stunned.

With uncontainable excitement, Li Xiao Bai said: "I completed the transaction! They offered rank seven poem wall Immortal Gu!"

Yet through this transaction, Li Xiao Bai obtained his first Immortal Gu, and a rank seven at that.

Staring in disbelief, Imperial Minister Su exclaimed: "Someone actually bought a heaven path Immortal Gu with a rank seven information path Gu? What fool is this?"

That 'fool' was none other than Gu Yue Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan had been monitoring Li Xiao Bai; while he generally avoided interfering, helping his clone obtain an Immortal Gu was far too crucial.

His time path clone directly refined poem wall Immortal Gu up to rank seven.

Though Li Xiao Bai was only rank six, this rank seven poem wall Immortal Gu was more than suitable to be his core Immortal Gu.

"So heaven's envy Immortal Gu caused my luck resonance." Upon receiving the Gu, Fang Yuan found Cooking Luck Pot vibrating slightly.

Around his silver light pillar, harmonious clouds revolved in defense while ascending to clash with the clouds at its peak.

Deeply shaken, Fang Yuan wondered: "Is this heaven's envy Immortal Gu the key to dealing with the venerables?"

After extensive deductions, Fang Yuan began instilling immortal essence into heaven's envy Immortal Gu!

Heaven's envy Immortal Gu shook and resisted stubbornly, but it soon faltered against Fang Yuan's forceful invasion.

Moments later, heaven's envy Immortal Gu absorbed some immortal essence and spat out a lump of grey smoke.

Fang Yuan's eyes shined with immense brilliance!

"I actually partially refined heaven's envy Immortal Gu! Is this due to my unrestrained heavenly marks?"

Fang Yuan possessed over ten thousand unrestrained heavenly marks, refined from heaven path dao marks gained by annexing grotto-heavens.

Afterwards, he successfully activated heaven's envy Immortal Gu!

Fang Yuan did not lose any lifespan.

Fang Yuan realized: "Though I can activate heaven's envy Immortal Gu, having only partially refined it, I cannot exert its full strength yet."

"If I continue gaining unrestrained heavenly marks, will I be able to refine heaven's envy Immortal Gu completely?"

Suddenly, a flash of inspiration pierced the darkness of Fang Yuan's mind like lightning, creating a huge commotion!

Fang Yuan thought: "Both heaven's envy and fate Gu are heaven path Gu. If I can refine Heaven's Envy, could I refine Fate Gu and control fate itself?"

Meanwhile, on Southern Border's Shang Liang Mountain, Shang Yan Fei gathered his children in the same hall.

As the eldest son, Shang Qiu Niu spoke first: "Congratulations to Father on succeeding in immortal ascension and becoming a blood path Gu Immortal!"

Shang Yan Fei said: "Keep my blood path advancement secret. I gathered you to distribute assets before entering closed cultivation. The great era has arrived; I want you all to become immortals and lead its tides!"

# Chapter 2122: Nine Children Dragon Drawings

Dressed in a black robe with blood-red hair and a handsome young face, he sat as his children gathered in the hall.

Under their gazes, Shang Yan Fei took out a stack of beast skins.

Each beast skin vividly depicted a dragon-like beast, with ink inscriptions at the corner exuding an aura of primitive antiquity.

"These nine children dragon drawings were an immortal opportunity I obtained in my youth, but I could never unravel them. Now, I pass these nine children dragon drawings to you, hoping you can unravel the mystery and gain your own immortal opportunities."

Shang Yan Fei called his children one by one, distributing the drawings with words of encouragement.

Shang Yan Fei called for Shang Tuo Hai: "You managed the merchant caravan well, so I give it to you entirely, along with a water path Gu Immortal's inheritance. Though largely incomplete, its contents remain valuable. I hope you continue to work hard in the future."

And finally, Shang Yan Fei called for Shang Xin Ci.

"Father." Shang Xin Ci walked towards her father.

Shang Yan Fei sighed: "Having distributed everything, only this house remains. Xin Ci, you surpassed my expectations most—take this house."

Once he said that, the hall went into a commotion.

Under everyone's gazes, Shang Xin Ci calmly replied: "I thank Father for this gift."

After the gathering ended, most of Shang Yan Fei's children gathered secretly.

"Shang Xin Ci and Fang Yuan have a mysterious relationship; I'm afraid the higher-ups are considering that too."

Everyone's discussions came to a halt.

Shang Yi Fan said: "Fang Yuan influences the entire world—why would he care about ants like us? Shang clan's supreme elders are overthinking it. After all these years, has Fang Yuan helped Shang Xin Ci even once?"

Shang Yi Fan continued: "Shang Xin Ci has a huge force, but she is not unbeatable. If we work together, we can divide her forces and win."

Shang Ya Zi snickered: "With the expert I recently recruited, Shang Xin Ci will face endless trouble and her reputation will crumble."

Days later.

The study room's atmosphere was tense.

Hearing Shang Bu Li's report, Shang Xin Ci frowned: "In just a few days, these issues have swept through our entire market."

Counterfeit Gu had flooded the market—indistinguishable at first, they eventually self-detonated, inflicting huge losses on buyers.

Xiao Die questioned Shang Bu Li angrily: "You oversee the market—why did you withhold information until the crisis escalated?"

Shang Bu Li snorted coldly: "I failed to rectify the situation, so I resign—do not try to stop me."

Looking at Shang Bu Li deeply, Shang Xin Ci replied calmly: "In that case, I approve your resignation."

"Goodbye!" Shang Bu Li chuckled as he left.

Xiao Lan reported: "Clan Leader, Lord Shang Tuo Hai seeks an audience."

Her gaze flickering briefly, Shang Xin Ci answered: "Let him in."

Entering the study room, Shang Tuo Hai saw Shang Xin Ci's expression and nodded: "So you realized it."

Shang Xin Ci asked: "Because of the clan leader position?"

Shang Tuo Hai explained: "After you banned the slave trade, Shang Bu Li lost his fortune; he joined this fake Gu conspiracy out of resentment. He has been convinced by them and is involved in this fake Gu conspiracy."

Shang Tuo Hai added: "Shang Bu Li is just the first to defect; more will appear soon."

Shang Xin Ci nodded: "And what do you want from this?"

Shang Tuo Hai replied: "Even if you fall, I will not become clan leader. I will lead the caravan to pursue immortality myself. Unable to rely on the clan, I hope you will repay this kindness if you become immortal in the future."

Suddenly, Shang Xin Ci was stripped of her capable subordinates, left isolated without help.

Those Gu Masters who bought fake Gu gathered to cause trouble.

Shang Xin Ci had to bring Xiao Lan and Xiao Die to the scene and take control of the situation.

"These Gu worms are all fake, is Shang clan selling fake goods now?"

Facing the intense rage, Shang Xin Ci remained calm as ice: "Shang clan will compensate all of you twice the amount of your losses."

Just one sentence made the surroundings silent.

Watching from the dark, Shang Ya Zi and the others grew anxious and began giving instructions.

The lurking experts within the crowd attacked Shang Xin Ci.

Shang Xin Ci unleashed a killer move, shielding the shop and blocking all attacks.

Light flickered in her eyes as her aura erupted, activating a battlefield killer move.

The killer move pushed outward, trapping all the troublemakers and instantly silencing the noisy street.

Shang Ya Zi and the rest watched with intense shock.

At that moment, she exuded the commanding aura of Shang Yan Fei—the air of a peak rank five expert!

# Chapter 2123: Xin Ci's Immortal Opportunity

Though benevolent by nature, Shang Xin Ci showed an extremely strong stance, suppressing the entire situation.

Though she trapped everyone, Shang Xin Ci did not punish them, instead upholding her promise to compensate them twice the amount.

Shang Qiu Niu had a complex expression: "Perhaps this is the difference between Shang Xin Ci and us, and why Father favors her to become clan leader."

Shang Qiu Niu said: "Shang Xin Ci's strength surpasses ours. Under her leadership, Shang clan's businesses made immense profits. Even after stopping the slave trade, our profits only fell briefly before rising far higher than before."

Shang Yi Fan smiled coldly: "Whoever becomes clan leader will be nurtured into an immortal! Even if Shang Xin Ci surpasses us, will you not vie for that immortal opportunity?"

Shang Qiu Niu was silent for a moment before nodding solemnly: "I have to try!"

After releasing the troublemakers, Shang Xin Ci went to pacify the shop owners.

An elderly man walked shakily to Shang Xin Ci, expressing gratitude: "If not for Clan Leader, I would be in deep trouble. Blinded by greed, I believed rumors and bought cheap goods, never thinking they were all fake."

The old man said in trepidation: "I bought a large batch of unsellable fake goods. Clan Leader, will you compensate my losses as well?"

Shang Xin Ci replied calmly: "As Shang clan leader, I will not go back on my word. You will receive double compensation for the fake goods you imported."

Xiao Lan warned: "Young miss, compensating everyone plays right into the culprit's scheme to drain our primeval stones."

Shang Xin Ci nodded: "We can always earn back primeval stones, but if Shang clan's reputation is ruined, rebuilding it will take far more time and effort."

Xiao Die pouted: "This is infuriating! That old man is blatantly exploiting your kindness for profit! If Lord Fang Yuan were here, he would beat them senseless—no one would dare bully us then!"

Ever since Fang Yuan was struck by Lu Wei Yin's killer move, three lifetime dreams reform a chosen one, Shang Xin Ci fell into uncontrollable grief whenever his name was mentioned.

Thus, Fang Yuan's name became a taboo around Shang Xin Ci.

At the end of the street, Xiao Lan said: "Young miss, Lord Zhou Quan and Wei De Xin have been ill for a long time. Let's go visit them."

The three of them arrived at Wei De Xin's accommodation.

The suspicious cultivator looked grim upon seeing Shang Xin Ci, but knowing her benevolence, he relaxed internally: "I am a Wu clan Gu Master, here to deliver a letter to Lady Wei De Xin."

Shang Xin Ci let the Gu Master leave and entered, finding Wei De Xin bedridden.

Wei De Xin explained: "Our enemies schemed against Zhou Quan and me, leaving us bedridden. But I won't falter easily—I sent a letter to my brother asking for help."

Xiao Lan was overjoyed: "Great! Lord Wei Shen Jing is Southern Border's renowned Counterfeit Master. With his help, we can surely resolve this fake goods crisis!"

"Pity he is busy now. Wu clan leader Wu Ji recently succeeded in her immortal ascension and nominated him. Wu clan is promoting external elders, seeking outsiders as external Gu Immortals. Undergoing a test now, my brother can only explain the situation by letter and cannot come personally."

Before they left, Zhou Quan reminded them: "Paying double only alleviates the symptom, not the root cause. You must find the source of these fake goods and stop it. You must also track down and clear all remaining fakes from the market. Only then will this crisis truly be resolved."

That night, back in her study, Shang Xin Ci looked at the fake Gu on the table with worry.

"Clan leader, why sigh?" Light shone from the fake Gu, condensing into an old man's image.

Shang Xin Ci was astonished—the old man was the shop owner who had demanded compensation earlier!

# Chapter 2124: Admiring Fang Yuan

The mysterious old man was so strong, Shang Xin Ci did not even detect his method to lurk within the Gu worm.

Shang Xin Ci said solemnly: "I sighed because Shang Ya Zi and the others scheme to unseat me for that immortal opportunity, completely indifferent to the misery and losses they inflict on others. They disregard Shang clan's reputation entirely, caring only for themselves."

The old man sighed: "Shang Xin Ci, having lived on Shang Liang Mountain for years, I believe your sincerity. Thus, I decided to help you!"

The old man said: "The creator of the fake Gu is Feng Tian Yu, bribed by Shang Ya Zi."

"Feng Tian Yu?" Shang Xin Ci's gaze flickered. "I know him—a righteous path cultivator and former young clan leader. He is a rank four refinement path master with incredible attainment. Regrettably, his clan was exterminated in a conflict, reducing a young clan leader with boundless prospects to a lone cultivator."

The old man nodded: "Feng Tian Yu has secretly reached rank five while hiding as a rank four. I have a method for you to recruit him as your loyal subordinate."

Shang Xin Ci's expression shifted: "Senior wants me to deceive Feng Tian Yu?"

The old man smiled: "You truly know Fang Yuan. If a harmless lie can subdue the culprit and save countless people, will you tell it?"

The old man's smile widened: "Being villainous is hard, but being virtuous is harder—a good person must defeat villains while upholding their own morals. I am merely offering a method; what you do with it is entirely up to you."

Shang Xin Ci did not hesitate: "Thank you, senior. The method is sound; I will give it a try."

The old man added: "This Gu worm also holds a Gu Immortal true inheritance best suited for you."

Moments later, joy flashed across her face as she muttered: "Good deeds Gu?"

Feng Tian Yu stayed in the third inner city.

"Brother Feng, you are truly enjoying yourself," Shang Xin Ci's voice suddenly echoed.

Feng Tian Yu composed himself: "The Shang clan leader visits me in person—I am truly honored. Clan leader, your methods are amazing. I set up three Gu formations here, yet you entered stealthily—is anywhere barred to you?"

Unruffled, Shang Xin Ci replied: "Flooding the market with fakes nearly ruined my reputation as clan leader."

Shang Xin Ci smiled: "Brother Feng, whatever I declare as truth is truth, even without evidence."

Shang Xin Ci turned around, smiling: "Brother Feng, come work for me."

"What?" Feng Tian Yu stared in disbelief, then laughed: "Shang clan leader, do you know what price Shang Ya Zi paid to hire me?"

Shang Xin Ci chuckled: "Whatever he offered, you won't be able to refuse mine."

Shang Xin Ci raised her right index finger: "Firstly, your life."

Shang Xin Ci smiled confidently: "Don't worry, Brother Feng, you have rank five cultivation level, no need to be nervous."

Shang Xin Ci added: "Furthermore, if you perform well, you may receive an audience with Lord Fang Yuan."

"I deduced your identity with help from Lord Fang Yuan's hairy man Gu Immortal subordinates."

"I presented a fake Gu, and that hairy man Gu Immortal praised it as genius work. Progress further, and you might gain Lord Fang Yuan's recognition and become his subordinate."

"Truly? Is this real?" Feng Tian Yu asked, his face flushed with excitement.

"But I admire Lord Fang Yuan's refinement path talent the most!"

"Back on Three Kings Mountain, witnessing Lord Fang Yuan refine Fixed Immortal Travel in person was the greatest fortune of my life."

Feng Tian Yu was a most fanatical admirer of Fang Yuan.

Even though Shang Xin Ci did not produce any solid evidence, as long as there was hope, as long as there was a chance for him to get close to his idol, the divine existence in his heart, it was enough for him to feel extreme excitement, he could not control himself.

# Chapter 2125: Brother Feng, You?!

Days later, in Shang Liang Mountain's second inner city, Shang Ya Zi and his cohort had gathered to confer, only to discover with fury that they were surrounded.

"Zhou Quan, Wei De Xin! How dare you muster Gu cultivators in the second inner city!"

Zhou Quan announced: "We have investigated the rampant fake Gu on Shang Liang Mountain and identified you as the culprits. Surrender now, and our merciful leader may grant leniency."

Shang Yi Fan shouted: "You accuse us without evidence! Shang Xin Ci couldn't handle the crisis, so she shifts blame to us!"

"Denial is useless," Wei De Xin cut in. "We wouldn't arrest you publicly without concrete evidence."

Zhou Quan laughed: "Everything went as the clan leader foresaw. You want evidence? Behold!"

Zhou Quan waved his sleeve, dumping a large pile of Gu worms onto the ground.

Wei De Xin added: "Every fake Gu across Shang Liang Mountain is gathered right here."

Zhou Quan chuckled: "We have solid proof that Feng Tian Yu refined these fakes on your orders."

Shang Ya Zi stepped forward to shield Feng Tian Yu: "Zhou Quan! You dare frame us and slander my good friend! Slandering Brother Feng is far worse than accusing us! Unless you prove he made these fakes, I will demand an audience with Father for justice!"

Zhou Quan laughed: "Of course I have evidence. Feng Tian Yu, tell them: did you refine these fake Gu?"

Feng Tian Yu calmly admitted: "Steward Zhou is correct. Shang Ya Zi's group instructed me to refine fake Gu and disrupt the market to harm the clan leader."

Zhou Quan spoke: "Master Feng isn't my only witness. What do the rest of you have to say?"

Shang Qiu Niu sighed deeply: "I confess, we committed this mistake."

Shang Qiu Niu sighed: "Shang Xin Ci approached me earlier with Master Feng. We have zero chance of winning—concede defeat."

Realizing the truth, Shang Ya Zi glared at Feng Tian Yu with venomous fury: "Answer me, Feng Tian Yu! You care nothing for beauty and obsess only over refinement path. Shang Xin Ci couldn't possibly possess the charm to win you over. Why betray me?"

Feng Tian Yu sneered: "How could mortals understand my pursuit? Surrender at once!"

"Die, all of you!" Shang Ya Zi erupted, launching an attack.

Well-prepared, Shang Qiu Niu, Feng Tian Yu, Zhou Quan, and Wei De Xin clashed with them in chaotic battle.

On the verge of capture, Shang Yi Fan shouted: "You forced my hand!" and hurled out a mortal Gu House.

The cage-like mortal Gu House shattered, releasing a mud monster.

Roughly humanoid, shifting mud covered its body as countless faces surfaced.

"You bastard!" The mud monster roared, lunging at Zhou Quan and the others.

Amidst the chaos, Shang Ya Zi's faction narrowly escaped.

Unable to remain on Shang Liang Mountain, they fled and became demonic Gu Masters.

Eventually, Shang Xin Ci's forces subdued and resealed the mud monster, though over ten cultivators perished.

With the crisis resolved, Shang Xin Ci secured her leadership, recruited Feng Tian Yu, and saw her reputation soar.

After receiving the report, Shang Yan Fei smiled.

"Now that this is settled, I can depart to search for Blood Sea true inheritances."

# Chapter 2126: Ni Clan

In Shang Liang Mountain's first inner city, Shang Xin Ci handled clan affairs.

Shang Xin Ci smiled, inspecting a report: "Reparations are complete and the fake Gu incident is settled."

A dazzling information path mortal Gu flew before Shang Xin Ci.

Shang Xin Ci's mind jolted: "A task from the higher-ups."

Thinking to entrust Feng Tian Yu with an important mission, Shang Xin Ci summoned him.

Feng Tian Yu arrived excitedly: "Clan leader, I have great news!"

"I have been researching that strange mud monster and discovered a shocking secret!"

"He was Ni Jian, whose village was slaughtered by a demonic expert."

"After dying, he was revived by a qi path Gu Immortal, questioned about the culprit, and then discarded."

"A mortal body birthing an Immortal Gu is extraordinary! That slaughtered village was merely one branch— many other Ni clan branches are scattered across Southern Border."

Feng Tian Yu urged: "I request permission to investigate this secret! If we master this refinement method, mortals could refine Immortal Gu."

"No escorts needed," Feng Tian Yu waved. "Solving this secret will be an immense contribution. I must accumulate contribution points to have any hope of meeting Lord Fang Yuan!"

Meanwhile, in Mini Yellow Heaven of the sovereign immortal aperture, a group of kinsmen Gu Masters arrived beside the gold fragment current.

"Over the past dozen years, our Ni clan has grown tenfold, but recently this mysterious realm has turned dangerous. Now we face a life-and-death crisis."

"The gold fragment current is rising—we must dig new channels before it submerges our home!"

# Chapter 2127: Sovereign's Commotion

Mini Western Desert.

An enormous pitch-black city occupied the desert.

Created by inkman Immortal Yi Yan, Fang Yuan had seized and relocated it here.

Two inkman Gu Immortals, Mo Tan Sang and Mo Qi Yi, hovered aloft, surveying their surroundings with grave expressions.

Mo Qi Yi sighed: "They are already spawning desolate plants, making clearing them even harder. I thought this was a paradise, not that the environment would be dozens or a hundred times worse than Northern Plains!"

The variant human reinforcements included Xue Er, Bing Yuan, and hairy man and mushroomman Gu Immortals.

The hairy man Gu Immortal said: "I brought hairy man Gu Masters to reconstruct Inkman City into a unified Gu House, making future relocations effortless."

The mushroomman said: "These toxic vines are resources for us mushroommen, and I've found their source. By fighting poison with poison, I can use the vines to stabilize this vegetation for some time."

The hairy man Gu Immortal interrupted Mo Tan Sang: "Do not worry. Lang Ya Sect was ordered to reconstruct every city in the sovereign immortal aperture. Most will become mortal Gu Houses, while major cities like Inkman City will become Immortal Gu Houses!"

Shi Zong said, "Master annexed Fire Plain grotto-heaven and the apertures of its immortals and Grotto Lord, greatly increasing fire path dao marks in the sovereign immortal aperture. This volcanic Fire Bird Mountain nearly erupted as a result. Fortunately, we discovered it in time and deployed an immortal formation to suppress it, but someone must now remain to preside over it."

Due to aperture instability, Fang Yuan designated Star Collection City as the primary metropolis under Combat Beast King.

Just then, an information path Gu worm buzzed loudly as it flew over.

"Damn it! Only I can handle this disaster, but it's already too late to resolve it!" Combat Beast King paled.

Combat Beast King grieved, "This disaster will annihilate dozens of resource points and the Ni clan."

# Chapter 2128: Hu Land Projection

Ni clan Gu Masters exerted all their strength against the gold fragment current.

Nurtured by Fang Yuan in Mini Yellow Heaven, the Ni clan had multiplied and united under heavy pressure.

Yet just as the Gu formation neared completion, the gold fragment current and the underlying cloud soil began to tremble.

Because they saw the meteor rain falling from the sky.

"I refuse to die like this!" Ni clan leader Ni Xiang clenched his fists. "We sacrificed so much!"

Right then, the meteor-lit sky abruptly dimmed.

An abyss-black giant slowly emerged. It was so colossal that merely bending its leg cast an immense shadow across the ground.

The two-headed black giant glared with four terrifying eyes, radiating a malevolent light that pierced the sky.

Its hundreds of raised clawed hands resembled a ferocious, bizarre forest.

One of the pitch-black giant's head opened and breathed out a dark soul river.

The giant intercepted nearly the entire meteor rain, letting only stray fragments reach the ground.

As the meteor rain died down, the giant departed, its massive form slowly vanishing from the Ni clansmen's view.

The black giant then transformed into a beam of soul light and entered Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal body.

This black soul giant was the soul of Fang Yuan's main body!

From Shadow Sect's true inheritance, Fang Yuan had obtained the supreme cultivation method of soul path.

Human soul cultivation progressed up to hundred-million-man soul, solidifying from phantom form to directly affect the material world.

# Chapter 2132: Nurturing Gu Immortals

Wu Qiao took a deep breath and delivered his prepared response.

Wu Yong made no comment, only nodding as he put down his cup: "Do it."

Though Gu Immortals could handle tribulations, balancing the three qi required the Gu Master's own effort.

Historically, only one or two of eighteen Wu clan seeds would succeed in immortal ascension.

This simply could not satisfy Wu Yong's ambition!

Thus, Wu Yong disregarded opposition to recruit outsider Gu Masters as candidates, treating them fairly with full support.

"They see the situation, yet oppose it because it threatens their own interests."

"Their vision is too narrow; without regional walls, Wu clan faces the entire five regions, and our most terrifying rivals lie in Central Continent."

"Central Continent's sect system..." Wu Yong sighed.

Wu Yong saw the sect system's superiority, prompting him to support outsider candidates and recruit external elders.

"Five or six of these seeds should succeed in immortal ascension. If a Wu clansman becomes a qi path Gu Immortal, Hu Land can finally be utilized."

"With Eight-Faced Prestige Wind and Hu Land, Wu clan will stand among the top super forces in all five regions."

The plague erupted so violently that Meng Qiu Zhen lost all strength and collapsed upon discovering it.

"I must persevere; that mortal's location is not far."

But right at this time, he heard rustling noises.

"It's that mortal's footsteps. Good!" Meng Qiu Zhen's eyes shone as he shouted with all his strength: "Help... help..."

# Chapter 2144: Pulling Mushrooms

Despite shouting with all his strength, Meng Qiu Zhen's voice remained faint.

"Who is asking for help?" A mortal girl pushed through the brambles and arrived.

The girl mumbled: "Did I hear wrongly? I must gather mushrooms to sell in Tu clan village. Eh? There are so many here!"

But right now, Meng Qiu Zhen's body was already covered with mushrooms.

Squatting down, the mortal girl started picking mushrooms from Meng Qiu Zhen's body.

With every mushroom she picked, the drain on Meng Qiu Zhen's vitality lessened.

His illness was alleviated rapidly and his strength slowly recovered.

"Don't be afraid, I am also a person. I called for help earlier—thank you for saving me, kind girl."

Meng Qiu Zhen forced a smile: "Plucking all the mushrooms will save me. They harm us mushroommen, but are harmless and even beneficial to other races."

With nimble hands, the girl rapidly picked the mushrooms from Meng Qiu Zhen's body.

"There is still one last mushroom!" The girl said seriously.

"Wait." Meng Qiu Zhen's expression changed, "You don't need to pick that mushroom — ahhh!"

Amidst Meng Qiu Zhen's miserable cries, the second stage was finally cleared.

This was a bustling and busy market with people walking everywhere.

"This is Tu clan village?" the tightly covered Huang Xiao Mi whispered behind Meng Qiu Zhen.

Having played Huang Xiao Mi in the first two stages, his identity changed for the third.

"I became that human girl," Meng Qiu Zhen sighed inwardly.

"Regardless, since Huang Xiao Mi followed her into Tu clan village, I should still help him find the mushroomman witch."

"Fang Tu, you came? Quick, take this good spot beside me. The evening market only lasts a short time," a middle-aged uncle waved at Meng Qiu Zhen.

"Thank you, uncle." Meng Qiu Zhen placed the basket of mushrooms beside him.

Huang Xiao Mi silently helped Meng Qiu Zhen set up the mushrooms.

"Fang Tu, hide quickly! Don't let that 'beast' see you," the uncle warned.

"Lady Fang Tu!" the bald leader shouted, eyes gleaming slyly as he spotted Meng Qiu Zhen from afar.

Rubbing his green beast tattoo, the bald youngster grinned: "Lady Fang Tu, selling mushrooms again? I want to buy some."

Meng Qiu Zhen looked up and frowned: "You are touching my hand!"

"Shameless scoundrel, molesting an innocent girl in broad daylight!" Huang Xiao Mi shouted indignantly.

"Who are you to stand beside my Lady Fang!" Provoked, the bald youngster glared at Huang Xiao Mi.

"Hmph, who's afraid of you!" Huang Xiao Mi showed no weakness, counterattacking immediately.

"Don't fight!" Meng Qiu Zhen shouted, retreating; trapped in a mortal body, he could not interfere in a Gu Master battle.

"Wait, you're not human—you're a variant human!" the bald youngster suddenly shouted.

"A spy! What are you plotting in Tu clan village? Hahaha, I'm going to make a great contribution!"

The bald youngster shouted: "Attack him together! He's a mushroomman—we don't need morals against such a person!"

"Despicable! Fight me alone if you're a man!" Outnumbered and captured, Huang Xiao Mi shouted indignantly.

The bald youngster ran to Meng Qiu Zhen, asking solicitously: "Sister Fang, are you alright? You must have been forced by this mushroomman. Haha, how will you thank me?"

# Chapter 2145: Being a Bystander

Meng Qiu Zhen shook his head impatiently: "Brother Mi is a good person..."

The bald youngster interrupted hurriedly: "As expected, that scheming mushroomman threatened Lady Fang. Let's report to the elders. Move!"

The bound Huang Xiao Mi shouted: "That's right, I deceived and threatened Fang Tu! Capturing me will bring huge trouble to Tu clan; someone will definitely save me!"

The bald youngster escorted Huang Xiao Mi to the village prison, receiving praise from the Tu clan elders.

Once everyone left, the bald youngster invited Meng Qiu Zhen: "Sister Fang, come have dinner and stay over; my mother will be thrilled to see you!"

"So 'Green Beast' had this kind of past with Fang Tu?" Meng Qiu Zhen nodded, letting the plot develop.

"Little Fang! I haven't seen you in days. Are your parents well?" his mother asked enthusiastically.

The bald youngster patted his chest: "Mother, I made a huge contribution! I caught a mushroomman and jailed him."

"What?" The bald youngster's mother paused.

"Alright, alright," his mother waved. "Brat, we're out of soy sauce. Go buy some at the nearby shop."

Once the youngster left, his mother approached Meng Qiu Zhen: "Come, Little Fang, tell Auntie what happened."

The dream realm's third stage passed like this.

Fourth stage.

Deep in the night, underground prison.

"My identity changed again?" Meng Qiu Zhen realized upon regaining his senses.

He was no longer mortal Fang Tu, but a rank four Gu Master once more.

"I am the bald youngster's mother now?" Meng Qiu Zhen quickly discovered she was actually a mushroomman.

Meng Qiu Zhen guessed: "My current identity is probably Huang Wan."

"Huang Wan hid in human territory in Tu clan village, even adopting a human child to conceal her identity. If that bald youngster knew his 'mother' was a mushroomman, what face would he make?"

"Though expelled, Huang Wan still cares for her tribe, moving tonight to save Huang Xiao Mi."

Meng Qiu Zhen immediately went deeper into the underground prison.

Soon, he saw Huang Xiao Mi bound to a wall in the deepest part of the prison.

Using his Gu worms, Meng Qiu Zhen silently melted the prison door lock.

"Huang Xiao Mi, wake up." Meng Qiu Zhen approached him to inspect his condition.

Suddenly, 'Huang Xiao Mi' detonated into ash, covering Meng Qiu Zhen.

Dark-yellow light filled the prison as the concealed Gu formation activated.

"A trap!" Meng Qiu Zhen helplessly discovered that 'Huang Xiao Mi' had vanished completely.

Two twin-like elders were transported before Meng Qiu Zhen by the Gu formation.

After a sixty-round battle, he was defeated and captured by the two elders.

The dream realm dissipated.

"I failed." Meng Qiu Zhen's soul returned to his body as he sighed.

With an injured soul, Meng Qiu Zhen analyzed the battle while healing.

Meng Qiu Zhen deduced five poison path killer moves, primarily based on bee poison Gu.

Entering the dream realm again, Meng Qiu Zhen inspected everything patiently.

"This is a fake prison; the real prison and Gu formation core are further below!"

Meng Qiu Zhen carefully entered the real underground prison.

"No, there is a trace of Earth Tunnel here!"

"This must be a famous mountain containing a natural Earth Tunnel. By developing it slightly, Tu clan village gained abundant resources—no wonder they nurtured two rank four elders."

"Those two Gu Masters!" Meng Qiu Zhen heard cultivators moving through the Earth Tunnel ahead.

"The two rank four elders," Meng Qiu Zhen recognized them while observing secretly.

"This mushroomman is tight-lipped, enduring such cruel torture!"

"Even without his confession, we know a mushroomman tribe lurks around Tu clan village. We just don't know the exact location."

"In a few days, we will breach his soul defenses and learn everything through soul search."

# Chapter 2146: Prison Break

The two elders eventually stopped and entered another tunnel.

Following the route of the two rank four elders, Meng Qiu Zhen found Huang Xiao Mi.

Investigating carefully and confirming there were no traps, Meng Qiu Zhen entered the cell.

The mushrooms on Huang Xiao Mi shrank until all of them receded into his body.

Ultimately, the bald youngster struck down Huang Xiao Mi, killing him on the spot.

At the next moment, the dream realm shattered.

Back in the sovereign immortal aperture, Meng Qiu Zhen healed while collating insights about the dream.

Once healed, Meng Qiu Zhen re-entered the dream realm seeking answers.

Without waking him, Meng Qiu Zhen directly used a poison path killer move to purge the plague from Huang Xiao Mi.

Finding his illness cured, Huang Xiao Mi rejoiced: "Thank you, senior! Please save the mushroomman tribe—many of us are afflicted with this plague."

Meng Qiu Zhen nodded, giving Huang Xiao Mi poison path Gu to grant him battle strength.

With a peculiar expression, Meng Qiu Zhen asked: "I used many concealment methods; how did you find us?"

After an intense battle, Huang Xiao Mi still died in battle.

After deep analysis and deduction, he began the fourth exploration.

Sneaking in early to hide, he entered the cell once the elders left, curing Huang Xiao Mi and giving him healing Gu worms.

"Wait here and keep healing; you have a tracking mark on you," Meng Qiu Zhen instructed. "Escape once you see this healing Gu fly into the air."

Summoned by the two elders, he was heading toward them when Meng Qiu Zhen suddenly attacked him.

The bald youngster died on the spot.

However, Meng Qiu Zhen found himself immobilized as intense sadness, guilt, and regret overwhelmed his heart, stripping away control of his body.

"Perhaps because they lived together so long, the mushroomman Huang Wan already treated him as her real son."

"So this guy cannot be killed either?" Meng Qiu Zhen was troubled.

After deep consideration, Meng Qiu Zhen re-entered the dream realm.

Using Create Dream Immortal Gu, he constructed a complex tunnel along the way.

With his arrangements complete, Meng Qiu Zhen reached the cell just as the two elders left.

The two elders lost their way just as they were about to meet the bald youngster.

With this crucial gap in time, Meng Qiu Zhen successfully brought Huang Xiao Mi away.

Rather than killing the troublesome youth, Meng Qiu Zhen knocked him unconscious. After stopping Huang Xiao Mi from seeking revenge, he successfully cleared this dream realm scene.

# Chapter 2147: War

The sixth scene of the dream realm.

Meng Qiu Zhen became the mushroomman Huang Xiao Mi again.

Huang Xiao Mi had obtained poison path Gu from Huang Wan to eliminate the plague afflicting his tribe.

Huang Xiao Mi moved stealthily in secret, trying to escape.

Tu clan village's perimeter was regularly patrolled by scouting Gu Masters.

As the patrol rested, a colorless, odorless poison gas drifted toward them.

The five Gu Masters fell on the ground, falling unconscious.

"Huang Wan's poison move only works on rank three and below, but its lack of aura is exceptionally practical," Meng Qiu Zhen assessed.

But a change happened before Meng Qiu Zhen's very eyes.

"Variant human thief, you're still here? Stop right there!" Startled for a moment, the bald youth shouted and gave chase.

As the bald youth pursued him, the recovered Huang Xiao Mi avoided direct combat, laying traps as he fled to eliminate the rest of the squad.

Since the bald youth was Huang Wan's son, Meng Qiu Zhen prudently avoided attacking him.

Eventually, Meng Qiu Zhen successfully escaped.

Through their rivalry, both grew rapidly in strength, reaching rank four simultaneously.

Finally, at the twelfth scene of the dream realm.
