The mushroommen set a trap disguised as their gathering spot, prompting Tu clan village to dispatch the bald youth.

"Green Beast, today you die!" Huang Xiao Mi shouted, leading his troops to encircle the outnumbered humans.

Eventually, the bald youth exhausted all his strength and primeval essence.

He shouted: "Come kill me! Even if I die, I only lost to the schemes of those Tu clan elders!"

"So you understood after all." Meng Qiu Zhen smiled coldly, stepping forward to deliver the finishing blow when an unexpected change occurred.

Concealing her appearance, Huang Wan suddenly appeared, unleashing a wave of white poisonous smoke and successfully saving the bald youth.

The next moment, a rank five human Gu Master struck.

With a roar, the Gu Master dispersed the white smoke, obstructing Huang Wan's escape.

"Village head!" Overjoyed to see the rank five Gu Master, the bald youth turned to look at the female Gu Master who had saved him.

Sensing a familiar yet foreign aura from her, the bald youth asked curiously: "Benefactor, who... are you?"

# Chapter 2148: Le Tu

Tu clan Gu Masters emerged from all directions, encircling the mushroommen along with Huang Wan and her son.

Huang Xiao Mi shouted: "Don't panic! I've requested tribal reinforcements—they will arrive shortly. Hold out until then!"

Instead of attacking directly, Tu clan's leader stepped forward, staring complexly at Huang Wan: "Wan Er, as expected, you came."

Huang Wan snorted coldly: "What do you want?"

At her words, the bald youth realized the truth, his body trembling as he gasped: "Mother?!"

With her identity exposed, Huang Wan dropped her concealment and revealed her true appearance.

Tu clan's head looked deeply at the youth before turning to Huang Wan: "Wan Er, is he truly our son? I never imagined you stayed hidden in Tu clan village and raised him alone. It must have been so hard on you."

Huang Wan snorted coldly: "You are Tu clan's leader, while I am the mushroomman tribe's witch—we were destined to separate. But our child is innocent; I stayed in the village for a reason. As a hybrid, my son would never be accepted by the tribe. So I let him grow up in Tu clan village, intending to eventually reveal the truth and have you take him in."

Huang Wan looked gently at the bald youth: "You used to ask about your father—now you know. I had my plans, but reality is beyond our control, and I never anticipated today. Child, no matter how much you resent us, remember this: whether human, variant human, or hybrid, everyone deserves happiness. Do not dwell on hatred—a broad heart reveals a vast world. That is why mother named you Le Tu."

Hearing this, Meng Qiu Zhen was shaken internally.

"What? 'Green Beast' is Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable? He has mixed blood—how could a hybrid become one of the ten human venerables?!"

"Mother, say no more." Le Tu stepped back, shaking his head at Huang Wan in disbelief: "How... can you be a mushroomman?"

Huang Wan's heart jumped: "Ah Le, you grew up among humans, so I know this is hard to accept, but..."

The ground behind Huang Wan cracked open as a rank four Tu clan elder launched a sneak attack.

Caught off guard, Huang Wan was sent flying, coughing up blood midair.

"Mother!" Le Tu subconsciously ran towards Huang Wan.

"Too late! Tu clansmen, slaughter them all!" Tu clan's village head shouted, unleashing a barrage of attacks.

"Lord village head!" Unable to call him 'Father', an anxious Le Tu shielded Huang Wan, staring at the leader in disbelief.

Le Tu realized the village head had used him to distract Huang Wan, enabling the elder's sneak attack.

"You made this choice after all!" Huang Wan glared coldly at her former lover.

With no time to heal in this urgent situation, she quickly suppressed her injuries and stood up.

"As village head, I am responsible for my people's lives. Besides, exterminating variant humans is every human's righteous duty!" Tu clan's leader snorted, attacking relentlessly.

"You have such a cruel and wicked heart!" Huang Wan screamed, pushing Le Tu aside to clash with the village head.

A dark light flashed in the village head's eyes as a plan formed.

Tu clan's leader deliberately forced Huang Wan toward a specific Tu clan Gu Master.

This Tu clan Gu Master was only rank two, yet he was maneuvered right into Huang Wan's attack range.

Without thinking, Huang Wan struck the Gu Master, killing him on the spot!

"No!" Le Tu shouted, subconsciously running over.

"Get back, Ah Le!" Huang Wan screamed palely as Le Tu charged in.

Seizing the opening, Tu clan's leader landed three consecutive attacks, knocking her unconscious on the spot.

"Mother!" Le Tu shouted, shielding Huang Wan with his body: "Don't harm my mother!"

Surging with killing intent, Tu clan's leader was about to attack when shouts echoed from afar.

Tu clan's head frowned: "Losing our elites over these mushroommen isn't worth it without locating their hideout."

Thinking so, Tu clan village's head ordered: "Retreat."

"What are you doing?" the bald youth called out nervously as Tu clan's head approached.

Tu clan's head struck Le Tu unconscious, carrying both mother and son away.

The mushroomman Gu Masters chased relentlessly.

After the mushroommen failed their pursuit, Meng Qiu Zhen arrived at the next scene.

This time, he became Huang Wan again.

Chains pierced through his bones, binding his body without a trace of primeval essence or strength.

"You know my goal, so don't be hasty in refusing. Look at this." Tu clan's head retrieved an information path Gu worm.

In a well-decorated room, Tu clan's leader opened the door and met with Le Tu.

"I heard you were awake and came immediately, my son," Tu clan's head said with a warm expression.

Covered in bandages, Le Tu tried to get out of bed, but his body wavered and collapsed back down.

"How is my mother now?" Le Tu asked urgently.

# Chapter 2149: I Confess Everything

Tu clan's head sighed deeply: "Your mother is noble—she took huge risks staying in Tu clan village all these years for your sake."

His tone suddenly hardened: "Yet I cannot spare her; she is a mushroomman, a variant human!"

"You've earned enough merits to take the Tu surname. From today onward, you are Tu Le, a true Tu clansman!"

"Child, father is proud of you. This is your new life!"

"I don't want the Tu surname! I'll trade all my contributions to save my mother's life!" Le Tu called out.

Le Tu ground his teeth until blood seeped out, pointing at the leader: "If you kill my mother, I won't live either—I'll stake my life against yours!"

Tu clan's leader sighed: "I owe you dearly for failing to raise you all these years."

"I will let your mother escape, but only secretly."

"However, the mushroomman tribe must be eradicated down to the last one!"

Visibly moved, Le Tu gulped: "Village head... as long as you spare my mother, I don't care about the rest of the tribe!"

"Good child!" The village head patted his shoulder: "We cannot achieve true victory without locating their tribe."

"Your mother knows the tribe's location. Ah Le, I need your help to convince her to tell us."

"I promise you, once we eliminate the mushroomman tribe and remove this threat, I will release your mother to live in peace."

"This..." Le Tu hesitated.

The video ended here.

Tu clan's head smiled coldly, approaching Huang Wan: "What do you think? Do you want your own son to come convince you personally?"

Meng Qiu Zhen looked at the village head appreciatively: "Unscrupulous and shameless, you are quite something."

Meng Qiu Zhen's gaze flickered straightforwardly: "No need for such trouble. You want to know the tribe's location? I'll tell you directly."

"What?" Tu clan village's head was dazed.

"I'll give you the location and even reveal a secret tunnel for your elites to flank them," Meng Qiu Zhen offered.

Tu clan's head was silent before laughing coldly: "A captive dares toy with me? Good, very good—to think you would disregard your own son so cold-bloodedly."

He clapped and said: "Master Wu Xiao, please come out."

"Wu Xiao greets the village head." A tall, thin Gu Master with a grim expression manifested from the dream realm.

"This is Southern Border's famous doctor, Master Wu Xiao. Did you really think I came unprepared?" the village head introduced.

Wu Xiao examined Meng Qiu Zhen with Gu worms before reporting: "Village head, her soul defenses are airtight. An abrupt soul search will dissipate her soul and severely poison the attacker via backlash."

Tu clan's head nodded: "As a doctor skilled in soul path, only you can counter mushroomman poison while preserving their souls."

Wu Xiao began using his killer move on Meng Qiu Zhen.

The dream realm intensified, steadily draining his soul foundation.

"Stop! Don't you want their location? I'll tell you directly, isn't that enough?" Meng Qiu Zhen shouted.

Suddenly, Doctor Wu Xiao spat out a mouthful of blood.

"Amazing! A poison within a poison—to think such a method exists. Since I've been hit, I must use my final method."

"What drawback?"

"As a forceful soul search, it drives the target insane, though their raving words are truthful thoughts!"

Without even looking at Huang Wan, Tu clan's head said without hesitation: "Go ahead and use it; do not hold back."

"Yes." Wu Xiao immediately took action.

Moments later, Huang Wan went completely insane.

"Tell me the mushroomman tribe's location," Tu clan's head demanded.

Meng Qiu Zhen wanted to tell the truth, but his words came out as: "La la la, my homeland lives in my heart! Hehehe."

"How do we get into the mushroomman tribe's headquarters?" Tu clan's head pressed.

"Use your legs to walk in, or crawl if you like! Hahaha..." Huang Wan laughed madly again.

# Chapter 2150: Crazy Mother

Though Huang Wan spoke the truth each time, her answers were entirely nonsensical.

Doctor Wu Xiao was shocked: "Amazing! This mushroomman's will is so strong that even in insanity, she became purer, her every action resonating with her true feelings. In her heart, she will never betray her tribe, even if they exiled her. Village head, there is nothing else I can do."

"You..." Furious, the village head reined himself in: "Then Master Wu Xiao, go rest now."

The village head sneered at Huang Wan: "Don't worry, even crazy, you are still useful. If I cannot get answers from you, I'll capture more mushroomman higher-ups for Master Wu Xiao. I refuse to believe I cannot uncover your tribe's location!"

Le Tu wept in agony as tears flowed like a river.

Huang Xiao Mi nodded, playing along: "Mother, I don't blame you, you will always be my wonderful mother."

Huang Wan shed tears of joy: "Stupid rascal, I'm glad you forgive me. But don't kill your father or anyone else. I only want you to live in peace and happiness. Spare them. Conflict and slaughter only breed deeper hatred, torturing you and leaving you empty and unhappy."

"With my treatment afterward, she can definitely recover—there is still hope!"

"Ah—!" Le Tu threw back his head, crying out in sheer agony.

"Fine, for my mother's sake, I'll spare you two today." Le Tu gritted his teeth so hard they bled.

The dream realm ended here.

As his soul returned to his body, Meng Qiu Zhen sighed deeply.

But the fact was that his attainment level had risen.

His poison path attainment also rose to great grandmaster.

After clearing Paradise Earth's dream realm, only a few remained.

"By now, Ke Xin Hong should have arrived at Southern Border's Wu clan to meet Wu Yong."

# Chapter 2151: Refining Gu in Exchange for Famous Mountains

Ke Xin Hong smiled faintly, greeting politely: "Ke Xin Hong pays respects to Wu clan's first supreme elder."

Wu Yong smiled from his seat: "Esteemed envoy, no need for formalities."

Ke Xin Hong spoke straightforwardly: "I bring fan wind Gu, successfully refined and advanced. Please inspect it."

Wu Yong was stunned: "So fast? Could this be a counterfeit to scam me?"

He accepted and inspected it thoroughly, finding no flaws.

Minutes later, Wu Yong received confirmation that rank eight fan wind Gu was undeniably genuine.

Ke Xin Hong added: "Now that you've checked it, which two Immortal Gu would your clan like refined next? I can take them back."

Wu Yong became hesitant.

Wu Yong felt three chances were far too few; he wished he could elevate all of Wu clan's Immortal Gu.

"Your speed caught me unprepared, so I must choose carefully. Envoy, please stay as our guest for three days while I consider," Wu Yong said.

Ke Xin Hong smiled: "Aside from this, would Wu clan be open to another transaction?"

"What transaction?" Wu Yong became alert.

Ke Xin Hong explained the details while Wu Yong fell into contemplation.

Wu Ba Chong shouted in shock: "What? Fang Yuan wants our famous mountains in exchange for refining rank eight Immortal Gu?"

"Precisely." Ke Xin Hong nodded.

Wu Ba Chong sneered: "Absurd! Every famous mountain is at least a large resource point—most are giant, and some are super resource points producing rank eight immortal materials! Even if you refine rank eight Immortal Gu, you're merely advancing our existing Gu, not giving us additional ones."

"Besides, rank eight Immortal Gu are costly to feed and expend resources, whereas famous mountains yield resources continuously without drying up. Taking our famous mountains cripples our foundation—what schemes are you up to?!"

Ke Xin Hong replied: "Wu clan's territory is too vast to defend with your limited number of immortals."

"Furthermore," Ke Xin Hong continued, "rank eight Immortal Gu are priceless and unique. While immortal materials can be bought freely, Immortal Gu can only be traded. Even in treasure yellow heaven, the world's premier market, how many Immortal Gu have ever been traded?"

"With the five regions united, the chaotic war is inevitable. Combat strength comes first; only with sufficient power can you safeguard anything else. A rank eight Immortal Gu dramatically boosts your strength, letting you defend your territory and seize immense spoils through conquest."

"This..." Wu Ba Chong hesitated.

"Chai clan even sold us Human Smoke Mountain, their headquarters, recently."

Ke Xin Hong pressed no further: "If Wu clan declines, we won't force you. Beyond collecting Gu for refinement, I must propose this deal to other clans as well."

If rival clans traded with Fang Yuan while Wu clan abstained, their battle strength would surge ahead.

Wu Yong tapped his finger on the table, lost in deep thought.

At almost the same time, in Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace.

Earth Extremity Gan Ni knelt before Immortal Zombie Giant Sun: "Gan Ni pays respects to Master!"

She respectfully presented four rank eight Immortal Gu.

Giant Sun praised her: "Refining four rank eight Immortal Gu since the fate war is an immense contribution."

Gan Ni replied: "It was thanks to Master's luck path methods, though Longevity Heaven's luck has dropped significantly..."

Giant Sun waved a hand, cutting her off: "Every gain has its price. Expending luck to refine these Immortal Gu was a necessary investment."

Besides imitation Gu, the other three were all rank eight blood path Immortal Gu!

Divine Emperor City.

Light flickered as the ten children of human path emerged from the painting world into reality.

Concealing their presence, Qin Ding Ling and the others watched the scene unfold.

Qin Ding Ling declared: "These ten are Heavenly Court's human path seeds—we must nurture them fully!"

Divine Emperor City took flight, soaring straight out of Central Continent with unparalleled momentum.

The target was Crazed Demon Cave!

# Chapter 2152: Earth Vein's Initial Formation

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Several variant humans gathered in a circle, busy with an important task.

A gigantic hill landed on the ground.

Fang Yuan had dispatched envoys across the regions to negotiate trades.

Fang Yuan assigned variant human Gu Immortals to relocate the newly purchased Silent Hill into the sovereign immortal aperture.

Relocation was merely the first step; next, they had to establish its mountain roots.

The one in charge of this was a rockman Gu Immortal.

Activating his method, Silent Hill's mountain roots grew rapidly, plunging into the surrounding earth.

"Silent Hill is in place, and famous mountains are distributed across the mini five regions. The foundation is set—we can begin forming the earth vein."

Seeing Silent Hill settled, Fang Yuan took action personally.

To construct the earth vein, he had already established immortal formations across key areas of the mini five regions.

With a thought, Fang Yuan expended immortal essence, activating the immortal formations.

Linked by the Gu formations, an earth vein began chaining together, using the famous mountains as its nodes.

This earth vein traversed all five mini regions.

Seen from above, the earth vein formed a clear, simple geometric outline covering barely half the mini five regions.

With the earth vein established, the ground settled.

"The newly formed earth vein is still crude and offers no immediate benefit to the sovereign immortal aperture. It may even cause frequent disruptions initially, but once stabilized, the aperture will be sturdier than ever!"

Assessing the situation, Fang Yuan turned his attention outward and inspected his luck with Cooking Luck Pot.

Constructing the artificial earth vein had significantly impacted his luck.

His silver luck pillar had once been loose like cloud soil.

Though smaller now, the silver pillar had become far denser.

"Yet the other venerables' luck has also strengthened," Fang Yuan frowned.

Looming above were three clouds representing Star Constellation, Giant Sun, and Spectral Soul.

Star Constellation's cloud still dominated the uppermost layer, expanding slightly.

Curiously, Star Constellation's cloud appeared to be devouring Spectral Soul's cloud.

At the pillar's base, swirling yellow-brown dust circled the silver light, stabilizing it.

Luck inspection confirmed the project's immense value, strengthening Fang Yuan's resolve to see it through.

Immortal killer move — Heaven and Earth Travel!

In an instant, Fang Yuan's main body traveled from Eastern Sea to Southern Border.

A towering mountain pierced the clouds, exuding frost. With its mountain roots already severed, Fang Yuan arrived to collect it.

This was Frosty Peak.

Wu clan had agreed to sell Frosty Peak to Fang Yuan.

Beside Fang Yuan's variant human Gu Immortals stood Wu clan's immortals, led by Wu Yong himself.

"Fang Yuan, have you been well?" Wu Yong greeted him with a complex expression.

# Chapter 2153: Lord Fang Yuan, Time to Get Going!

Seeing Wu Yong, Fang Yuan also revealed a faint smile.

Wu Yong had come personally, signaling his clear intent to cooperate.

Just as Fang Yuan was about to speak with Wu Yong, a Gu Immortal flew over.

Usually composed, he now wore an anxious expression.

Spotting Fang Yuan, Lu Wei Yin called out: "Lord Fang Yuan, I finally found you!"

"What's the matter?" Fang Yuan smiled.

Lu Wei Yin said urgently: "Lord Fang Yuan, Divine Emperor City has brought Heavenly Court's immortals straight to Crazed Demon Cave!"

"Oh?" Fang Yuan's expression moved slightly.

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable has likely revived. We must head there immediately before Heavenly Court takes full control!"

Wu Yong realized this battle would reshape the entire Gu Immortal world across the five regions.

With that, Fang Yuan stored Frosty Peak into his sovereign immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan turned solemn: "I know you want to make contributions, and I have promised to assist Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's revival. But I have my own judgment. If I do not use this time to strengthen myself, how can I face the venerables? There is no need to rush me."

"This..." Lu Wei Yin pondered without speaking further.

Fang Yuan turned to Wu Yong and smiled again: "Wu Yong, regarding the sale of famous mountains, we can expand our transactions. For example, Moon Bowl, Corpse Mountain, Phoenix Peak, or Corpse Emperor Yu Ding Tian."

Discussion concluded, Fang Yuan waved his sleeves: "Alright, I'll see you both another time."

Lu Wei Yin stretched out his hand: "Lord Fang Yuan..."

Before leaving, Fang Yuan cast a cold glance at him: "I have other matters to handle."

Activating heaven and earth travel, Fang Yuan vanished on the spot.

He acutely sensed he was falling behind Fang Yuan and the others, knowing nothing about what was happening in Crazed Demon Cave.

# Chapter 2154: Looting Everything

"Lord Fang Yuan, Lord Fang Yuan!" Lu Wei Yin shouted.

After all, Spectral Soul lost his attainments upon leaving behind the dream realms, while Star Constellation and Giant Sun would not retain supreme grandmaster attainment even if revived.

With rising attainment levels, Fang Yuan annexed more grotto-heavens, pushing the sovereign immortal aperture to its limit once again.

Inside lay a lush rainforest of yellow and green. Desolate beast packs roamed amidst tangled trees and vines, growls echoing through the primitive wilderness.

"No rush." Fang Yuan raised his hand: "These immortal materials are useful to me."

Fang Yuan and Lu Wei Yin then proceeded into the second layer.

The second layer was a scorching land of burning stones piled together, ranging in size from tiny pebbles to elephant-sized boulders.

"Take them all." Fang Yuan ordered, the variant human Gu Immortals moved again.

They swept the area like a locust swarm, emptying the entire second layer.

After looting everything along his path, Fang Yuan reached Crazed Demon Cave's seventh layer.

The seventh layer was ablaze with color, its rocks, grass, soil, and trees all shining in radiant light.

Every piece of soil or rock here was a quasi-rank nine immortal material.

# Chapter 2155: Paradise Earth's Sacred Tomb

Fang Yuan was well-prepared when the demonic sounds rang. Having resisted them previously, handling them now was effortless.

Under the demonic sounds' influence, dao marks of the same path gathered into vast rainbow lights, no longer scattered and disordered.

Fang Yuan followed, his body likewise shrouded in yellow light.

Yet Fang Yuan discerned its essence at first glance: "Tomb Earth of the Ten Earths? What a massive tomb."

The tombstone bore six words — Tomb of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable!

Seemingly sensing Lu Wei Yin and Fang Yuan, the tomb suddenly emitted a grand pillar of light.

Reinvigorated with surging morale, the people of Yellow Earth Great World launched a counterattack.

Green Lotus Great World.

Amidst this lush green world stood a black-and-white mountain.

The top two seats were unoccupied, while Qin Ding Ling sat in the fourth!

"Fang Yuan and Lu Wei Yin arrived after all!" After receiving the information, Qin Ding Ling snorted coldly.

Qin Ding Ling gritted her teeth: "We must split into two groups: one will attack Yellow Earth Great World, while the other aids Demon Judgment Board in suppressing Savage Wilderness Great World and restraining Longevity Heaven. As for the other Gu Immortals, you can go conquer the small worlds in groups."

Qin Ding Ling stood up and bowed to the Gu Immortal in the third seat: "Lady Ming Hao, please allow this subordinate to deploy Divine Emperor City and personally lead the invasion of Yellow Earth Great World to resist Fang Yuan."

Though formerly Heavenly Court's leader, Qin Ding Ling held only the fourth seat here, answering to the three fairies above.

With the first two fairies absent, only the third, Fairy Ming Hao, was present to oversee the situation.

Fairy Ming Hao appeared as a delicate, cute girl of three or four, her large eyes glittering with specks of starlight.

Saying so, her tiny arm waved as a Gu worm flew out.

The other was Qing Hao Zi, a tall bamboo green as jade.

Next, the two immortals left the mountain, leading their troops to the front lines.

Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace.

Green Lotus Great World.

# Chapter 2160: Book Mountain

"You are quite perceptive." Fairy Ming Hao smiled.

Initially shooting the flying stars singly, she soon launched them in groups of three, five, or ten.

Though their power did not increase, the landing stars placed growing pressure on Lu Wei Yin!

"Ming Hao cultivates wisdom and star path, possessing pseudo venerable battle strength. I should retreat!" Lu Wei Yin resolved.

Chuckling, Fairy Ming Hao flashed a mysterious light from her eyes toward Lu Wei Yin's forehead.

Meanwhile, his thoughts moved much faster but halted prematurely. His remaining thoughts grew 'rash', colliding impatiently to deduce results too hastily.

In Crazed Demon Cave.

Dazzling and vast golden light flowed like a sea wave.

Fang Yuan retreated rapidly with a solemn expression.

Without reverse flow protection seal, facing the two venerables was perilous, like walking a tightrope between cliffs.

Worse yet was the turmoil inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

"An all living beings luck method..." Fang Yuan glared at Giant Sun Immortal Venerable with murderous intent.

With an eerie gaze, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable relaxed upon seeing the tribulation aura intensify around Fang Yuan.

He continually unleashed various compound killer moves that Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had never seen or heard of.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable smiled: "Brilliant compound killer moves, but a pity they are unsystematic—you still lack a combat system of your own!"

While speaking, he inflicted another deep injury on Fang Yuan's chest.

Comparing foundation, he was indeed inferior to venerables.

Seeing Fang Yuan's tribulation aura double in moments, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable smiled: "You have felt it, haven't you? The greatest profundity of my move lies in the sheer number of tribulations. As many resource points, Immortal Gu, Gu Immortals, desolate beasts, and so on as are there in the sovereign immortal aperture, there will be an equivalent number of calamities and tribulations."

"Whoever is struck must resolve countless tribulations simultaneously. Difficult—truly difficult. Fang Yuan, I won't give you the chance to save yourself."

Saying so, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable attacked once again.

His relentless, majestic attacks forced Fang Yuan on the defensive, unable to assist the sovereign immortal aperture.

The sovereign immortal aperture fell into a scene of abyssal ruin.

Mini Central Continent.

Large meteorites dragged long tails, smashing into the ground.

The meteorites exploded into spreading flames, incinerating the surrounding mist, marsh, and extreme marsh flowers into dry wasteland.

From the inferno, tall flame monsters stood up.

As the flame monsters rampaged, a Gu Immortal streaked across the sky.

It was Fang Yuan's dragonman clone — Wu Shuai.

With a thought, Wu Shuai dispatched ant groups to battle the flame monsters.

Under Wu Shuai's command, Star Collection City frantically dispatched manpower to tackle tribulations.

Yet the tribulations were too numerous, widespread, and varied, each requiring different methods to resolve.

This posed a severe challenge to the Gu Immortals stationed in the sovereign immortal aperture.

# Chapter 2205: Black Fire

News arrived of the first Gu Immortal suffering critical, near-fatal injuries.

Combat Beast King's heart immediately tensed: "So quickly?"

Mounting Gu Immortal casualties diminished the aperture's resistance; if this continued, the situation would collapse like an unstoppable avalanche.

Combat Beast King gritted his teeth: "Abandon Mini Black Heaven and stop rescuing desolate beasts! Protect large cities first, then key resource points. What are the wisdom path deductions?"

The results quickly arrived, and Combat Beast King decided on the spot to mobilize Star Collection City's Gu Immortals.

During his brief clash, flower mist extreme marsh was completely destroyed, yet most of the flame monsters remained.

Wu Shuai led them west, meeting another Gu Immortal midway who was being pursued by a pack of qi monsters.

With the two Gu Immortals in the center, the flame monsters and qi monsters clashed against each other.

"Formed purely through luck path without heaven's will to control them, they are leaderless. We can use tribulations to fight tribulations."

Under such operations, the sovereign immortal aperture's situation finally eased.

"We have stabilized the situation!" Combat Beast King exhaled, his face drenched in sweat after so short a time.

But this was far from enough.

"The tribulation clouds above the flower mist extreme marsh have disappeared completely."

"Something is wrong!!! There is an abnormal situation."

"Report! Over twenty tribulation clouds across the mini five regions are showing identical changes!"

"This is the... earth shaking heavenly light tribulation!"

Combat Beast King's face paled as reports revealed earth shaking heavenly light tribulations appearing across crucial areas.

Yellowish-brown pillars of light shot from the tribulation clouds, striking the ground and piercing deep into the earth.

Terrifying shockwaves expanded outward, shaking the earth, crumbling mountains, altering river courses, and stirring roaring seas.

"This luck path method targets the aperture's resources. With those points destroyed or crippled, the earth veins became the conspicuous target!"

"However, you think the earth veins we constructed painstakingly can be destroyed so easily?"

As the earth vein formation activated, a grand aura spread rapidly, forcefully suppressing the violent subterranean tremors.

Star Collection City's dispatched Gu Immortals soon reached the affected areas and attacked the earth shaking heavenly light pillars.

The massive light pillars broke down one after another as the aperture's Gu Immortals coordinated to overcome this crisis.

Yet just when the immortals thought the tribulations had passed, an aura that shook the hearts of all living beings in the aperture suddenly erupted!

Amidst the immortals' terrified gazes, a fire ignited in the depths of the tribulation clouds.

The fire was black!

Upon appearing, the black fire instantly incinerated all remaining tribulation clouds.

The black fire swelled and rained down, reducing both sky and ground to nothingness wherever it passed.

"Isn't this the black fire from dragon whale grotto-heaven? Giant Sun Immortal Venerable is truly formidable!" Wu Shuai's heart pounded in the face of such extreme danger.

"Don't panic! The main body anticipated this and taught me a countermeasure," He Chun Qiu said, activating a human path formation.

The human path formation incorporated the Thousand Wish Tree and the secluded domain of heaven and earth, Human Sea.

Massive lumps of light surged across the regions, pouncing wherever black fire spread.

The black fire rapidly dissipated and shifted shapes, yet the white light continually extinguished it regardless of its form.

Despite the white light's efficacy, the black fire continued to gather and expand.

"Oh no, black fire has appeared on Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley!"

The human path formation left behind by Fang Yuan was also implicated.

They could only depend on Fang Yuan's main body!

Fang Yuan's main body dodged continuously in a miserable state, bathed in blood with disheveled hair and a broken arm.

Unable to counterattack the two venerables, he was forced to halt five restriction profound light qi, barely hanging on to his last breath.

"I must resolve the black fire!" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, knowing his sovereign immortal aperture would be destroyed if left unattended.

Immortal killer move — Hu Elevation!

Freed from his shackles, Qi Sea clone made his move.

"Here I come!" Zhan Bu Du roared, freed from protecting Qi Sea as he rampaged toward Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

Fang Yuan's main body took the chance to retreat.

Immortal killer move — Humanly Flame Smoke!

He activated his method to rescue the human path formation first, then coordinated with it to suppress the scattered black fire.

However, Zhan Bu Du and Qi Sea Ancestor were being beaten back.

"Paradise Earth!" Fang Yuan retreated towards Paradise Earth.

Paradise Earth took a deep breath, activating heavenly web protection veil once more.

Their attacks became increasingly terrifying, Fang Yuan could only flee miserably.

Immortal Gu House — Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress!

Sheltered inside the Immortal Gu House, Fang Yuan activated an ability Gu-cored killer move to absorb the black fire.

The deadlock inside the sovereign immortal aperture finally began turning for the better.

Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress shielded Fang Yuan briefly before crumbling under the two venerables' combined strength.

"Die!" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable suddenly used a vicious killer move.

"Protect me!" Fang Yuan shouted in alarm, unable to dodge in time.

At the crucial moment, Zhan Bu Du flew over and used his body to block the strike.

A huge explosion rang, Zhan Bu Du was torn into pieces, dying immediately.

# Chapter 2206: Fighting Over Eternal Life

Fang Yuan's eyelids twitched.

Zhan Bu Du perished, his immortal aperture swiftly absorbed by the Crazed Demon formation.

Fortunately, Zhan Bu Du's will managed to send his various Immortal Gu into treasure yellow heaven in time.

However, black fire was still wreaking havoc in the sovereign immortal aperture!

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable attacked once again.

Fang Yuan gritted his teeth and ordered the Qi Sea clone to block the calamity.

The next moment, however, starry paths twisted into an azure sphere that trapped Qi Sea Ancestor.

Caught unprepared, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's killer move bombarded and instantly shattered the starry path sphere.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable turned toward Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, who let out a sigh.

Lu Wei Yin and the rest were shaken—this was the first lapse in the two venerables' cooperation!

Having escaped death, the Qi Sea clone continued guarding Fang Yuan's side.

The sovereign immortal aperture had only slightly improved. If Fang Yuan relaxed his control even a fraction, the chaos would erupt again and destroy the entire aperture.

Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer vanished completely, the final merged great world dissolving into nothingness and sacrificing countless living beings.

The Door of Life and Death and the immortal graveyard flew away, stored into Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's immortal aperture.

In the Crazed Demon formation at the ninth layer's center, only the final piece of truthful floating ice remained.

Aboard the floating ice, the three Crazed Demon Eccentrics activated practice Gu together, carving the final portion.

The sight shook the immortals, while Fang Yuan silently breathed a sigh of relief.

As Fang Yuan expected, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable stopped attacking him, pausing to face each other.

The two venerables had allied to eliminate the pseudo venerables, but Fang Yuan used every method to hold onto his last breath.

With the eternal life research results nearly complete, seizing them was now of paramount importance!

Tangling with the pseudo venerables would only grant the other venerable an opportunity.

"Success, we succeeded!" The three eccentrics slumped on the ground, shouting hoarsely and excitedly.

Immortal killer move — Luck Gamble!

Qin Ding Ling emerged, targeting Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

Simultaneously, Golden Hooped Great Immortal reappeared, using his golden hoop to trap Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

Yet Giant Sun Immortal Venerable smiled: "Star Constellation, you have good methods, but haven't you forgotten something?"

The rank eight Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace blazed with dazzling light.

Activated by Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, it immediately disrupted the Crazed Demon formation and stirred Limitless' chains into unrest.

Star Constellation Chessboard Formation, forcefully merged with Limitless' chains to restrain the pseudo venerables, was already at its limit.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's sudden move freed Limitless' chains from the starry paths, collapsing the entire Star Constellation Chessboard Formation.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable coughed up blood from the terrifying backlash.

Seizing this chance, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable surged forward toward the Crazed Demon formation.

Without time to heal, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable produced that mysterious secluded domain of heaven and earth once more.

Star Constellation aimed the lantern-like secluded domain at Giant Sun's back and shook it.

Disturbed by intense emotions, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's speed fell sharply.

As the two venerables clashed, aftershock storms violently shook the world.

Obstructing each other, the two venerables reached the final mountain-sized truthful floating ice almost simultaneously.

The two venerables suddenly stopped, their expressions were strange.

Looking grim, Secret Schemer slumped on the ground and barely cupped his fists: "Venerables, the eternal life results lack only half a step. As long as either of you activates practice Gu briefly, this truthful floating ice will be carved successfully!"

The two venerables were silent.

Whoever entered could not leave for some time, needing to completely carve this truthful floating ice first.

The required contribution was crucial: expending too much strength would weaken the entering venerable despite their lead, playing right into the hands of the rival at peak condition!

Without Star Constellation Chessboard Formation or Star Constellation Immortal Venerable overseeing them, the Heavenly Court Gu Immortals were instantly outmatched, slaughtered one after another by the pseudo venerables.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable snorted coldly at the sight, immediately moving to assist.

Refusing to waste this chance, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable immediately moved to intercept Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

Evenly matched, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable used a brief respite to release Calamity Luck Altar from his immortal aperture.

Commanded by Giant Sun, Bing Sai Chuan charged Calamity Luck Altar into the truthful floating ice.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable snorted, shaking the lantern once more.

Calamity Luck Altar halted immediately as its commander, Bing Sai Chuan, clutched his chest, fell to his knees, and began weeping.

Blaming himself endlessly, he sobbed: "It is all my fault! If only I were stronger, I could have helped master defeat Heavenly Court and obtain the eternal life results. What is the point of my life? I let master down... Sob sob... I should just die!"

Saying so, Bing Sai Chuan actually activated a killer move to kill himself!

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable sighed, enduring Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's attacks while recalling Calamity Luck Altar to his side.

Golden light flowed and entered Bing Sai Chuan's body and mind.

With Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's help, Bing Sai Chuan broke free from the guilty emotions.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable smiled, having grasped Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's weakness and exploiting his lack of effective methods to revive subordinates.

Star Constellation opened her immortal aperture, releasing Qin Ding Ling and the other revived immortals.

Though slain by Lu Wei Yin's group, these Gu Immortals had swiftly revived in the immortal graveyard.

# Chapter 2207: Limitless' Revival!

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable coldly unleashed various methods, slaughtering all these Heavenly Court members.

The two venerables clashed repeatedly, keeping each other in check and preventing either side's subordinates from entering the truthful floating ice.

Amid the deadlock, Shen Shang suddenly rushed toward the truthful floating ice.

"Seeking death!" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable shouted, golden light blazing from his eyes.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable attacked Shen Shang at the same time.

Shen Shang shouted and quickly retreated, Paradise Earth and Lu Wei Yin used all their strength to protect him.

Yet the attacks struck Shen Shang, knocking him unconscious and barely breathing.

Fang Yuan made few moves, merely observing the battle while stabilizing his aperture.

He had finally resolved the black fire!

Inside his aperture, every resource point lay damaged, with Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley charred to ruins.

Sixty percent of the Gu Immortals were dead, including the old Combat Beast King.

"Only twenty percent of my immortal essence remains," Fang Yuan calculated inwardly.

As the two venerables fought, the power of their killer moves continuously escalated, surpassing prior limits.

The Crazed Demon formation continued operating as Limitless' chains materialized from thin air and shot toward the two venerables.

The pseudo venerables were forced to retreat repeatedly, nearly driven to the ninth layer's edge.

Paradise Earth looked at Fang Yuan: "Fang Yuan, do you have a plan?"

Pale-faced with an extremely weak aura, Fang Yuan smiled bitterly and shook his head.

The two venerables' killer moves collided and exploded, sending aftershocks slamming into the truthful floating ice.

Heavily damaged, the truthful floating ice cracked loudly as fractures spread across it.

The three eccentrics were also heavily injured, Pang Shan even died immediately!

"What are you doing, you idiots?! We only need someone to activate practice Gu, yet you are destroying the eternal life results!" Not Immortal berated them hysterically.

"Fang Yuan," Giant Sun Immortal Venerable shouted, "Heavenly Court is our common enemy! Lend me a hand and I will share the eternal life results with you, just like Primordial Domain!"

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable reacted immediately, shouting: "Fang Yuan, Heavenly Court has always sought to recruit you! Now that fate Gu is destroyed, why can't we join hands?"

Fang Yuan laughed heartily: "Venerables, you both scheme well! You can have my help, but can you afford the price?"

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable smiled: "Fang Yuan, I can give you all my Primordial Domain!"

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable immediately countered: "I can give you all my Primordial Domain too, plus trade my wisdom path true inheritance and Genesis Lotus' wood path true inheritance. Not just you, Fang Yuan—this offer extends to Paradise Earth, Lu Wei Yin, Shen Shang, Qi Jue, and all the rest! Heavenly Court's magnanimity is renowned, and I am willing to swear in the name of Star Constellation..."

Before Star Constellation Immortal Venerable could finish speaking, a crisp cracking sound rang out.

With a soft sound, the truthful floating ice shattered completely, its crystal fragments scattering and slowly dissipating.

The human-shaped ice was initially vague, but grew lifelike within breaths, rapidly filling with flesh and blood.

Finally, under the immortals' stunned gazes, the human-shaped ice transformed into a Gu Immortal.

*"Forever been the Dao-Seeking Crazed Demon,"*

*"Looking up towards life, death, and the universe."*

*"Through a million years of planning and accumulation,"*

*"On this day, Limitless achieves true eternal life!"*

Reciting the poem, the immortal slowly opened his eyes, his calm expression shocking Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, and Paradise Earth.

"Limitless?" Paradise Earth could not believe it.

"Limitless Demon Venerable, how could you revive? Impossible!" Star Constellation Immortal Venerable cried out involuntarily.

# Chapter 2208: True Eternal Life

"Did Limitless revive and achieve eternal life the moment the ice was carved?" Fang Yuan was shaken.

"This defies historical records—has Limitless Demon Venerable truly surpassed the venerables to attain eternal life?" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's eyes flickered with golden light.

"His current state is extremely strange; his aura is so immense not even master could compare." Star Constellation Immortal Venerable was shocked and suspicious.

Exchanging glances, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Star Constellation Immortal Venerable attacked Limitless Demon Venerable simultaneously with fierce methods.

Limitless Demon Venerable smiled faintly as spiraling chains effortlessly neutralized both venerables' methods.

Limitless waved his hands with a soft sound; space rippled, immediately forcing Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Star Constellation Immortal Venerable to retreat.

Limitless Demon Venerable smiled: "I do not wish to be your enemy. Having obtained the fruit of eternal life after a million years, I have yet to truly test it."

"How do you want to test it?" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable asked.

Through this hole, the Gu Immortals saw a vast sea of—Chaos!

"You lunatic, breaching the world boundary again! Aren't you afraid the entire world will be destroyed?" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable called out.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable added solemnly: "Limitless, I know your aspiration. But if you threaten the five regions and two heavens, Heavenly Court and I will exterminate you, even at the cost of our lives!"

"Calm down, both of you. The hole is small; I merely wish to test eternal life. We venerables are invincible in the world, yet plagued by tribulations born of this chaos."

"Which venerable here has not been injured by chaos, or suffered an ordeal because of it?"

"Crazed Demon Cave has run for a million years; there is one definitive test to verify if eternal life has been achieved."

Saying this, Limitless Demon Venerable extended his arm into the hole.

After holding his arm inside for a moment, Limitless Demon Venerable pulled it back.

His arm was pitch-black, resembling charcoal from a completely burnt tree.

Jaw slack, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable said dejectedly: "Is this... the true realm of eternal life?!"

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable sighed inwardly: "Now I understand why I couldn't deduce it—you have been utilizing the chaos outside the world ever since creating Crazed Demon Cave. You lunatic!"

Looking at his arm, Limitless Demon Venerable sighed softly: "In my previous life, I had reached the end of the road. Even the Heavenly Dao offered no possibility of eternal life. Restrained by fate Gu, I planned laboriously to design Crazed Demon Cave. I simply had no other choice."

"With you around, even if the hole widened, you would do your utmost to mend it."

"Yet..." Limitless Demon Venerable added, "this still falls short of eternal life. Wouldn't you agree, Paradise Earth?"

Paradise Earth nodded slowly and expressionlessly.

"Just a bit more... I am still lacking by a fraction," Limitless Demon Venerable shook his head, sighing deeply.

Turning his gaze to Demon Immortal Qi Jue, he asked, "Qi Jue, can you lend me a hand?"

Demon Immortal Qi Jue snorted coldly: "Why must I help you?"

Limitless Demon Venerable produced practice Gu with a smile: "This Immortal Gu was prepared for you from the start, Qi Jue. I have waited over a million years for this moment."

Demon Immortal Qi Jue laughed until tears flowed: "So my revival was part of your plot after all. Hahaha, how laughable! How utterly disappointing!"

"Limitless, you want to become a venerable without asking me? With me around, keep dreaming!" Demon Immortal Qi Jue had successfully ambushed Limitless Demon Venerable.

With bloodshot eyes, he shouted at Limitless Demon Venerable: "You already passed your tribulation and became a venerable! Why seal your cultivation to fight me to the death?"

Limitless smiled faintly: "Because you are my Dao Guardian. Only at death's door could I uncover the true bond between a venerable and their Dao Guardian—and my deduction proved correct. I have comprehended the secret behind Dao Guardians."

Limitless Demon Venerable replied calmly: "Being a venerable is merely another cultivation level. Compared to this, I prefer pursuing the Great Dao."

"Limitless, oh Limitless! Even a million years cannot change your nature—you're still the Limitless I know!" Demon Immortal Qi Jue shouted, pointing at him.

Limitless Demon Venerable smiled: "Just as I remain Limitless, you are still that same Demon Immortal Qi Jue, right?"

Gritting his teeth in helpless resignation, Demon Immortal Qi Jue grabbed practice Gu and flew toward Limitless Demon Venerable: "You're right, I am still me. Let's do it!"

Limitless' eyes flashed: "Good! Only with a Dao Guardian's aid can a venerable transcend rank nine and attain eternal life!"

Demon Immortal Qi Jue gritted his teeth: "Then let me see true eternity!"

The light of practice Gu enveloped Limitless Demon Venerable's entire body.

Conversely, Demon Immortal Qi Jue grew increasingly feeble until his aura hit rock bottom, forcing him to halt practice Gu.

Limitless' aura vanished completely, appearing no different from a mortal's.

Taking a deep breath, Limitless Demon Venerable thrust his arm into the world boundary hole once again.

A moment later, he pulled back an entirely intact arm!

# Chapter 2209: Limitless' Death

Seeing Limitless Demon Venerable's intact arm, even Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Star Constellation Immortal Venerable were thoroughly shocked.

Yet Limitless Demon Venerable had resisted the chaos bare-bodied, emerging completely unharmed!

"You did it," Star Constellation Immortal Venerable said with a deep sigh.

"No, he hasn't. This is not true eternal life yet!" Paradise Earth spoke with absolute certainty.

"Indeed, I have not. This cannot be considered eternal life," Limitless Demon Venerable agreed with a dejected expression.

Opening his mouth toward the hole in the world boundary, he began inhaling deeply.

After inhaling a vast amount of chaos, Limitless Demon Venerable sat cross-legged.

As Limitless Demon Venerable activated his killer move for the first time, an immense aura erupted, shaking every immortal's mind.

Since childhood, he had maintained a curious heart.

Thus, he planned with Star Constellation, dragging the Gu world into Crazed Demon Cave for a million years.

Exerting all his strength, he stepped into the boundless darkness.

Black fire began spewing from Limitless Demon Venerable's nose and ears.

Limitless Demon Venerable slowly opened his eyes, looked at the immortals, and said plainly: "I failed."

"No! I am still around!" Demon Immortal Qi Jue shouted, exerting all his strength to activate practice Gu.

A wave of profound light shot towards Limitless Demon Venerable's body from Demon Immortal Qi Jue.

The black fire on Limitless Demon Venerable was quickly extinguished!

Gaining a moment to rest, Limitless Demon Venerable laughed aloud and shook his head: "Qi Jue, you can stop now."

"How can we determine the outcome before putting in all our effort?" Demon Immortal Qi Jue rebuked angrily. "Are you willing to give up like this? True eternal life... I want to see it too!"

The Demon Venerable sighed with a complex expression: "I failed even after a million years of accumulation. Don't you understand? Eternal life... does not exist."

Bam.

Limitless Demon Venerable shattered abruptly, reverting into countless fragments of truthful floating ice.

Due to Demon Immortal Qi Jue's close connection with him, the chaos instantly swept over him, erasing him without a trace!

He died, he died on the road of exploration.

"Does eternal life truly not exist in this world? Is venerable the limit, with no... road ahead?" Star Constellation Immortal Venerable muttered.

Fang Yuan struck suddenly, snatching a piece of truthful floating ice!

Most truthful floating ice was destroyed in the chaos, but a small portion remained.

With nothing left to say, the reacting immortals attacked almost simultaneously.

Not Immortal and Secret Schemer died on the spot before making a sound.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable shouted angrily as golden light surged across the sky, exploding fiercely like an unstoppable tsunami.

The golden aurora suddenly spiraled, sucking in a piece of truthful floating ice.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable snorted coldly and scattered thousands of radiant flying stars to crash into the golden aurora, annihilating both.

As Giant Sun Immortal Venerable failed, the captured truthful floating ice broke free from the golden aurora, drifting in the void.

This largest truthful floating ice equaled all remaining fragments combined, and Star Constellation refused to let Giant Sun seize it.

Just then, Lu Wei Yin struck, targeting the small truthful floating ice fragment closest to him.

Without Star Constellation Immortal Venerable moving, sudden starlight appeared and sent Lu Wei Yin flying.

The hole was gradually expanding.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable said calmly to Star Constellation: "Why not call a ceasefire, eliminate these pseudo venerables first, repair the hole, and split the floating ice?"

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable nodded, replying with immediate action.

Immediately, dancing starlight shot everywhere, launching fatal attacks against Fang Yuan and the other pseudo venerables.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's killer move soon followed.

"I can't keep resisting two venerables. Everyone, I'm leaving first!" Fang Yuan shouted, dragging Qi Sea Ancestor along as he fled the ninth layer.

"Others can leave, but you, Fang Yuan, cannot!"

Fang Yuan's piece was substantial, comprising at least ten percent of the entire truthful floating ice!

Soon, Fang Yuan was forced to activate reverse flow protection seal again!

Both venerables' killer moves were quickly reflected back to them.

# Chapter 2210: Paradise Earth's Death

Paradise Earth nodded: "Fang Yuan, you are right!"

Fang Yuan, Giant Sun, and Paradise Earth each activated unique emotion-resisting methods to resolve the onslaught.
