Rank nine cultivation level!

"Mere tricks." Star Constellation Immortal Venerable snorted coldly as starlight surged toward Fang Yuan like flowing water.

Fang Yuan exhaled lightly; a surging qi tide blocked all the starlight.

On the other end, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable probed, sending down a torrential rain of golden needles.

Fang Yuan waved his hand; red aurora filled the sky, incinerating all the golden needles.

The pupils of the two venerables shrank.

Blocking both venerables' attacks perfectly, Fang Yuan displayed genuine rank nine cultivation level!

# Chapter 2211: Fang Yuan Becomes Venerable!

Fang Yuan's killer moves erupted, forcing Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable to retreat.

Equally confused, Qi Sea Ancestor smiled bitterly: "I had no clue either."

Lu Wei Yin and Shen Shang were speechless; Fang Yuan had hidden this so deeply he even deceived his own clone!

"Strange, strange, very strange!" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable attacked fiercely, raining down majestic golden light.

Fang Yuan shouted in response, activating a prepared method that forcefully suppressed the overwhelming golden light.

"The dao marks on his body far surpass Giant Sun Immortal Venerable!" Seeing this, Lu Wei Yin and the rest felt their hearts jumping.

Inhaling cold air, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable activated an investigative method.

Bleeding golden tears, Giant Sun finally pierced Cooking Luck Pot's defense to see Fang Yuan's true luck.

He saw a grand, condensed silver pillar of light connecting heaven and earth.

At the silvery pillar's base lay a brown grave, mostly dissipated with only a small portion left.

Seeing this, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable understood and sighed inwardly: "This is Paradise Earth's luck; it stabilized the silver light pillar's foundation while steadily eroding and replacing Fang Yuan's own. It was the biggest threat to Fang Yuan's luck initially, now that he killed Paradise Earth, this threat has been removed! This remaining part of the grave is the foundation of Paradise Earth that Fang Yuan has yet to devour completely."

Among the three clouds, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's golden-blood cloud stood at the top, while Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's and Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's hovered below, showing signs of tearing apart.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable pondered rapidly: "Fang Yuan truly possesses rank nine cultivation. I underestimated his shrewdness! When did he become a venerable? Did he have it from the start? All signs point away from that. He had secretly become a venerable during a certain moment in the Crazed Demon Cave battle. But... he clearly lacked attainment level."

During the Primordial Domain contest, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had ganged up on Fang Yuan, destroying its refinement path portion.

"Wait!" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable retreated, looking at Fang Yuan: "Did Thieving Heaven's true inheritance contain refinement path true meaning? You had the necessary attainment level long ago!"

Fang Yuan smiled, but his attacks became even fiercer.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable was sent flying by consecutive attacks.

Seizing this moment, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable unleashed countless lightning-fast flying stars that struck Fang Yuan's back in succession.

Yet he immediately straightened his back and wiped it with his hand.

The starlight specks shining intensely on his back were dao marks left behind by the flying stars.

Yet as Fang Yuan wiped them, all these dao marks were refined into his own!

The power of rank nine refinement path!

This countered Star Constellation, whose combat system relied on consecutive hits fueled by the flying stars' lingering dao marks.

A flash of insight struck Star Constellation Immortal Venerable as she realized part of the truth: "Fang Yuan, well played. You acted deliberately during the Primordial Domain contest. You gave up on competing for Primordial Domain and let us destroy its refinement path portion, pretending weakness so we would overlook you!"

Fang Yuan smiled plainly: "Star Constellation, you think too highly of me."

Star Constellation smiled coldly: "Stop deceiving us. Before entering Primordial Domain, you were already on the verge of supreme grandmaster attainment. After entering Primordial Domain, you realized that even if you gave up a portion of the refinement path Primordial Domain, you could still become a refinement path supreme grandmaster by yourself."

"First, becoming a venerable meant breaking the Heavenly Dao blockade through a risky tribulation requiring precise timing. Had you become a supreme grandmaster openly, we would have been on guard."

"Second, even if you ascended quickly, Limitless' eternal life result remained far off before the three worlds united. Moreover, Limitless' retaliation would have prevented you from using your strength."

"Third, remaining a non-venerable caused us to overlook you. In our eyes, even as a pseudo venerable, Paradise Earth seemed far more threatening."

"Finally, everyone held back trump cards during the Crazed Demon Cave battle—you did not know how deeply I had infiltrated the formation. Thus, you concealed your methods, waiting for us to exhaust ours before claiming victory!"

With a loud roar, he charged at Fang Yuan atop a giant golden aurora.

Simultaneously, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable launched a pincer attack from another direction.

# Chapter 2212: Refine Gu, Refine Human, and Refine Heaven!!

Facing their fierce assault, Fang Yuan quickly dodged for the moment.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable pursued relentlessly, shouting: "When I fought into the Door of Life and Death, I intended to probe Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's trump cards and Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's condition. But if you followed me, you would be able to see the strength of Heavenly Court and my Longevity Heaven."

Fang Yuan's counterattack shattered Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's killer move, forcing him back again.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable yelled: "Fang Yuan, you surely wanted to see Paradise Earth's premature resurrection too. What superb acting! After leaving the Door of Life and Death, Qin Ding Ling's method put me at a disadvantage. You managed to watch openly as our two sides fought and expended each other's strength!"

Realization dawned on Giant Sun: "You used your aperture being struck to obscure your aura, stacking tribulations to break through the Heavenly Dao blockade!"

Silently, Fang Yuan attacked fiercely while Giant Sun Immortal Venerable struggled to resist.

Staring at Fang Yuan, he continued: "That was how you became a venerable unnoticed. I originally thought that you were not skilled in aura concealment methods, but to think that your attainment in this aspect is shocking, you have been concealing your aura the entire time! You actually deceived me, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, and wait, even Paradise Earth was deceived!"

As golden light faded and starlight dimmed, Fang Yuan stood domineering, his aura surging like a rising tiger over ten thousand li.

Forced back, both venerables coughed up blood as their injuries worsened.

In a snow-white robe with fluttering hair, Fang Yuan dominated the battlefield, his aura towering over mountains and rivers.

He firmly grasped the upper hand as he suddenly recited —

*In my youth I knew the hardships of the world,*

*Yet I still aspired to soar above the clouds.*

*A journey of cold winds and uncertainty,*

*A lone traveler experiences a life of ups and downs.*

*A heart of steel forged from countless setbacks,*

*A lifetime of effort to forge one sword.*

*Today my sword aims beyond the clouds,*

*Refine Gu! Refine Human! Refine Heaven!!*

Fang Yuan's attacks surged like a tide, engulfing the battlefield from every direction.

Fang Yuan grabbed, drawing the final truthful floating ice toward him.

"Don't think about it!" Star Constellation Immortal Venerable snorted, tossing out the Door of Life and Death at the crucial moment.

The Door of Life and Death erupted with immense suction, while Giant Sun Immortal Venerable simultaneously struck Fang Yuan with a killer move.

To seize the truthful floating ice, Fang Yuan exposed a weakness and was forced into the Door of Life and Death by the two venerables.

Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and Reverse Flow River!

A road of life suddenly formed, extending out of the Door of Life and Death.

Fang Yuan instantly returned to the battlefield, leaving the furious, agitated Spectral Soul Demon Venerable trapped in the Door of Life and Death.

Seeing that the Door of Life and Death failed to trap Fang Yuan, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable sighed softly.

The Door of Life and Death opened next moment, and Spectral Soul Demon Venerable immediately flew out!

Still agitated and muddled, he ignored Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and furiously targeted Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Fang Yuan.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable seized this opportunity to snatch the truthful floating ice.

Immortal killer move — Dang Hun Luo Po Seal!

With one attack by Fang Yuan, a thousand of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's arms severed.

Fang Yuan roared and pushed forward, finally claiming that last truthful floating ice.

"Star Constellation, I've already done my best," Verdant Great Sun sighed from within Spectral Soul's belly.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's expression went blank. His roars and hatred vanished; ignoring Fang Yuan and Giant Sun, he charged expressionlessly toward the hole.

With a loud boom, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable used his own body to block the hole in the world boundary.

# Chapter 2213: Chu Du Versus Hei Lou Lan

At this ordinary location, tens of Gu Immortals were gathered!

Chu Du did not back down, he directly agreed.

Without standing on ceremony, Hei Lou Lan shot into the clouds like lightning.

Hei Lou Lan initiated the battle with aggressive strength path techniques. Chu Du stood firm as a mountain while Hei Lou Lan displayed outstanding ranged methods; after ten rounds, both charged and clashed in the center.

Before the watching crowd, the two traded punches and kicks in an intense brawl.

More than ten rounds passed again.

Chu Du gradually gained the upper hand.

Though Hei Lou Lan was powerful and versatile, her combat experience still paled compared to Chu Du's.

"This cannot go on, I need to take a risk!" Hei Lou Lan's gaze flashed sharp as a blade.

Halting the killer move midway caused severe backlash, inflicting heavy internal injuries on Hei Lou Lan.

Totem killer move — Dark Capital Strength Biao!

At the next moment, Hei Lou Lan's body shook.

A tiger roared, its huge black claws sent Chu Du flying.

Chu Du swiftly defended, but even after blocking the dark capital strength biao's strike, he was hurled like a cannonball toward the ground.

# Chapter 2214: You Have Won This Battle

The dark capital strength biao was already exceptionally fast and difficult to handle.

More importantly, after stabilizing herself, Hei Lou Lan quickly healed her injuries and rejoined the fray.

Coordinating seamlessly with the dark capital strength biao, she pincer-attacked Chu Du, firmly suppressing him.

"You will lose!" Hei Lou Lan roared, unleashing her killer move, eight directional strength fight.

At the critical moment, Chu Du laughed: "Finally caught you!"

A strength path giant hand appeared and grabbed forcefully.

The strength path giant hand pinned the biao into the ground.

Immortal killer move — Battle Strength Transpiration!

Chu Du erupted with an intense aura, his body expanding into a ten-meter giant.

Immortal killer move — Heaven and Earth Combined Strength!

A formless force enveloped a thousand li around them; the Gu Immortals were restrained like bugs fallen into oil.

"A quasi-battlefield killer move!" Hei Lou Lan gritted her teeth, astonished by Chu Du's technique.

Hei Lou Lan activated expend strength Immortal Gu to unleash seventy-percent expended strength.

Struck by the move, every action and killer move he performed required over fifty percent more effort.

"Awesome, this is really great!" Though bloodied and fractured, Chu Du laughed heartily with excitement.

Before Chu Du even tired, Hei Lou Lan was thoroughly suppressed, falling into dire peril!

Unwilling to fail, Hei Lou Lan secretly gritted her teeth; she could only take a risk.

The dark capital strength biao growled and leaped toward Hei Lou Lan.

Instead of evading, Hei Lou Lan advanced, merging into the dark capital strength biao in midair.

The dark capital strength biao shrank, becoming a smoky, illusory half-beast armor over Hei Lou Lan.

"Chu Du, time to go down!" Hei Lou Lan shouted, flapping the biao wings to instantly appear before him.

Hei Lou Lan's iron fists struck with thunderous force, sending Chu Du crashing into the ground.

Hovering in midair, Hei Lou Lan rained down relentless fist shadows.

The ground trembled amidst rising smoke, her terrifying strength making spectators turn pale.

"Enough... stop, Black Moon," Chu Du's strained voice called from the pit.

Hei Lou Lan ignored him, continuing her relentless pummeling.

"Is Chu Du admitting defeat?" Wu Guang asked excitedly.

"Something's wrong! Master is in an abnormal state." Chen Cheng's expression changed.

Everyone realized Hei Lou Lan had lost reason, acting purely on wild slaughter instincts.

But right at this moment, a figure flew out.

It was Chu Du!

Enduring the onslaught at life's risk, Chu Du gripped Hei Lou Lan's shoulder.

A powerful vibration erupted, separating Hei Lou Lan from the dark capital strength biao.

Hei Lou Lan regained her senses, her pupils instantly shrinking.

Her fist had pierced Chu Du's chest, yet he had intervened solely to save her from fatal backlash.

"Why?" Hei Lou Lan fell into utter confusion and disbelief.

At that moment, the ferocious dark capital strength biao appeared behind Chu Du and snapped viciously.

"Stop!" Hei Lou Lan screamed internally, willing the dark capital strength biao to halt.

Out of Hei Lou Lan's control, the dark capital strength biao remained wildly ferocious.

Just as Hei Lou Lan thought Chu Du was doomed, a powerful aura erupted from his body.

His killer move sent the dark capital strength biao flying with a single strike.

The immortals were shocked!

"Rank, rank eight cultivation level?!"

"Chu Du became a rank eight Gu Immortal?"

Hei Lou Lan stared wide-eyed at Chu Du: "Why?"

She withdrew her hand from Chu Du's chest and placed it upon his shoulder.

Hei Lou Lan activated a healing method upon Chu Du.

Pale-faced, Chu Du accepted her goodwill with a smile: "Ever since you began issuing challenges, I have been watching you, Fairy Black Moon."

"Because... strength path has been silent for far too long."

"Your emergence made me really happy. Continue on this path, Black Moon."

"Revitalize strength path and let it shine gloriously again!"

Looking at his dazzling eyes, Hei Lou Lan was silent.

Heavily damaged, the dark capital strength biao receded back into Hei Lou Lan's skin.

Hei Lou Lan looked at Chu Du deeply before leaving.

Before departing, she said: "Chu Du, you have won this battle."

Nevertheless, news of his advancement to rank eight caused a massive stir across Northern Plains.

Days later, Heavenly Court and Longevity Heaven released shocking news that shook the world.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had revived, while Gu Yue Fang Yuan had become a refinement path Demon Venerable!

The world was in an uproar, all the immortals were shocked.

# Chapter 2215: Heaven Refining Demon Venerable!

Fang Yuan returned to Eastern Sea.

"This place will do." Fang Yuan descended onto a small deserted island.

Activating several investigative killer moves, Fang Yuan secured complete control of the island, detecting no threats.

Fang Yuan directly took out the five regional limit formation.

Soon, five-colored smoke enveloped the island, billowing toward sky and sea.

Now a rank nine venerable, Fang Yuan could act openly without fear.

If Star Constellation Immortal Venerable or Giant Sun Immortal Venerable attacked now, Fang Yuan would welcome it.

Fang Yuan closed his eyes, sending his divine sense into the sovereign immortal aperture.

He had already accumulated several beads of rank nine immortal essence.

Refinement path killer move — Refine Self!

A fist-sized pale yellow light flowed from Fang Yuan's abdomen, circulating slowly around his entire body.

Fang Yuan had over a hundred injuries, mostly untreated.

The pale yellow light cleansed all starlight and golden aurora, refining away the foreign dao marks left by Star Constellation and Giant Sun.

Finally, the pale yellow light lingered over his severed arm before fading after an hour.

Fang Yuan exhaled, finally relaxing.

After a brief rest, he activated compound killer move Man as Before.

Instantly, his injuries healed and his severed arm was fully restored.

Though Fang Yuan was badly hurt, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable fared no better.

He was nearly certain their healing efficiency lagged far behind his.

With his physical body healed and soul at peak condition, Fang Yuan turned to address the sovereign immortal aperture.

The sovereign immortal aperture had suffered Giant Sun's killer move, Heavenly Dao tribulations, and a chaotic disaster.

The sovereign immortal aperture suffered devastating losses, its foundation reduced to merely twenty percent of what it was before Crazed Demon Cave.

"Yet I anticipated this before Crazed Demon Cave and prepared accordingly!"

Expending thoughts, Fang Yuan activated another compound killer move — Landscape as Before.

The year essence pools and sub-pools throughout the sovereign immortal aperture opened their dams.

Accumulated water from the River of Time manifested into a vast silhouette under Landscape as Before, sweeping across the mini five regions and mini nine heavens.

When the River of Time silhouette receded, various mountain and river resource points were completely restored.

This technique nearly exhausted the year essence pools' River of Time water, drastically reducing the aperture's time ratio relative to the outside world.

At this point, forty percent of the sovereign immortal aperture's foundation was restored.

The remaining forty percent losses stemmed from the chaotic disaster.

Landscape as Before was useless against chaotic disaster damage, and Gu Immortals slain by it could not be revived via Human Sea.

Only ten percent of his immortal essence reserves remained, leaving him dangerously precarious.

This was why Fang Yuan disengaged rather than continuing his battle against Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

Unfortunately, the rank eight Heavenly Essence Treasure Imperial Lotus that had once bolstered his essence reserves was now far less effective.

Furthermore, because aperture time had slowed drastically, Fang Yuan's essence production rate was low.

Fang Yuan needed time to recuperate, manage his essence, and refine natural dao marks across the world, which required enormous immortal essence.

"My immortal essence deficit is severe, and immortal essence stones are now virtually useless to me."

"Recklessly raising the sovereign immortal aperture's time rate to the limit won't work either," Fang Yuan frowned.

Venerables faced a grand tribulation every ten years, a myriad tribulation every fifty years, and a chaotic disaster every one hundred years.

Barring dream path or pill path varieties, grand and myriad tribulations posed no threat to Fang Yuan; he only feared the centennial chaotic disasters.

If the aperture's time ran too fast, chaotic disasters would arrive rapidly; if heavily injured or near death, other venerables would seize the opportunity.

Beyond replenishing immortal essence, Fang Yuan had also lost numerous Immortal Gu.

All seven Immortal Gu Houses Fang Yuan deployed in Crazed Demon Cave, including Rising Cloud City, were lost as well.

Besides Immortal Gu and essence, many Gu Immortals had perished.

Xiao He Jian, Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch, and clone Zhan Bu Du had all perished in Crazed Demon Cave alongside several aperture defenders.

Most were revived through Human Sea, needing to cultivate into immortals once more.

Yet a group remained unrevivable, including the rank eight Gu Immortal, old Combat Beast King.

Most importantly, he exposed too many killer moves.

In Crazed Demon Cave, Fang Yuan had been forced to expose compound killer moves alongside trump cards like refine self and totem moves.

These killer moves were now compromised and required modification before further use.

But compared to his losses, Fang Yuan's gains were much higher!

First, Fang Yuan ransacked the first seven layers, obtaining vast amounts of chaotic dao mark immortal materials.

In Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer, Thieves Den yielded vast amounts of rank nine immortal materials, enough to attempt refining rank nine Immortal Gu.

The second thing was Primordial Domain.

Fang Yuan obtained roughly as much Primordial Domain as Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, slightly less than Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

Third was Paradise Earth's true inheritance and methods to digest truthful floating ice.

The fourth was information.

From the battle, Fang Yuan gained deep insight into Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, and their factions, Heavenly Court and Longevity Heaven!

The fifth gain was also Fang Yuan's greatest gain.

His cultivation level rose to become venerable level.

This was a peak qualitative change!

From now on, he transformed from a chess piece into a player, able to openly plot against the world and rule the five regions.

Gu Yue Fang Yuan!

The eleventh venerable of the Gu cultivator world.

A demonic cultivator who became venerable through refinement path.

According to Heavenly Court and Longevity Heaven, his title was —

Heaven Refining Demon Venerable!

# Chapter 2216: Crying Because of Fang Yuan

Eastern Sea.

Shen clan headquarters, purple rosewood myriad sparrow island.

An elderly Gu Immortal waited patiently before a stone door.

Radiating a rank eight aura, he was Shen clan's authoritative first supreme elder, Shen Cong Sheng!

Rumble...

The secret room's door opened, and two Gu Immortals walked out.

Leading the way in a grey robe and shoulder-length black-and-white hair was Shen Shang.

His black fire injury fully healed after Divine Emperor City, Shen Shang's battle strength had reached pseudo venerable level.

Stepping aside at the stone door, Shen Shang smiled at the Gu Immortal behind him: "Please come in."

Behind him walked a pale, weakened Gu Immortal in grey hemp garments and a conical hat.

It was Lu Wei Yin, a survivor of Crazed Demon Cave.

Lu Wei Yin bowed slightly: "Senior Shen's human path methods are extraordinary; thirty percent of my injuries have healed already. I can only repay this debt later."

Shen Shang laughed heartily: "No need to worry, nor call me senior. We fought closely in Crazed Demon Cave; with our friendship, simply treat me as an equal."

Shen Cong Sheng laughed as well: "Seniors, the banquet is prepared, please follow me."

Shen Cong Sheng asked curiously: "Without Heavenly Court's and Longevity Heaven's declarations, the five regions would still be in the dark. What truly happened in Crazed Demon Cave? Not only did Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Star Constellation Immortal Venerable revive, Gu Yue Fang Yuan even became Heaven Refining Demon Venerable?"

Lu Wei Yin and Shen Shang exchanged looks before recounting the complex battle in Crazed Demon Cave.

Shen Cong Sheng frowned, asking: "Three things puzzle me. First, why did Limitless Demon Venerable rush to take such a risk at that moment? With such strength, couldn't he have suppressed the entire world and built another formation if this Crazed Demon formation was not enough to achieve his goal?"

"I see." Shen Cong Sheng nodded, asking again: "Second, are they truly leaving Spectral Soul Demon Venerable alone in the ninth layer's void?"

Lu Wei Yin pondered: "Manipulated by Star Constellation, Spectral Soul's emotions surged, nearly erasing his memories until he only vaguely recalled Lord Paradise Earth. Afterwards, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable was released from the Door of Life and Death by Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, he actually went to block the hole of the world boundary of his own accord, that was out of our expectations."

"He never regained his memories or sanity. Utterly emotionless, he simply treated the hole in the world boundary as the greatest threat. He used his body to block it and ignored everything else, that was truly a strange condition, as if... he was a soul beast."

Shen Shang said: "We discussed Spectral Soul's state without reaching any conclusion. Even the venerables seem able only to guess. After the battle of Crazed Demon Cave, they are all severely weakened, since the hole is handled by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, ignoring him is the best move for now."

Shen Cong Sheng asked his final question: "Third, Star Constellation and Giant Sun exposed Fang Yuan's venerable scheme, but how did he acquire so many new killer moves? I really cannot understand it, I thought Fang Yuan was always specialized in the wisdom path aspect of blocking others' deductions. His wisdom Gu was also used up in Heavenly Court, how could he still have so many killer moves?"

After their meal, Shen Cong Sheng brewed tea for Lu Wei Yin and Shen Shang.

Halfway through, tears streamed down Shen Cong Sheng's cheeks, ruining the tea.

"I am ashamed," Shen Cong Sheng apologized, quickly wiping his tears.

Having received treatment and warm hospitality, Lu Wei Yin knew the main show had arrived and asked: "First supreme elder of Shen clan, why are you weeping?"

Shen Cong Sheng answered: "A thousand years since our founding, Shen clan faces extermination in my generation. I am truly incompetent. This beautiful rosewood myriad sparrow island and our countless clansmen are all going to perish."

Shen Shang sighed deeply.

Lu Wei Yin asked: "Are you two worried about Fang Yuan?"

"Precisely. Word spread that Lord Demon Venerable returned to Eastern Sea, shrouding ten thousand li around a mortal island with five restriction profound light qi! The entire Eastern Sea Gu Immortal world is terrified!" Shen Cong Sheng said, tears streaming down his face once more.

# Chapter 2217: Delicious Wine Becomes Flavorless

With Heavenly Court and Longevity Heaven announcing it jointly, the news was undeniable.

Fang Yuan became Heaven Refining Demon Venerable, and Qi Sea Ancestor was revealed as his clone.

Previously, Eastern Sea's righteous path backed Qi Sea Ancestor's Righteous Qi Alliance to oppose Fang Yuan's variant human alliance.

With Fang Yuan leading both sides, Eastern Sea's righteous path clans had been thoroughly toyed with in his grasp.

Discovering the truth brought Shen Cong Sheng fury and humiliation, followed quickly by dread.

Though an Eastern Sea super force controlling seven seas and vast assets, how could Shen clan face Fang Yuan?

When Fang Yuan was a pseudo venerable, Eastern Sea's super forces united under Qi Sea Ancestor to stabilize their situation.

Now that he was a venerable, no Eastern Sea super force could escape his wrath.

Consulting the clan's elite Gu Immortals, Shen Cong Sheng decided that joining Fang Yuan was their best choice.

Though embarrassing, submitting to a Demon Venerable was understandable to all.

Having resolved to submit, Shen Cong Sheng realized Shen clan must be the first to do so in order to secure the greatest advantages. Leading alongside a pseudo venerable like Lu Wei Yin to rally other Eastern Sea righteous forces would leave a strong impression on Fang Yuan.

Shen Cong Sheng shared this plan with Shen Shang, who agreed it was viable—provided they convinced Lu Wei Yin first.

Thus, Shen Cong Sheng wept while Shen Shang sipped tea, awaiting Lu Wei Yin's reaction.

Lu Wei Yin sighed internally.

He knew Shen Shang shared close ties with Fang Yuan, having fought Heavenly Court together in the fate war and immediately obeying Fang Yuan upon exiting Divine Emperor City in Crazed Demon Cave.

Lu Wei Yin pondered before speaking: "Were Lord Paradise Earth alive, I would follow him. I helped Fang Yuan ambush Spectral Soul to aid Lord Paradise Earth's revival, yet now he has been killed by Fang Yuan..."

Lu Wei Yin gritted his teeth, showing anger on his face.

Shen Cong Sheng urged: "Lord Lu Wei Yin, you need not be conflicted. You aided Fang Yuan back then primarily following Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's will."

Pausing briefly, he added: "Furthermore, though Fang Yuan dealt the finishing blow, Star Constellation and Giant Sun were the primary culprits."

Lu Wei Yin looked up with a sigh, nodding reluctantly: "You are right."

He smiled bitterly: "Without Lord Paradise Earth, I am merely a wandering vagrant. And the mushroommen are all inside Fang Yuan's aperture as hostages. I am troubled by both choices, I cannot calm down. Shen Shang, we have a deep friendship forged from battles, I wonder what your opinion on this matter is? I would like to hear your view."

Shen Shang said: "I want to join Lord Heaven Refining Demon Venerable. Back in the blue dragon whale, we already worked together. Afterwards, we collaborated in both the fate war and the battle in Crazed Demon Cave. Through our multiple cooperations, Lord Fang Yuan had not let us down once. Of course, can we say that Fang Yuan is dependable? That is complete nonsense, he is still a Demon Venerable after all. But Shen clan's foundation is here, if we try to move, it will be too risky. After considering the pros and cons, this is the only thing we can do."

Lu Wei Yin's expression turned grim as he nodded: "Brother Shen has aided me greatly. Since that is your decision, I will follow you."

Shen Shang coughed: "It is best that you agree. We can help each other out in the future."

Seizing the moment, Shen Cong Sheng suggested Shen Shang and Lu Wei Yin take the lead in rallying Eastern Sea's other super forces to join Fang Yuan.

Expecting this, Lu Wei Yin nodded and agreed on the spot.

The next morning, Shen Cong Sheng set off to visit other super clans.

Based in Eastern Sea, these super forces soon learned from Shen Cong Sheng that Shen Shang and Lu Wei Yin would join Fang Yuan.

With Demon Immortal Qi Jue dead, only three pseudo venerable battle strength experts remained in the world.

Of the three, Shen Shang and Lu Wei Yin were joining Fang Yuan, while Righteous Qi Alliance leader Qi Sea Ancestor was Fang Yuan's clone!

The trend was overpowering, and other Eastern Sea super clans soon followed.

Of course, not everyone wanted to join Fang Yuan.

Xia Xuan, Xia Jia, and other Gu Immortals decided to abandon Eastern Sea and the Righteous Qi Alliance upon hearing the two factions' announcements.

After losing their territory, they had joined Qi Sea Ancestor only to be manipulated while key members were slain.

"This demon Fang Yuan killed our clansmen and devoured our foundation, this enmity is greater than heaven!"

"Eastern Sea, we will be back one day!"

Xia clan's Gu Immortals conversed while skimming the sea toward Central Continent in secret.

Zui Xian Weng watched until they vanished on the horizon.

This elderly Gu Immortal sighed deeply, he had a worried expression.

He already regretted promising Qin Ding Ling to infiltrate the Righteous Qi Alliance for Heavenly Court.

A day ago, Heavenly Court had ordered him to let these Xia clan Gu Immortals go.

"I succeeded this time because it was an easy mission, but next time?"

Thinking of Fang Yuan's venerable cultivation level, all of Zui Xian Weng's wine turned flavorless.

"How did he suddenly become a venerable out of nowhere?!"

# Chapter 2218: Fang Yuan As An Escape Route

A tiny bamboo stick skewering five cicadas rested over the fire grill.

The five skewered insects were rank five fire path purple smoke cicadas.

The cook wore a white robe with thick hair, seated on a folding stool that accentuated his tall, slender frame.

It was Northern Plains' rank eight Gu Immortal Heavenly Lord Bai Zu!

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu had a famous hobby in Northern Plains: cooking Gu worms into delicious delicacies from time to time.

Chu Du sat before him, the sole esteemed guest invited to the meal!

Chu Du chewed away until only one purple smoke cicada remained.

"Brother Chu, how's the taste?" Heavenly Lord Bai Zu asked with a smile while grilling.

Chu Du smiled: "Delicious! Grilled purple smoke cicadas have the taste of chicken and sweetness of taro. Crunchy and savory, one skewer is definitely not enough."

Chu Du nodded analytically: "Ever since Yi Tian Mountain showed Spectral Soul's profound food path attainments, Heavenly Court began researching food path with significant results. As a result, food path started to spread among people."

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu sighed: "With fate destroyed, five regions unified, and three venerables reigning, an unprecedented chaotic war is about to begin. Food path is becoming like this, strength path will also not stay the same. Brother Chu, I know that you are focused on promoting strength path, that is impossible during normal times, but in this great era, you have a good chance of success."

Chu Du laughed; having risked injury to save Fairy Black Moon, his aspirations were already clear.

Chu Du's eyes glimmered: "It is still too early. Currently, fewer than five true strength path experts exist across the five regions. Aside from Fairy Black Moon and me, Western Desert's Fang clan first supreme elder is the most famous. To revitalize strength path, I must get more Gu cultivators to choose it. I cannot change the world's environment, but I can create more strength path experts to push this tide forward!"

Reaching his intended topic, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu interjected: "Brother Chu, you forgot one strength path expert. He relied mostly on strength path early on, and is now far beyond ordinary people's realm."

# Chapter 2224: Power of a Refinement Path Venerable

A lump of fire was burning quietly in Fang Yuan's hand.

Red flame meant fire refinement, white was light refinement, and icy blue was ice refinement…

Fang Yuan clenched his fist lightly, the flame disappeared instantly.

Lately, he had personally refined over ten rank six and seven Immortal Gu without activating Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool.

But in this process, Fang Yuan gained a considerable harvest.

With supreme grandmaster refinement path attainment, no Gu recipes held secrets from him.

Right now, Fang Yuan could modify most recipes with a single attempt. Even for profound Immortal Gu recipes requiring time and effort to deduce suitable materials, a single glance with his refinement path intuition revealed the exact direction to take.

Repeated attempts confirmed that this intuition was unfailingly accurate!

The same held for modifying refinement path killer moves and methods. Once, struck by inspiration while refining Gu, he conceived a new method and succeeded on the first try!

Conversely, refining other paths' Immortal Gu was constrained wherever his attainment lagged behind.

"Refining refinement path Immortal Gu has a near-hundred-percent success rate. Of course, I haven't attempted rank nine refinement path Immortal Gu yet."

"Beyond gaining experience, as my attainment in other paths rises, my success rate for refining their Immortal Gu will rise rapidly too!"

"It is a pity that I cannot retrieve the Primordial Domain in treasure yellow heaven yet."

Unable to retrieve the Primordial Domain obtained from Giant Sun, he kept it in treasure yellow heaven.

Thinking of treasure yellow heaven, Fang Yuan recalled the three Gu Immortals that transacted with him earlier.

These three came from Southern Border, Central Continent, and Northern Plains.

Transacting openly under real names, the details quickly spread across the five regions' Gu Immortals.

The Southern Border immortal was from Wu clan's vassal, Qiao clan; transacting openly was Wu Yong's move to relieve political pressure.

The others were a Northern Plains lone immortal and a Central Continent demonic immortal.

Because Fang Yuan mandated open transactions, many Gu Immortals hesitated.

Only a few accepted open transactions due to disposition or external pressure.

Afterwards, Fang Yuan chose these two people.

Both were merely rank six Gu Immortals at the bottom of the immortal world.

Naturally, neither remained in Northern Plains or Central Continent.

Unsure how Heavenly Court and Longevity Heaven would react, the two were smart enough to flee to other regions immediately.

"The coming period is crucial." Unsure how Giant Sun and Star Constellation would react, Fang Yuan awaited their moves with wary alertness.

According to his deductions, there were four possible reactions from the two venerables.

First, they could send subordinates to kill these two rank six Gu Immortals. This was easy, Fang Yuan purposely chose them back then because they were weak.

If they perished to Longevity Heaven or Heavenly Court, Fang Yuan would be delighted.

Second, the two venerables cooperate to attack Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan was wary of this outcome, yet welcomed it as well.

Third, the two venerables target treasure yellow heaven instead.

This would cripple the foundation of his Great Love Gu refinement plan.

Yet this was highly unlikely. Since antiquity, Heavenly Court, Longevity Heaven, Shadow Sect, and countless geniuses had tried to locate treasure yellow heaven, all failing.

Fourth and most likely, the venerables would ignore his Gu refinement business and build advantages elsewhere.

"Ever since Crazed Demon Cave, the contest between me, Giant Sun, and Star Constellation has begun. Whoever develops best will hold the greatest advantage in our upcoming battles."

"Advantages may not guarantee victory, but accumulating them will surely decide the outcome."

Reflecting on Crazed Demon Cave, Fang Yuan knew he had triumphed through superior tactics.

Having only shown pseudo venerable battle strength and served as their pawn, the venerables subconsciously underestimated him.

Both Giant Sun and Star Constellation regarded each other as their greatest threat.

This gave Fang Yuan a lot of room to maneuver.

Thus, Fang Yuan intentionally leaked his refinement path ambitions, letting both venerables discover he sought to ascend through refinement path.

Once his refinement path attainment was sufficient, he deliberately conceded the fight over Primordial Domain before them.

With Primordial Domain's refinement path portion destroyed, both venerables believed Fang Yuan could not ascend anytime soon and lowered their guard.

On this basis, Fang Yuan continued to expose his weakness.

For instance, Zhan Bu Du's high-profile presence in several battles had given Star Constellation Immortal Venerable a massive headache.

Thus, Fang Yuan deliberately let Giant Sun kill him.

Likewise with known methods like reverse flow protection seal and Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress.

Fang Yuan deliberately exhausted these methods to further lower their guard.

Fang Yuan had even planned to sacrifice the Qi Sea clone purposely.

Even so, the two venerables remained wary, occasionally teaming up to eliminate him first.

That was the most dangerous moment for Fang Yuan.

As the venerables wore each other down, Limitless Demon Venerable's arrival and Paradise Earth's ascension attempt drew their attention away.

Seizing his chance, Fang Yuan killed Paradise Earth and repelled both venerables, emerging as Crazed Demon Cave's greatest victor.

Beyond sound tactics, victory hinged on the thorough preparations Fang Yuan had made beforehand.

Obtaining ability Gu and fortitude Gu proved immensely useful in Crazed Demon Cave.

Raising his subordinates' cultivation allowed White Rabbit and Miao Yin to clash with Duke Mei and Duke Tong.

He deduced and modified numerous killer moves: Dang Hun Luo Po Seal, road of life, hundreds of totem killer moves, heaven envies heroic geniuses, and countless compound killer moves.

He had even created artificial earth veins, defensive food path methods, and dream path killer moves.

Most saw use in Crazed Demon Cave; without such preparation, sound tactics alone could not have sustained him to the end.

"Having become a refinement path venerable and gained the most from Crazed Demon Cave, Giant Sun and Star Constellation are focusing heavily on me now."

"I must do everything to boost my strength and development to build an advantage in this three-venerable contest."

# Chapter 2227: Fang Yuan's Loving Consolation

The white crane-like heaven form cried out in front of Fang Yuan.

Boom!

Boom!

# Chapter 2244: Sudden Love

"Huff, huff, huff..." Gu Yue Fang Xiang breathed roughly, he hid behind the roots of an ancient tree.

He found over ten injuries on his body, including three bone fractures and severe internal damage that required urgent healing.

Gu Yue Fang Xiang gritted his teeth, activating his Gu worm.

The Gu dived into his chest wound, quickly stopping the internal bleeding.

The centipede’s legs dragged his flesh together, forcing the wound to mend with intense pain.

"I see blood traces!"

"This mixed blood Gu Yue Fang Xiang is truly a monster!"

Waking later, Fang Xiang found the Gu shattered but felt relieved. "It lasted long enough. Now is the time to escape."

After escaping the immediate pursuit, Fang Xiang continued his journey through the mountains. After half a day, the sky suddenly turned dim, a strange fog appeared in the mountain's forest.

Gu Yue Fang Xiang arrived in a deep pool on the mountain, he inspected the surroundings and felt very satisfied, he decided to stay here for some time and recuperate.

"There is a good source of water here, wild beasts will definitely come here to drink water, be it water or beast flesh, they are both needed."

"If I am lucky, I can even hunt and obtain some Gu materials to refine Gu worms, that will refill my stock of Gu worms!"

When their city was destroyed, his dying mother revealed his true identity.

Before her death, Steel Thread City Lord told Gu Yue Fang Xiang of his identity: "Oh son, mother has let you down. Didn't you always want to know about your father?"

"Your father is Gu Yue Fang Zheng, a former human slave who became a renowned demonic expert."

"If you want revenge, you must find him first."

His journey across the three continents shaped a determined nature, fueled by the belief that he would find his father.

Near the deep pool, Gu Yue Fang Xiang took a good rest for the night.

At dawn, Fang Xiang noticed the dense mist originated from the pool.

He dove in, finding the water grew warmer the deeper he went.

"This is?" He found a piece of white jade in the deep pool.

"A mermaid?" Fang Xiang stared at the beauty sealed inside, his heart jumping with adoration.

The mermaid, Lian Ke Xin, transmitted her voice: "Interesting mixed-blood kid, did you wake me?"

Lian Ke Xin laughed out loud, Gu Yue Fang Xiang felt his entire body going numb from infatuation, he thought: "This mysterious mermaid has such a beautiful voice as well!"

"I am mermaid immortal Lian Ke Xin. I was sealed here after a disaster. Please, help me break free."

"Refine the rank four earth refinement Gu and use it on this jade to save me some effort."

After spending three days, he finally refined the rank four earth refinement Gu on his first try.

Twelfth Hair, watching nearby, laughed; it was his secret help that ensured the success.

Lian Ke Xin 'escaped' and smiled at Fang Xiang with appreciation.

She healed his injuries and rewarded him with several mortal Gu and an inheritance.

Lian Ke Xin was about to leave, Gu Yue Fang Xiang asked in panic: "Fairy, fairy, will I be able to meet you again?"

Lian Ke Xin smiled: "Do you know the difference between immortal and mortal?"

"The inheritance I gave you is an immortal cultivation method. If you become an immortal, you will surely meet me again."

He knew that from now on, other than finding his father, he had a new goal to achieve in life —

That was to become a Gu Immortal and meet with Fairy Lian Ke Xin again!

But to think that he showed signs of creating killing path now while he was not sane.

Most importantly, it was refined in Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's body, this meant that although he was currently not sane, he was quite close to creating killing path.

Fang Yuan again offered Giant Sun half of Central Continent's resources to cooperate, but Giant Sun refused with an increasingly firm attitude.

Heavenly Court.

The qi harvest fruit continued to grow larger.

The vast amount of heaven and earth qi, countless qi path immortal materials, as well as methods like the primordial qi wall, were all turned into qi path dao marks that were added into the qi harvest fruit.

At the core of the qi harvest fruit, a human shaped core was formed.

As time passed, the core's features became clearer, it was increasingly human-like.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable saw this and immediately comprehended that Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable's revival method contained the profundity of human path.

"To think that master's human path attainment is even higher than I thought."

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable smiled faintly as memories surfaced in her mind.

In his bed, Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable suddenly coughed out blood.

Star Constellation frowned deeply: "Master, you suffered such heavy injuries and can't even walk now, yet you still took a risk to create a killer move!"

Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable had a look of joy: "These injuries are not an issue, my disciple, I succeeded. I grasped onto that inspiration and created a human path killer move."

Primordial Origin laughed: "With this, we will not need to force experts to join Heavenly Court. The temptation of lifespan extension is too great."

"As long as they contribute their immortal aperture to Heavenly Court, they will get to use this human path killer move to extend their lifespan."

Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable laughed to himself: "These injuries are nowhere near my limit. I've once suffered even greater injuries, you know it too, there has been at least five of such instances."

Star Constellation stared angrily: "You are twenty-five thousand years old; you must admit you are old. I will lead Heavenly Court while you recuperate!"

Primordial Origin laughed, and as she was taking her leave, he even winked at her playfully.

When she returned three days later, the legendary leader of humanity, the first generation Immortal King of Heavenly Court, had passed away peacefully.

Eventually, she spoke in a hoarse voice: "Master, I've already thought of the name for this human path killer move. It suits this scenario quite well, I'll name it — Lying in Bed."

Like her master, Star Constellation eventually sacrificed herself for Heavenly Court, becoming one with the Dao.

This pair of master and disciple were truly of the same lineage!

Lying in bed and others sleep soundly became the foundation of Heavenly Court's immortal graveyard.

Within the qi harvest fruit, the human shaped core had already grown to the size of a normal human adult.

The human shaped qi harvest fruit was already showing Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable's form.

He was the first venerable of the world, among them, he was also the one with the longest lifespan.

He had worked his hardest and given his life to Heavenly Court and all of humanity.

He was Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable!

Finally, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable let out a sigh of relief and knelt on one knee as she said: "This disciple pays respects to master."

Fang Yuan, however, stared at Heavenly Court. He frowned with a vague hint of anticipation and excitement in his eyes.

Boom!!!!!!!

Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable — exploded!

In Northern Plains, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable stood on the spot, he looked in the direction of Heavenly Court with uncontrollable shock on his face.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan had a faint smile.

# Chapter 2329: Fang Yuan’s Scheme To Blow Up Heavenly Court

Heavenly Court shattered!

Grotto-heaven fragments flew everywhere like a volcanic explosion, leaving the immortal aperture entrance exposed in spectral heaven.

The only thing that could be confirmed was that the mountain-like qi harvest fruit had dissipated entirely.

"I succeeded..." In Central Continent, Fang Yuan looked in the direction of Heavenly Court and let out a breath of air.

The sovereign immortal aperture's time flow was too fast, this forced Fang Yuan to undergo tribulations. Although he had used endless trouble multiple times to delay his tribulations, the chaotic disaster could not be skipped by this method.

Now that Fang Yuan was a venerable, he would need to annex a rank nine immortal aperture!

Back then, Fang Yuan used the immortal ascension of his Gu Immortal seeds to experience natural inspiration and use stealing heavenly secret to inspect all the secrets within Heavenly Court!

Thus, Fang Yuan thought of sacrificing Qi Sea Ancestor to purposely lure Star Constellation Immortal Venerable into using the qi harvest fruit revival method.

But he needed a chance to send Qi Sea there.

As long as nobody could make use of these heaven path dream realms, he could continue to refine rank nine Immortal Gu secretly, to raise his strength and pull apart his distance from the other venerables.

The contest over heaven path dream realms became the perfect red herring to conceal his scheme.

Thus, Fang Yuan sent Qi Sea Ancestor into the star array calculation formation and did not do anything excessive. Afterwards, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable personally 'helped' Fang Yuan and completed the arrangements for him, capturing Qi Sea Ancestor.

Giving up the Qi Sea clone was not enough, to assure Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, he even gave up the qi path Immortal Gu and Hu Land.

As long as he could achieve his goal, Fang Yuan could even give up rank nine Immortal Gu!

From the perspective of refinement path, the qi harvest fruit revival method was just using the qi harvest fruit as the main material, along with Primordial Origin's arrangements in Heavenly Court, to create a new body and soul.

The tampering involved peak refinement path profundities that Star Constellation could not detect. The flaw would only manifest during the revival process.

"My plan succeeded, as for the gains, it will depend on future developments." Fang Yuan did not rush to attack Heavenly Court.

He continued to plunder Central Continent while contacting Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

"Giant Sun, we are so lucky! A problem happened during Primordial Origin's revival, Heavenly Court blew up instead. This is our best opportunity to strike, if we miss this and Heavenly Court recovers, we will regret not taking action for life."

After seeing Heavenly Court's explosion, after a momentary shock, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable immediately thought of attacking Heavenly Court.

"Should I really attack Heavenly Court now?"

"Did they really make a mistake? Is Fang Yuan behind this?" Giant Sun Immortal Venerable thought of Fang Yuan's mysterious defensive method, he really could not see through this person. It was possible that Fang Yuan was behind this all along.

"Strange, why did I not sense this huge variable earlier when I used luck inspection on Heavenly Court?"

"Unless, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable used a method to conceal Heavenly Court and it stopped my luck inspection from working? That would really be ironic."

The last thing that made Giant Sun Immortal Venerable hesitate was Light Emperor.

As well as the wild rank nine light Gu in his immortal aperture!

"Giant Sun is still hesitating, did he notice anything?" Fang Yuan saw that Giant Sun Immortal Venerable was not taking any action, he started to ponder.

"With the explosion, Heavenly Court's losses cannot be assessed now. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's injuries are unclear as well. She has a huge territorial advantage inside Heavenly Court, she must not have gotten too injured, so she is still a threat."

He casted his gaze at Spectral Soul Demon Venerable who was far away.

"He is the best vanguard that we can have." Fang Yuan smiled as he used his method.

Totem killer moves flew out and provoked the insane Spectral Soul Demon Venerable continuously, he was successfully lured into Heavenly Court!

# Chapter 2330: Almost Suffering Amnesia From The Explosion

With a soft grunt, Zhao Lian Yun woke up in an area of ruins and rubble.

"What... what happened to me?"

"What happened? Why am I like this?"

Primordial Origin's explosion occurred too suddenly and abruptly, Zhao Lian Yun suffered a huge impact and almost experienced amnesia!

A moment ago, the many Gu Immortals around her were watching the mountain-like qi harvest fruit with immense anticipation for Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable's revival.

"Why did it explode all of a sudden?!" As her memories cleared up, Zhao Lian Yun's breathing became rougher.

"I can't believe it, I am practically unharmed. Did love Gu protect me?"

"Wait... I need to save the rest!"

She might have had love Gu's protection, but others did not have a rank nine Immortal Gu like her.

She set off into the vast field of qi currents, searching for survivors.

The area was saturated with qi path dao marks, rendering her investigative methods useless unless she could somehow trigger love Gu.

But love Gu was not just a rank nine Immortal Gu, it was very special. Even a venerable could not refine it forcefully, even though it was wisdom path, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable had not been able to use it. Thus, it continued to live in Zhao Lian Yun's body.

After a while, she gasped as she found Bu Zhen Zi.

Half his body was gone, his remaining organs protected only by a fragile skeleton.

He was in a phantom state, linked by translucent threads, but the condition was unstable.

His remaining bones were slowly turning into qi under the influence of the explosion's dao marks.

"When the explosion occurred, Bu Zhen Zi used a phantom path method, but even with this semi-invulnerable state, he could not avoid the injuries caused by this explosion."

"Bu Zhen Zi can't last much longer..." Zhao Lian Yun was helpless, she felt increasingly anxious.

She temporarily abandoned him to look for others, marking the spot.

"Is anyone here? Please help!"

"What happened? Did Fang Yuan or the other venerables attack?"

"What are Heavenly Court's losses?"

"Can anyone come to help me? At least respond with a word!"

An intense suction force ahead drew in the surrounding white qi.

At the source, she found an open immortal aperture entrance.

Zhao Lian Yun stood before the immortal aperture's entrance in a daze, motionless.

Seeing the aperture, Zhao Lian Yun’s eyes turned red with sorrow; Fairy Liu Fang had died in the explosion.

Although she had rank seven cultivation level, she did not have the defensive power of phantom path, she did not have love Gu either.

Along the way, she saw many more apertures taking in heaven and earth qi.

"Not mentioning the Heavenly Court members, Central Continent's ten great ancient sects sent more than ten Gu Immortals each. Not counting the captives in the star array calculation formation, there are over a hundred Gu Immortals from the ten sects in Heavenly Court now."

"This explosion killed eighty percent of the Gu Immortals!"

But to think that Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable would explode upon revival, like this, many of Central Continent's Gu Immortals died, the pillars of Central Continent's righteous path collapsed.

"Doomed, Central Continent is doomed."

"Maybe Heavenly Court can still revive them?" Zhao Lian Yun was hopeful.

Heavenly Court fell into a trap!

Although Zhao Lian Yun had rank nine love Gu, she was only rank six, what could she do?

"Don't be dejected," a voice called as a lantern brightened the fog. "Heavenly Court is still around, and we are still alive."

It was an elderly Gu Immortal, his body was bloodstained from head to toe.

One of his arms was gone from the explosion, his remaining arm was carrying a small fire in his palm.

Zhao Lian Yun recognized him, it was Immortal Crane Sect's Old Lord Can Yang.

# Chapter 2331: Pitiful Survivors

Old Lord Can Yang was a famous expert in Central Continent, his reputation was long established.

Zhao Lian Yun recalled his Flickering Flame and life chasing fire move, as well as his investigation of the Eighty-Eight True Yang Building with Feng Jiu Ge.

Zhao Lian Yun breathed in deeply, the look of dejectedness on her face quickly faded away as she asked Old Lord Can Yang for help, she explained Bu Zhen Zi's condition.

But Old Lord Can Yang shook his head slowly: "I cultivate fire path, my understanding of phantom path is very shallow, I am not skilled in healing methods. There is nothing I can do."

Once he said that, Old Lord Can Yang's body started to shiver at an observable level.

"Cough cough."

As they moved through the ruins, they encountered more survivors. There was a giant monkey lying on the ground, he was like a small mountain.

Zhao Lian Yun was stunned; Shi Lei's battle strength was even higher than Old Lord Can Yang's.

Shi Lei was the publicly known number one rank seven Gu Immortal in Central Continent, his battle strength was even higher than Old Lord Can Yang!

He had turned into an ancient desolate beast, using its physique to barely survive his injuries.

"Cough, cough." Old Lord Can Yang coughed again, blood could be seen again. A moment later, he suppressed his injuries again.

Not long after, they met Yang Feng.

He was a rank seven Gu Immortal of Ancient Soul Sect, he cultivated transformation path. Like Shi Lei, he had also turned himself into an ancient desolate beast.

"My greatest injury is my spine, if I exert it even a little, my spine will break."

The three of them continued to search, soon, they found Vicious Lightning Fiend.

Vicious Lightning Fiend also had rank seven cultivation level, his body was covered in lightning as he floated in the air, three Lightning Deities surrounded his body and assisted in healing him.

"I was fortunate."

"Right before the explosion occurred, I watched while having my Lightning Deities revolve around me to leave a good impression on Lord Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable."

"The killer move Lightning Deity was created by Vicious Lightning Fiend using the incomplete Immortal Gu recipe of Blood Deity. With more than ten Lightning Deities which had rank seven Gu Immortal battle strength each, he was known as a top expert among rank seven Gu Immortals in Central Continent, only being inferior to Shi Lei."

Zhao Lian Yun recalled as she greeted Vicious Lightning Fiend.

But there was an awkward thing.

The apertures of the dead were absorbing the white qi filling Heavenly Court, which also flowed out through new gaps.

"Wait." Yang Feng, who had turned into a giant wolf and needed to rest every few steps, suddenly spoke.

"My waist hurts, but more importantly, people are coming from behind us."

Yang Feng nodded: "Of course my waist hurts, but more importantly, there are people coming from behind us."

"Indeed, there are three of them." Old Lord Can Yang's gaze flickered as he noticed.

Zhao Lian Yun and the rest stopped moving, they started at the stirring white qi.

The three Lightning Deities waited solemnly, but suddenly, one spun around on the spot, one flew up into the sky, while the final one twisted its body around like it was having a spasm from a lightning shock!

# Chapter 2332: Heavenly Court’s Resolve

Vicious Lightning Fiend's face turned red, this was a rarely seen expression, he explained: "The Lightning Deities are damaged from the explosion, due to the qi path dao marks carved on them, they are hard to control. If my concentration falls, they will go berserk."

A few breaths of time later, Old Lord Can Yang relaxed and said: "They are our comrades."

Soon, two rank eight Gu Immortals appeared before the group.

These were rank eight Gu Immortals after all, the supreme elders had countless methods in their possession, they managed to stabilize Yang Feng and Old Lord Can Yang's injuries, but the effect was not great.

Soon after, the vague figure of blood appeared from within the white qi, it was the rank eight Immortal Gu House — Demon Judgment Board!

Although Demon Judgment Board was a rank eight Immortal Gu House, it specialized in investigation, its combat prowess and healing ability were far weaker.

Fang Zheng asked the ten children of human path inside the house to help. "We are all of the same faction," they responded, "we will do our best!"

"Lord Fang Zheng, please don't say that, the ten great ancient sects are all subsidiaries of Heavenly Court, we are all of the same faction. We will do our best to help the rest!" The ten children of human path quickly responded.

The ten children were now rank six human path Gu Immortals, ordered by Star Constellation Immortal Venerable to cultivate in Divine Emperor City's painting worlds.

Fang Zheng had also comprehended the essence of painting path, allowing him to unleash blood path killer moves through Demon Judgment Board with greatly increased strength.

After Fang Zheng made the arrangements, the ten children flew out to assist Zhao Lian Yun and the rest.

Human path was unique; their healing methods were effective on the immortals despite their different paths.

But now, with the human path killer moves, their conditions improved rapidly with immediate effect.

Seeing them recover, Fang Zheng steered Demon Judgment Board toward the inner area.

Having undergone many ordeals, his foresight was sharp as he assessed the dire situation.

Fang Zheng navigated the dense white qi toward the heart of Heavenly Court. He soon reached the Heavenly Court immortals.

Many were present, but some were missing, their fates unknown.

They were standing around Qin Ding Ling.

With Star Constellation missing, Qin Ding Ling took command despite her haggard, bloodstained appearance.

After the immortals discussed this, she split them into three groups.

Fang Zheng brought his master, Red Heart Traveler, into Demon Judgment Board for healing.

As fellow blood path cultivators, the healing was exceptionally effective and Red Heart's aura stabilized.

Red Heart Traveler noted that Heavenly Court had never suffered such damage, even during the fate war.

Fang Zheng asked if the explosion was a scheme.

"But if someone did this, then Giant Sun Immortal Venerable and Heaven Refining Demon Venerable are the most suspicious. Between them, Heaven Refining Demon Venerable is the most likely culprit!"

Fang Zheng knew the other venerables would not miss this chance to attack; Heavenly Court was in immense danger.

Regarding this, Fang Zheng was resolved.

Suddenly, Demon Judgment Board's investigative methods triggered an alert.

A series of totems flew around and provoked a huge mountain-like monster to approach Heavenly Court.

Spectral Soul was insane, but the totem killer moves were Fang Yuan's signature. The Heavenly Court immortals watched with bloodshot eyes, furious at the scheme.

Duke Mei's group struggled through the qi path dao marks at the center but found no trace of Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

"Heavenly Court is right behind us, we cannot retreat!" Qin Ding Ling ordered, her tone patriotic. "Everyone, use all your effort to destroy the totems and lure Spectral Soul away!"

Without a word, the immortals followed her into the fray.

A huge battle soon erupted, it got intense immediately.

Sensing Heavenly Court's aura, Spectral Soul roared and attacked directly.

The immortals resisted with all their might but were helpless against Spectral Soul's advancement, falling into despair.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable hesitated: "We should observe further."

"You dare?!"

"Why won't I? You have Longevity Heaven while Star Constellation has Heavenly Court. If you want to drive me to desperation, will I just give up and die? I will not let either of you off!" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, showing a look of insanity and desperation.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable snorted coldly: "Fine, I'll ally with you, we must destroy the qi harvest fruit core!"

Intense wind blew as Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's hair fluttered behind her.

She frowned slightly as the image of Heavenly Court was reflected in her dark pupils.

Inside Heavenly Court, amplified by wisdom path dao marks, she easily suppressed the insane Spectral Soul Demon Venerable within a dense star fog.

Despite the assault, Star Constellation held. Within Heavenly Court, her strength was terrifying, allowing her to resist both venerables simultaneously.

"Star Constellation Immortal Venerable suppressed the two Demon Venerables, Giant Sun and Fang Yuan, on her own!"

Immortal killer move — Arrival of Dragon Snake with Dust Fog and Explosive Soul Wind!
